descriptionHtml:
The Emerging ERP Solutions practice is all about bringing you the best in cloud-based ERP applications like Workday and Infor. We're here to help transform finance and supply-chain processes, making them more efficient and cost-effective. Our teams use Deloitte's vast expertise to deliver lasting results for our clients. By working closely with CFOs, CIOs, and Business Unit leaders, we provide valuable business transformation and continuous support across various industries.

If you're seeking an exciting career with plenty of opportunities, consider joining us at Deloitte. We work on projects involving Workday Financials, Supply Chain Management, Infor Solutions, Microsoft Dynamics, and Sustainability Technology and Strategy. With such a variety of areas to explore, you'll have the chance to make a real impact while growing in your career. Come be part of a team that values innovation and strives for excellence. Apply now and let's achieve great things together!

Deloitte's Emerging ERP Solutions-Workday teams are market leaders working with clients across industries to deliver transformational solutions optimized for their unique business needs.

Recruiting for this role ends on 4/1/2026

Work you'll do

As a Workday Supply Chain Management Sr Consultant, you will lead project workstreams, identify and document business requirements, provide functional design, prototyping (including scenario design, flow mapping), testing, user training, defining support procedures. Additional duties may include: coordination of schedules, creation of documentation and collateral, creation and execution of test / use cases, configuration of Workday software, assisting with prioritization and sequencing of the workstream's efforts and assisting project leadership as required.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of consulting or industry experience in Workday SCM/ERP finance domain
  • 2+ years of experience leading SCM workstreams as well as project teams
  • Workday SCM Professional certification or capability to obtain upon joining
  • A minimum of 1 full life cycle Workday SCM implementation
  • Demonstrated knowledge in some combination of the following: Procure-to-Pay (PTP), Order-to-Cash (OTC)
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Bachelor's Degree or 8 years equivalent professional experience
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred

  • An advanced degree in the area of specialization
  • Functional knowledge around SCM systems and processes.
  • Experience defining systems strategy, developing systems requirements, designing and prototyping, testing, training, defining support procedures, and implementing practical business solutions under multiple deadlines Ability to work independently, manage small engagements or parts of large engagements
  • Experience as a lead and mentor to junior staff
  • Presentation skills (MS Visio, MS PowerPoint)

Wages + Salary

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $116,000 to $229,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Must Have Technical/Functional Skills

  • Deep expertise in complex manufacturing processes, engineering-driven production, and SAP S/4HANA Manufacturing capabilities, with hands-on experience implementing SAP DM in Engineer-to-Order (ETO), Make-to-Order (MTO), Make-to-Stock or complex process & discrete based manufacturing environments.
  • Experience with RISE with SAP transformation programs.
  • Experience of Working in Global template deployment projects
  • Strong understanding of: Cloud Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), production automation, and integrating these systems with SAP's core ERP modules
  • Experience of project execution using Agile or Agile-Hybrid methodology
  • Create technical and functional specifications for custom developments (RICEFW) to meet specific business needs.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Drive solution design and discovery with business stakeholders.
  • Define scalable manufacturing and engineering process architecture aligned with SAP Best Practices and RISE with SAP standards.
  • Conduct Fit-to-Standard workshops and identify process gaps, enhancements, and optimization opportunities.
  • Provide leadership for manufacturing transformation initiatives across engineering, production, quality, and supply chain.
  • Configure and implement SAP Digital Manufacturing capabilities including Manufacturing BOMs, Routings and work instructions, Shop floor execution, Production versions
  • Support migration from legacy manufacturing systems to S/4HANA.
  • Define master data governance standards for manufacturing objects. Lead implementation project from blueprinting through testing (Unit, SIT, UAT), cutover, Go-Live, and hyper-care support.
  • Advise clients as a trusted advisor on best practices for manufacturing, particularly regarding production sequencing, constraint management, and manufacturing efficiencies.

Generic Managerial Skills, If any

  • Lead workshops and discovery sessions with business stakeholders, solution architects, and cross-functional SAP teams
  • Translate business transformation objectives into integrated solution design decisions
  • Coordinate with testing, data migration, and legacy system teams
  • Manage issue triage, impact analysis, prioritization, and closure for defects
  • Communicate risks, dependencies, design decisions, and status clearly to program leadership
  • Prepare and review functional documentation, configuration rationale, and training content
  • Support knowledge transfer and adoption of standardized S/4HANA processes

Salary Range: $130,000 - $150,000 a year

TCS Employee Benefits Summary

Discretionary Annual Incentive.

Comprehensive Medical Coverage: Medical & Health, Dental & Vision, Disability Planning & Insurance, Pet Insurance Plans.

Family Support: Maternal & Par ental Leaves.

Insurance Options: Auto & Home Insurance, Identity Theft Protection.

Convenience & Professional Growth: Commuter Benefits & Certification & Training Reimbursement.

Time Off: Vacation, Time Off, Sick Leave & Holidays.

Legal & Financial Assistance: Legal Assistance, 401K Plan, Performance Bonus, College Fund, Student Loan Refinancing.

Qualifications: BACHELOR OF COMPUTER SCIENCE

The Emerging ERP Solutions practice is all about bringing you the best in cloud-based ERP applications like Workday and Infor. We're here to help transform finance and supply-chain processes, making them more efficient and cost-effective. Our teams use Deloitte's vast expertise to deliver lasting results for our clients. By working closely with CFOs, CIOs, and Business Unit leaders, we provide valuable business transformation and continuous support across various industries.

If you're seeking an exciting career with plenty of opportunities, consider joining us at Deloitte. We work on projects involving Workday Financials, Supply Chain Management, Infor Solutions, Microsoft Dynamics, and Sustainability Technology and Strategy. With such a variety of areas to explore, you'll have the chance to make a real impact while growing in your career. Come be part of a team that values innovation and strives for excellence. Apply now and let's achieve great things together!

Deloitte's Emerging ERP Solutions-Workday teams are market leaders working with clients across industries to deliver transformational solutions optimized for their unique business needs.

Recruiting for this role ends on 4/1/2026

Work you'll do

As a Workday Supply Chain Management Sr Consultant, you will lead project workstreams, identify and document business requirements, provide functional design, prototyping (including scenario design, flow mapping), testing, user training, defining support procedures. Additional duties may include: coordination of schedules, creation of documentation and collateral, creation and execution of test / use cases, configuration of Workday software, assisting with prioritization and sequencing of the workstream's efforts and assisting project leadership as required.

Qualifications



- 5+ years of consulting or industry experience in Workday SCM/ERP finance domain
- 2+ years of experience leading SCM workstreams as well as project teams
- Workday SCM Professional certification or capability to obtain upon joining
- A minimum of 1 full life cycle Workday SCM implementation
- Demonstrated knowledge in some combination of the following: Procure-to-Pay (PTP), Order-to-Cash (OTC)
- Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
- Bachelor's Degree or 8 years equivalent professional experience
- Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred



- An advanced degree in the area of specialization
- Functional knowledge around SCM systems and processes.
- Experience defining systems strategy, developing systems requirements, designing and prototyping, testing, training, defining support procedures, and implementing practical business solutions under multiple deadlines Ability to work independently, manage small engagements or parts of large engagements
- Experience as a lead and mentor to junior staff
- Presentation skills (MS Visio, MS PowerPoint)

Wages + Salary

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $116,000 to $229,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Must Have Technical/Functional Skills

  • Deep expertise in complex manufacturing processes, engineering-driven production, and SAP S/4HANA Manufacturing capabilities, with hands-on experience implementing SAP DM in Engineer-to-Order (ETO), Make-to-Order (MTO), Make-to-Stock or complex process & discrete based manufacturing environments.
  • Experience with RISE with SAP transformation programs.
  • Experience of Working in Global template deployment projects
  • Strong understanding of: Cloud Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), production automation, and integrating these systems with SAP's core ERP modules
  • Experience of project execution using Agile or Agile-Hybrid methodology
  • Create technical and functional specifications for custom developments (RICEFW) to meet specific business needs.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Drive solution design and discovery with business stakeholders.
  • Define scalable manufacturing and engineering process architecture aligned with SAP Best Practices and RISE with SAP standards.
  • Conduct Fit-to-Standard workshops and identify process gaps, enhancements, and optimization opportunities.
  • Provide leadership for manufacturing transformation initiatives across engineering, production, quality, and supply chain.
  • Configure and implement SAP Digital Manufacturing capabilities including Manufacturing BOMs, Routings and work instructions, Shop floor execution, Production versions
  • Support migration from legacy manufacturing systems to S/4HANA.
  • Define master data governance standards for manufacturing objects. Lead implementation project from blueprinting through testing (Unit, SIT, UAT), cutover, Go-Live, and hyper-care support.
  • Advise clients as a trusted advisor on best practices for manufacturing, particularly regarding production sequencing, constraint management, and manufacturing efficiencies.

Generic Managerial Skills, If any

  • Lead workshops and discovery sessions with business stakeholders, solution architects, and cross-functional SAP teams
  • Translate business transformation objectives into integrated solution design decisions
  • Coordinate with testing, data migration, and legacy system teams
  • Manage issue triage, impact analysis, prioritization, and closure for defects
  • Communicate risks, dependencies, design decisions, and status clearly to program leadership
  • Prepare and review functional documentation, configuration rationale, and training content
  • Support knowledge transfer and adoption of standardized S/4HANA processes

Salary Range: $130,000 - $150,000 a year

TCS Employee Benefits Summary

Discretionary Annual Incentive.

Comprehensive Medical Coverage: Medical & Health, Dental & Vision, Disability Planning & Insurance, Pet Insurance Plans.

Family Support: Maternal & Par ental Leaves.

Insurance Options: Auto & Home Insurance, Identity Theft Protection.

Convenience & Professional Growth: Commuter Benefits & Certification & Training Reimbursement.

Time Off: Vacation, Time Off, Sick Leave & Holidays.

Legal & Financial Assistance: Legal Assistance, 401K Plan, Performance Bonus, College Fund, Student Loan Refinancing.

Qualifications: BACHELOR OF COMPUTER SCIENCE

descriptionHtml:
Position Description

CGI is seeking a high‑potential Junior SAP S/4HANA Functional Consultant with experience in SAP ECC or S/4HANA. The successful candidate will work closely with clients in workshops, understanding their requirements, designing and presenting solutions, testing and/or configuring SAP, and completing full software lifecycle implementations for the federal government. The primary focus is on design, configuration, and testing in SAP S/4HANA Public Sector. This role requires a broad understanding of SAP Federal Financial Accounting processes and solutions.

This position is located in one of CGI Federal's offices in Fairfax, VA, Lebanon, VA, Lafayette, LA or Knoxville, TN; however, a hybrid working model is acceptable. You will be required to work in a CGI Federal office two days per week.

Your future duties and responsibilities

  • Participate as part of a team in gathering and validating requirements, designing solutions, implementing, and supporting SAP Financials.
  • Enhance the client’s business functionality and overall performance while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.
  • Help facilitate workshops to review business requirements and translate them into system requirements, with the ability to identify gaps, issues, and work‑around solutions.
  • Act as a liaison with the client for troubleshooting: investigate, analyze, and solve software problems; map client business requirements, processes, and objectives; and develop necessary product modifications to meet client needs.
  • Design, configure, and test FI, CO, FM/GL, SD, MM, and/or AA modules, including unit testing, system testing, and supporting clients through User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  • Participate in the successful implementation of SAP S/4HANA, providing functional guidance, presentations, and instruction on SAP products to clients.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

  • Due to the nature of contract requirements, U.S. citizenship and successful completion of a CGI background check are required prior to beginning work. In addition, candidates must have the ability to obtain and maintain a DHS EOD/Public Trust clearance.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
  • Up to 3 years of SAP consulting experience, ideally supporting financial implementations.
  • Experience with financial management best practices, including demos and test scripts.
  • Knowledge of key integration points between SAP modules.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, including teamwork and facilitation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present and discuss strategies and technical information in a manner that builds rapport and supports understanding among both technical and non‑technical audiences.
  • Ability to analyze problems and provide clear recommendations.
  • Strong organizational skills.

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience with SAP ECC or S/4HANA for the federal government.
  • Experience in integration, configuration, and implementation of SAP application areas such as Sales and Distribution (SD), Materials Management (MM), Financial/Cost Accounting (FICO), and/or Funds Management (FM).

CGI is required by law in some jurisdictions to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. The determination of this range includes various factors not limited to skill set, level, experience, relevant training, and licensure and certifications. To support the ability to reward for merit-based performance, CGI typically does not hire individuals at or near the top of the range for their role. Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range for this role in the U.S. is $70,800.00 - $172,400.00.

CGI Federal's benefits are offered to eligible professionals on their first day of employment to include:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Comprehensive insurance options
  • Matching contributions through the 401(k) plan and the share purchase plan
  • Paid time off for vacation, holidays and sick time
  • Paid parental leave
  • Learning opportunities and tuition assistance
  • Wellness and well-being programs

Job Description

Must Have Technical/Functional Skills

  • Deep expertise in complex manufacturing processes, engineering-driven production, and SAP S/4HANA Manufacturing capabilities, with hands-on experience implementing SAP DM in Engineer-to-Order (ETO), Make-to-Order (MTO), Make-to-Stock or complex process & discrete based manufacturing environments.
  • Experience with RISE with SAP transformation programs.
  • Experience of Working in Global template deployment projects
  • Strong understanding of: Cloud Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), production automation, and integrating these systems with SAP's core ERP modules
  • Experience of project execution using Agile or Agile-Hybrid methodology
  • Create technical and functional specifications for custom developments (RICEFW) to meet specific business needs.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Drive solution design and discovery with business stakeholders.
  • Define scalable manufacturing and engineering process architecture aligned with SAP Best Practices and RISE with SAP standards.
  • Conduct Fit-to-Standard workshops and identify process gaps, enhancements, and optimization opportunities.
  • Provide leadership for manufacturing transformation initiatives across engineering, production, quality, and supply chain.
  • Configure and implement SAP Digital Manufacturing capabilities including Manufacturing BOMs, Routings and work instructions, Shop floor execution, Production versions
  • Support migration from legacy manufacturing systems to S/4HANA.
  • Define master data governance standards for manufacturing objects. Lead implementation project from blueprinting through testing (Unit, SIT, UAT), cutover, Go-Live, and hyper-care support.
  • Advise clients as a trusted advisor on best practices for manufacturing, particularly regarding production sequencing, constraint management, and manufacturing efficiencies.

Generic Managerial Skills, If any

  • Lead workshops and discovery sessions with business stakeholders, solution architects, and cross-functional SAP teams
  • Translate business transformation objectives into integrated solution design decisions
  • Coordinate with testing, data migration, and legacy system teams
  • Manage issue triage, impact analysis, prioritization, and closure for defects
  • Communicate risks, dependencies, design decisions, and status clearly to program leadership
  • Prepare and review functional documentation, configuration rationale, and training content
  • Support knowledge transfer and adoption of standardized S/4HANA processes

Deloitte's Emerging ERP Solutions-Workday teams are market leaders working with clients across industries to deliver transformational solutions optimized for their unique business needs.

Recruiting for this role ends on 4/1/2026

Work you'll do

As a Workday Supply Chain Management Sr Consultant, you will lead project workstreams, identify and document business requirements, provide functional design, prototyping (including scenario design, flow mapping), testing, user training, defining support procedures. Additional duties may include: coordination of schedules, creation of documentation and collateral, creation and execution of test / use cases, configuration of Workday software, assisting with prioritization and sequencing of the workstream's efforts and assisting project leadership as required.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of consulting or industry experience in Workday SCM/ERP finance domain
  • 2+ years of experience leading SCM workstreams as well as project teams
  • Workday SCM Professional certification or capability to obtain upon joining
  • A minimum of 1 full life cycle Workday SCM implementation
  • Demonstrated knowledge in some combination of the following: Procure-to-Pay (PTP), Order-to-Cash (OTC)
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Bachelor's Degree or 8 years equivalent professional experience
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred

  • An advanced degree in the area of specialization
  • Functional knowledge around SCM systems and processes.
  • Experience defining systems strategy, developing systems requirements, designing and prototyping, testing, training, defining support procedures, and implementing practical business solutions under multiple deadlines Ability to work independently, manage small engagements or parts of large engagements
  • Experience as a lead and mentor to junior staff
  • Presentation skills (MS Visio, MS PowerPoint)

Wages + Salary

The Emerging ERP Solutions practice is all about bringing you the best in cloud-based ERP applications like Workday and Infor. We're here to help transform finance and supply-chain processes, making them more efficient and cost-effective. Our teams use Deloitte's vast expertise to deliver lasting results for our clients. By working closely with CFOs, CIOs, and Business Unit leaders, we provide valuable business transformation and continuous support across various industries.

If you're seeking an exciting career with plenty of opportunities, consider joining us at Deloitte. We work on projects involving Workday Financials, Supply Chain Management, Infor Solutions, Microsoft Dynamics, and Sustainability Technology and Strategy. With such a variety of areas to explore, you'll have the chance to make a real impact while growing in your career. Come be part of a team that values innovation and strives for excellence. Apply now and let's achieve great things together!

Deloitte's Emerging ERP Solutions-Workday teams are market leaders working with clients across industries to deliver transformational solutions optimized for their unique business needs.

Recruiting for this role ends on 4/1/2026

Work you'll do

As a Workday Supply Chain Management Sr Consultant, you will lead project workstreams, identify and document business requirements, provide functional design, prototyping (including scenario design, flow mapping), testing, user training, defining support procedures. Additional duties may include: coordination of schedules, creation of documentation and collateral, creation and execution of test / use cases, configuration of Workday software, assisting with prioritization and sequencing of the workstream's efforts and assisting project leadership as required.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of consulting or industry experience in Workday SCM/ERP finance domain
  • 2+ years of experience leading SCM workstreams as well as project teams
  • Workday SCM Professional certification or capability to obtain upon joining
  • A minimum of 1 full life cycle Workday SCM implementation
  • Demonstrated knowledge in some combination of the following: Procure-to-Pay (PTP), Order-to-Cash (OTC)
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Bachelor's Degree or 8 years equivalent professional experience
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred

  • An advanced degree in the area of specialization
  • Functional knowledge around SCM systems and processes.
  • Experience defining systems strategy, developing systems requirements, designing and prototyping, testing, training, defining support procedures, and implementing practical business solutions under multiple deadlines Ability to work independently, manage small engagements or parts of large engagements
  • Experience as a lead and mentor to junior staff
  • Presentation skills (MS Visio, MS PowerPoint)

Wages + Salary

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $116,000 to $229,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance

descriptionHtml:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

The Senior SAP PTP/ MM Consultant will be responsible for leading the design, configuration, implementation, testing, data migration, cutover, and post-go-live support of SAP Purchasing (PTP) and Materials Management (MM) solutions within SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud.

This role requires strong functional and hands-on configuration expertise, a deep understanding of purchasing and inventory management business processes, and the ability to translate client requirements into scalable solutions aligned with SAP Best Practices and the Fit-to-Standard approach.

The consultant will take ownership of end-to-end solution delivery, ensuring that SAP purchasing, materials, and inventory management processes are effectively integrated with other functional areas, meet client business objectives, and are delivered on time and to the highest quality standards.

The successful candidate will work across multiple industries, collaborating closely with client stakeholders, solution architects, and cross-functional project teams throughout the SAP implementation lifecycle, following the SAP Activate methodology.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Implementation: Lead the design, configuration, implementation, testing, data migration, cutover, and post-go-live support of SAP Purchasing (PTP) and Materials Management (MM) solutions in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud.
  • SAP Best Practices and Fit-to-Standard: Apply SAP Best Practices and follow the SAP Activate methodology, emphasizing the Fit-to-Standard approach and minimizing unnecessary customizations and extensions.
  • Business Process Analysis and Solution Design: Analyze clients' purchasing, materials, and inventory management processes. Translate business requirements into effective SAP solutions aligned with business objectives and industry best practices.
  • Hands-On System Configuration: Independently configure and validate SAP PTP/ MM functionality within SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, including Material Master management.
  • Cross-Functional Integration: Ensure seamless integration of SAP PTP/ MM processes with other functional areas, including Production Planning (PP), Sales and Distribution (SD), Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), and Finance/Controlling (FI/CO).
  • Testing and Quality Assurance: Develop and execute functional and integration test scenarios, support System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), troubleshoot issues, and ensure solutions meet business and functional requirements.
  • Data Migration and Cutover: Guide purchasing and inventory management-related master data migration, including data validation and reconciliation. Plan and execute SAP PTP/ MM cutover activities to ensure successful system deployment.
  • Client Collaboration and Advisory: Work closely with client business stakeholders, IT teams, and project leadership to provide expert functional guidance, resolve design challenges, and drive timely decisions.
  • Documentation and Knowledge Transfer: Prepare and maintain functional design documents, configuration documentation, business process flows, test scripts, and training materials. Conduct knowledge transfer and support end-user training.
  • Post-Go-Live Support: Provide hyper- care and production support, resolve functional issues, and recommend process improvements to optimize SAP purchasing and inventory management operations. Project Delivery Accountability: Take ownership of assigned PTP/ MM deliverables, proactively identify and escalate risks, coordinate dependencies with other workstreams, and ensure high-quality, on-time delivery in accordance with project plans and commitments.

This job can be performed from anywhere in the US.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Experience: Proven hands-on experience implementing and configuring SAP PTP/ MM solutions in SAP S/4HANA, with direct implementation experience in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud.
  • Functional Expertise: Strong functional knowledge of SAP Material management covering areas like materials and supplier master data, Sourcing and supplier selection, Request for Price, Purchase requisitions, Purchasing contracts and Scheduling Agreements, Purchase Order management, consumable purchasing, Service Procurement, subcontracting, Supplier consignment, goods receipt and supplier returns, batch management, Supplier evaluation and performance monitoring, Intercompany stock transfer/Advanced Intercompany Stock transfer, Invoice management, reporting and monitoring for procurement, Core Inventory management, physical inventory and cycle counting.
  • Hands-On Configuration: Demonstrated ability to independently configure, test, troubleshoot, and support SAP PTP/ MM functionality, preferably using SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud configuration tools and capabilities.
  • Implementation Methodology: Proven experience with SAP Activate methodology, including leading Fit-to-Standard workshops, identifying process gaps, and designing solutions aligned with SAP Best Practices.
  • Cross-Functional Integration: Solid understanding of SAP PTP/ MM integration with Production Planning (PP), Sales and Distribution (SD), Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), and Finance/Controlling (FI/CO).
  • Data Migration and Cutover: Practical experience with purchasing, materials, and inventory management-related master data migration, data validation, reconciliation, and execution of system cutover activities.
  • Testing and Deployment: Experience preparing and executing functional and integration testing, supporting SIT/UAT, resolving defects, and providing post-go-live hyper-care support.
  • Business Process Knowledge: Strong understanding of purchasing, materials, and inventory management business processes, with the ability to translate business requirements into practical SAP solutions.
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical capabilities and demonstrated ability to independently investigate functional issues, identify root causes, and develop effective solutions.
  • Communication and Consulting Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to lead client discussions, explain SAP solutions, and effectively collaborate with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Delivery and Accountability: Proven ability to independently manage assigned deliverables, prioritize competing tasks, meet project deadlines, and proactively communicate risks and issues.
  • Teamwork and Quality: Ability to work effectively both independently and within cross-functional, globally distributed teams, with strong attention to detail and commitment to high- quality project delivery.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Participation in at least three full-cycle SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation, preferably with direct responsibility for PTP/ MM configuration and deployment.
  • Experience workflow management.
  • Familiarity with SAP Cloud ALM for managing project deliverables, requirements, testing, and defects.
  • Experience with purchasing and inventory management-related SAP Fiori applications, SAP Central Business Configuration (CBC), and Public Cloud extensibility concepts.
  • SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition certification in Purchasing or a related functional area.

Job Description

General Motors is undergoing a major transformation, both in how we operate and in how we will influence the future of transportation. Our Software Services team is on the forefront of this work, emboldening our culture by seeking out determined, innovative individuals who will join our team to help move us forward and achieve our mission.

The General Motors Global IT Organization is seeking to identify highly motivated and qualified individuals for potential future opportunities as a Senior Systems Configurator - SAP Functional Analyst to design, configure, and support SAP solutions that enable our end-to-end value chain across:

  • Source-to-Deliver / Source-to-Pay (Supply Chain & Direct Material Sourcing and Procurement for Automotive)
  • Make-to-Ship (Manufacturing & Plant Operations)
  • Order-to-Delivery (Order Management & Distribution)


This requisition is intentionally broad across SAP specialties, including but not limited to SD, FI-CO, MM, PP, WM, EWM, Ariba Direct Material Sourcing and Procurement for Automotive, and S/4HANA. You do not need experience in all of the areas listed; we are seeking strong SAP talent across one or more of these modules and encourage candidates to apply even if their expertise is focused in specific domains.

Location: Warren, MI or Austin, TX

The Role

As an SAP Functional Analyst, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams in Product Lifecycle Management, Global Purchasing & Supply Chain (GPSC), Manufacturing, Logistics, and Order Management to gather requirements and to design, configure, and support SAP solutions that meet business needs across the Source-to-Deliver, Make-to-Ship, and Order-to-Delivery spaces. You will implement scalable SAP processes, ensure solutions align with industry best practices and GM’s IT Solution Delivery Methodology, optimize business operations, support and extend SAP modules, drive process improvements through automation and standardization, and help design and build new SAP-based landscapes that transform how work is done today. You will:

  • Translate business needs into robust, integrated SAP configurations and functional designs.
  • Optimize business operations in areas such as Order Management, Pricing, Billing, Supply Chain, Logistics, Direct Material Sourcing & Procurement, Purchasing, Production Planning & Execution, Warehousing, and Master Data.
  • Support GM’s journey to S/4HANA and SaaS-first solutions, helping rationalize and modernize the SAP and surrounding application landscape.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead SAP configuration and solution design for core business processes such as Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Production Planning & Execution, and related workflows.
  • Oversee financial postings, cost allocations, and supplier collaboration as they relate to your SAP functional domains.
  • Support sourcing, procurement, supplier management, production planning, logistics, inventory control, warehouse management, and goods movement processes.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, analysts, and technical teams to gather requirements and deliver SAP solutions that are scalable, secure, and aligned with GM standards.
  • Participate in testing, validation, and deployment of SAP enhancements and new functionalities; ensure strong end-to-end process validation.
  • Support integration of SAP with external systems, partnering with integration and infrastructure teams.
  • Help evaluate and rationalize the existing manufacturing, supply chain, and order management application landscape, determining which solutions are integrated with, absorbed into, or retired in favor of SAP S/4HANA and related SAP SaaS solutions.
  • Participate in SAP upgrades, migrations, and digital transformation initiatives, including S/4HANA and cloud/SaaS adoption.
  • Apply standard SAP functionality to meet business needs, minimizing custom development while still addressing critical gaps via RICEFW objects.
  • Contribute to application management and production support, including issue triage, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement in your functional areas.
  • Create and maintain process documentation, configuration guides, and training materials to support adoption and reuse.
  • Mentor junior team members and promote best practices in SAP solution delivery, testing, and operations.
  • Adhere to organizational IT standards, security protocols, and industry best practices, including relevant regulatory and internal control requirements.


Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Computing, Information Systems, Supply Chain) or equivalent experience.
  • Several years of hands-on SAP experience, including configuration of one or more relevant modules, for example:
  • SD Order Management, Pricing, Billing, Order-to-Cash.
  • FI-CO integration with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, or Order Management.
  • MM, WM, EWM procurement, inventory, warehouse, and logistics execution.
  • PP / Manufacturing production planning and execution, plan-to-produce.
  • DMe/DMC SAP Digital Manufacturing or other digital manufacturing solutions, and integration with plant-floor and logistics systems.
  • Ariba Direct Material Sourcing and Procurement for Automotive.
  • S/4HANA functional configuration and extensibility.
  • Strong understanding of SAP principles and extensibility approaches, including how to design upgrade-safe, cloud-compliant solutions.
  • Solid business process knowledge in areas such as Order Management, Pricing, Billing, Supply Chain, Logistics, Direct Material Sourcing & Procurement, Purchasing, Production Planning, Warehousing, and Master Data.
  • Experience supporting integration with other SAP modules and external systems, including familiarity with common interface technologies (e.g., IDocs, APIs, middleware).
  • Familiarity with software testing, automation, and quality assurance practices; ability to define and execute test plans and support automated/regression testing.
  • Ability to debug and analyze SAP systems, preferably with some ABAP knowledge to support issue analysis and collaboration with development teams.
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured approach to diagnosing issues and proposing options.
  • Strong commitment to continuous improvement, teamwork, and integrity, including willingness to learn new SAP and cloud capabilities.


What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • SAP certification in one or more relevant modules (e.g., SD, MM, PP, WM/EWM, FI-CO, Ariba, S/4HANA).
  • Experience with SAP Automotive Suite or similar industry-specific solutions supporting OEMs, suppliers, or complex manufacturing.
  • Familiarity with the SAP Integrated Tool Chain – including Signavio (process modeling), SAP Cloud ALM (CALM), and Tricentis (Tosca) – as well as SAP Fiori and SAP BTP, especially for cloud-based SAP extensions and integrations.
  • Exposure to SAP AI / analytics capabilities and apply analytics/AI in manufacturing, supply chain, or order management use cases.
  • Experience with EDI transaction sets (ANSI X12, EDIFACT) and related communication protocols, and/or other integration platforms (e.g., SAP PI/PO, SAP Integration Suite, Sterling, Connect Direct).
  • Background working with manufacturers, suppliers, or service providers, ideally in automotive or complex discrete manufacturing environments.
  • Prior consulting experience or working with global stakeholder groups, including experience in regulated environments (e.g., SOX, internal controls, legal/tax requirements).


Hybrid: This role is categorized as hybrid. The successful candidate is expected to report to Warren, MI or Austin, TX, three times per week, at minimum, or as dictated by business needs.

This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the selected candidate is expected to report to a specific location at least 3 times a week {or other frequency dictated by their manager}. Relocation benefits are available for candidates who qualify under company policy.

Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all.

General Motors is committed to being a workplace that is not only free of unlawful discrimination, but one that genuinely fosters inclusion and belonging. We encourage interested candidates to review the key responsibilities and qualifications for each role and apply for any positions that match their skills and capabilities. Applicants in the recruitment process may be required, where applicable, to successfully complete a role-related assessment(s) and/or a pre-employment screening prior to beginning employment. descriptionHtml:
Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

Job Description:

What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

About The Team

Crowe’s NetSuite consulting practice helps organizations transform their finance and operational systems through the implementation and optimization of Oracle NetSuite ERP, a leading cloud-based enterprise resource planning platform. Our team works with clients across a range of industries to design, implement, and support scalable ERP solutions that improve financial visibility, streamline operations, and enable data-driven decision-making.

Our professionals combine deep accounting and operational expertise with technical NetSuite capabilities—including financial modules, workflows, reporting, integrations, and automation—to deliver end-to-end implementations and process improvements. As part of our growing consulting practice, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions that help organizations modernize their finance functions and support long-term growth.

About The Role

Crowe seeks a NetSuite Implementation Senior Consultant to support ERP implementations for Manufacturing and Distribution clients. This role works directly with clients and project teams throughout implementation engagements, helping translate business requirements into effective NetSuite solutions. You will contribute across the full implementation lifecycle, including discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.

The ideal candidate combines ERP consulting experience with strong NetSuite functional knowledge and an understanding of supply chain processes. Experience supporting manufacturing operations, inventory management, supply chain, order management, and related business processes is highly valued.

This role requires strong client-facing and problem-solving skills, along with the ability to manage key project responsibilities and deliver high-quality work with limited oversight. You will collaborate with client stakeholders across finance, operations, supply chain, warehouse, and production teams to understand business needs, configure solutions, and support successful implementations. Together with Crowe’s project teams, you will help design scalable NetSuite solutions that improve operational efficiency, streamline processes, and enhance inventory visibility.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead NetSuite solution design across all core and advanced modules (Financials, Advanced Inventory, WMS, Advanced Manufacturing), ensuring business needs are met through scalable configuration and best-fit system architecture.
  • Own functional configuration of NetSuite, including workflows, saved searches, dashboards, custom forms, roles, and permissions – without performing hands-on coding, but with a strong understanding of SuiteScript, Suitelets, and SuiteCloud architecture to guide technical teams effectively.
  • Collaborate with integration leads to design and validate data flows and interface architecture between NetSuite and external systems, including field mapping, API methods (SuiteTalk/RESTlet), and middleware approaches (e.g., Celigo, Boomi).
  • Evaluate and recommend solution approaches (standard vs. custom vs. SuiteApp) during design workshops and RTM reviews, balancing implementation speed, cost, and long-term maintainability.
  • Support the development of Functional Design Documents (FDDs) and ensure alignment between functional requirements, system design, and technical specifications throughout the build lifecycle.
  • Act as a solutioning lead during Design Phase, partnering with functional consultants to drive business process mapping, gap-fit assessments, and solution documentation aligned to PE-backed client scaling needs.
  • Provide configuration oversight and quality assurance, reviewing proposed scripts, workflows, custom records, and data models for adherence to Crowe and NetSuite standards.
  • Serve as a cross-functional escalation point for architecture or solution design decisions, ensuring technical feasibility and stakeholder alignment across workstreams.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, Supply Chain, Engineering, or related field
  • NetSuite Certifications – Suite Foundations, Administrator and ERP Consultant required.

Experience:

  • 4+ years of NetSuite experience with a focus on solution design, module architecture, or technical oversight roles.
  • Prior experience in multi-entity, multi-currency, or fast-scaling environments.
  • Strong expertise across core modules (GL, AR/AP, Procurement, Inventory, Fulfillment, Manufacturing).

Proficiencies:

  • Deep knowledge of NetSuite Advanced Modules: Advanced Inventory Management, Warehouse Management System (WMS), Advanced Manufacturing.
  • Understanding of NetSuite’s platform architecture including SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, SuiteTalk, and Suite Analytics.
  • Ability to read, review, and advise on SuiteScript 2.x design patterns and SuiteCloud development best practices.
  • Familiarity with 3rd-party integration frameworks, connector platforms (e.g., Celigo, Boomi), and data mapping processes.
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., prompt engineering, low-code development tools) is a plus.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Systems thinking with an ability to architect holistic ERP + integration solutions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to articulate technical decisions to functional and non-technical audiences
  • Ability to lead and influence both Crowe implementation teams and client stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated and detail-oriented with strong organizational and documentation skills.

Must Have Technical/Functional Skills

  • Deep expertise in complex manufacturing processes, engineering-driven production, and SAP S/4HANA Manufacturing capabilities, with hands-on experience implementing SAP DM in Engineer-to-Order (ETO), Make-to-Order (MTO), Make-to-Stock or complex process & discrete based manufacturing environments.
  • Experience with RISE with SAP transformation programs.
  • Experience of Working in Global template deployment projects
  • Strong understanding of: Cloud Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), production automation, and integrating these systems with SAP's core ERP modules
  • Experience of project execution using Agile or Agile-Hybrid methodology
  • Create technical and functional specifications for custom developments (RICEFW) to meet specific business needs.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Drive solution design and discovery with business stakeholders.

  • Conduct Fit-to-Standard workshops and identify process gaps, enhancements, and optimization opportunities.
  • Provide leadership for manufacturing transformation initiatives across engineering, production, quality, and supply chain.
  • Configure and implement SAP Digital Manufacturing capabilities including Manufacturing BOMs, Routings and work instructions, Shop floor execution, Production versions
  • Support migration from legacy manufacturing systems to S/4HANA.

Generic Managerial Skills, If any

Infosys is seeking a Principal SAP EWM Enterprise Applications Consultant

As a Principal Enterprise Applications SAP EWM consultant, you will be a expert contributing to different phases of the consulting lifecycle. You will be intensely involved in business process consulting; you will define the problem, propose and create the solution. You will also play an important role in the development, configuration and deployment of the overall solution. You will guide teams on project processes, deliverables and contribute to the proposal development, client training and internal capability building and help detail the project scope. You will have the opportunity to shape value-adding consulting solutions that enable our clients to meet the changing needs of the global landscape.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.
  • At least 11 years of experience with Information Technology.
  • Location for this position is Orlando, FL. This position may require travel and/or relocation.
  • All applicants authorized to work in the United States are encouraged to apply.

Preferred Qualifications

  • At least 11 years of experience in SAP EWM Skills
  • At least 2 end to end life cycle implementation / roll outs in S4 HANA in EWM process area
  • Should have at least two-three end to end implementation projects and at least one where performed as Solution Architect preferably at client location. Experience in multiple, full lifecycle SAP EWM project implementations
  • Must have experience in integration of EWM with automated warehouse – inbound and outbound processes, ASRS integration, AGV and MiR integration
  • Must have experience in integration of EWM with Manufacturing and Quality Management modules
  • Must have good knowledge in following IM areas: Inventory Management, Stock transfers, Special stocks, Stock types, Physical Inventory, Account Determination and Valuation

  • Must have good knowledge in following EWM areas: Integration with ECC, Inbound Processing Outbound Processing, Physical Inventory, RF Transactions, HU Management, Transportation Units, Production Integration
  • Good Knowledge in integration aspects with other modules SD, MM, PP, Manufacturing and QM
  • Good understanding of business processes in the life sciences / pharmaceutical domain.
  • Ability to understand business requirements from business users and prepare requirement document, functional specifications.
  • Good understanding of GXP and SOX requirements. Should have working experience in a highly regulated environment.
  • Should be aware of release governance processes and have experience in working on any incident management tool and testing tool
  • Handled post go live critical issue resolving till stabilization.
  • Must have an experience working in an environment utilizing number of non ECC systems like MES, WES using interfaces such as PI, ALE etc.
  • Basic understanding of custom code along with basic debugging skills.
  • Knowledge of S/4 HANA simplifications in logistics area will be an added advantage.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate at all levels of the business.
  • Strong leadership skills. Ability to lead team in resolving complex issues in a fast pace and challenging environment.
  • Analytical and Communication skills
  • Experience with project management
  • High Impact communication with senior stakeholders

The job entails sitting as well as working at a computer for extended periods of time. Should be able to communicate by telephone, email or face to face. Travel may be required as per the job requirements.

Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off

descriptionHtml:
At Gerdau, we empower our people to grow, thrive, and make a difference—together. With a culture built on trust and teamwork, we offer meaningful work, continuous development, and opportunities to shape your future. We invite you to come work with us, where your contributions are valued, your voice is heard, and your career is forged with purpose

Your Contribution

  • Act as an SAP architect and a catalyst of digital transformation to increase business agility and enable the strategy of the company, as well as the key liaison for his/her functional globally
  • Lead and collaborate with the development of best practices, guiding principles, solutions architecture, and roadmaps
  • Serve as a subject matter expert working with business processes peers solving problems, advising on various complex business-related issues
  • Advise and drive the use of technology to streamline business processes
  • Collaborate with leadership to develop ideas and solutions to present to business processes peers
  • Analyze, gather requirements, design business processes, define functional specifications, and configure solutions to improve efficiency and reduce costs
  • Configure, develop, and implement SAP systems, and smoothly integrate SAP applications with existing IT business solutions
  • Prepare test plan, test scripts for system testing, and functional testing, and implement the plan, as well as support for activities related to data conversion and resolve issues
  • Provide SAP system support, end-user training, and document SAP processes
  • Leads the analysis of the current technology environment to detect critical deficiencies, legacy and technical debt, and recommends solutions for improvement
  • Participate in projects as an SAP expert
  • Lead functional areas within projects and/or lead implementation projects
  • Keep abreast of the latest SAP offerings, updates, and developments
  • Work with Digital IT service providers to provide support to users, to deliver applications enhancements and on project activities
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with business peers to gain their active support for the transformation agenda
  • Support leadership in developing and implementing Digital IT roadmaps, such as projects and enhancement
  • Develop solution concepts and business cases for new investments
  • Coaches, mentors and collaborates with technical subject matter experts and peers to develop technology architecture that enables and drives new business capabilities and operating models

Your Expertise

  • Customer-Centric – Focus efforts to ensure internal and external customers thrive
  • Communication and Persuasion – Possess solid communication and persuasion skills essential to success in this position. You will represent the Digital IT group effectively and employ negotiation skills that build organizational consensus around a specific course of action while identifying communication barriers and taking action to facilitate mutual understanding.
  • Business Acumen – Acknowledge the impact of your actions in local and global contexts while working to generate sustainable value (economic, social, and environmental) for the organization. In addition, you should understand basic business processes and possess the ability to identify and develop workflows and process maps for continual improvement and waste elimination within the business.
  • Technical Expertise – Understand all IT functions, cloud technologies, and services in use, and become familiar with the current direction in the infrastructure market
  • Strategic Thinking and Vision – Possess a clear sense of the direction of the organization and understand what will create a competitive advantage for the business in the future. Distinguish tactical issues from strategic ones and take action while effectively translating strategic imperatives at the macro level into initiatives and priorities.
  • Simplistic Agility – Foster simplicity and agility to focus on what adds value while resolving issues
  • Global Perspective – Ability to successfully operate in a global IT organization bringing perspective to daily work while leveraging relationships, expertise, and opportunities across borders taking the company’s strategy and priorities into consideration.
  • Accountability – Take initiative and assume personal accountability and ownership for goals, outcomes, and deadlines holding others accountable for achieving individual and organizational objectives.
  • Analysis – Possess critical thinking ability and deal systematically with input from a variety of sources to suggest alternative approaches to unfamiliar situations or concepts, as well as strong analytical skills, including an understanding of business economics and financial resources.
  • Supplier Management – Possess the ability to engage and manage suppliers as needed for discovery, modeling, implementation, and support.

Your Credentials

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience
  • 8 years of SAP experience
  • SAP certifications preferred
  • Extensive SAP (module-specific) knowledge
  • Experience with full-cycle SAP implementations preferred
  • Knowledge of IT processes, IT functions (development, infrastructure, security, governance), and technology (cloud, big data, architecture, APIs)
  • Knowledge of Agile, Project Management, and Innovation processes
  • Ability to work with teams in Application Managed Services (AMS) environment driving engagement with an ownership mindset
  • Ability to document SAP processes
  • Experience leading projects
  • Understanding of business processes and best practices to provide effective solutions

Your Specific Credentials

  • Strong SAP FI/CO experience, especially CO, Material Ledger, Product Costing (CO-PC)), and month-end closing.
  • Functional knowledge of SAP bank integrations, payment file processing, and EDI, with the ability to analyze issues and coordinate solutions with technical specialists supporting integration platforms.
  • Knowledge of integration with PP, MM, and SD.
  • Experience with SAP implementations or rollouts.
  • Strong communication, ownership, and the ability to lead initiatives with business teams, IT, and partners.
  • VIM and Vertex knowledge as additional advantages.Desirable knowledge of SAP Materials Management (MM) impacting production processes

As a global company headquartered in Pune, India, we are active in more than 27 countries around the world, steered by 12500+ innovators who are making #EngineeringABetterWorld a reality - every day for everyone.

SAP FI Functional Consultant

Location: Shelbyville, TN-Onsite


Position Summary


We are seeking an experienced SAP FI Functional Consultant with 8–10 years of hands-on SAP implementation and support experience. The consultant will participate in a large-scale legacy ERP to SAP ECC 6.0 transformation program, working closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, technical teams and system integrators. Candidates with prior IFS ERP to SAP migration experience are highly preferred. Automotive manufacturing experience is considered a strong advantage.


Key Responsibilities


Module Expertise

General Ledger, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Tax and Financial Closing.


Required Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of SAP functional consulting experience.
  • Minimum two full lifecycle SAP implementation projects.
  • Experience with legacy ERP to SAP migration projects.
  • Strong experience in business process mapping and solution design.
  • Excellent stakeholder communication and documentation skills.
  • Experience supporting data migration, cutover and hypercare.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems or related discipline.


Preferred Qualifications

IFS ERP to SAP migration experience.

Automotive manufacturing industry experience.

SAP ECC 6.0 experience; S/4HANA exposure is beneficial.

SAP certification is an advantage.


Work Location & Travel

This position is primarily onsite at the client location during key phases of the project, including design workshops, testing, cutover and go-live activities. Candidates should be comfortable working in a collaborative onsite environment. Minor travel (approximately 10–20%) may be required for workshops, project meetings, testing support or deployment activities.

Job Summary

 JOB DESCRIPTION

BDO Digital, LLC., a wholly owned subsidiary of BDO USA, P.C., is a rapidly growing digital advisory organization dedicated to helping middle-market organizations capture the full power of technology, adapt to disruption, increase operational efficiencies, improve risk management effectiveness, and uncover new sources of revenue. Our collaborative, cross-disciplinary team is comprised of digital strategists, systems integrators, data scientists, software developers, change management professionals, and industry-specific advisors who work together to solve clients’ immediate digital needs and unearth new opportunities to drive competitive advantage. Our goal is to help our clients become faster, smarter, and more resilient to change.

To support our double-digit growth goals, BDO Digital seeks a manager who will be part of an Enterprise Business Applications (EBA) team supporting projects in the areas of EBA strategy and implementation, in addition to Business Transformation and Operational Excellence efforts. This role will conduct discovery, requirements gathering, process documentation, configuration, and implementation management of ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning), CRM (Customer Relationship Management), HCM (Human Capital Management) and other related business applications functioning as a key resource for our clients spanning, finance, product distribution, manufacturing, job costing, field service, sales, marketing, service, and reporting.

Job Duties

  • Strategy, Requirements & Selection:
    • Participates in defining needs for existing and new EBA solutions
    • Documents existing enterprise business applications, related business processes, and personas impacted
    • Identifies existing inefficiencies, potential improvement opportunities, and critical differentiating business requirements
    • Envisions and develops representations of recommended future state options for evaluation by clients
    • Understands related security structures and best practices
    • Designs and develops scorecards for evaluation of candidate business applications
    • Creates dashboard presentations of quantitative and qualitative scoring of candidate options
    • Supports Technical Leads, Developers and Managers by providing functional clarifications and setting expectations with team and client
  • Solution Functional Design:
    • Performs functional (business process) solution design in business applications (ERP, HCM, CRM, & related) contexts, to provide maximized business value and deliver strong business agility while meeting applicable requirements and constraints
  • Consulting:
    • Gains a deep understanding of client needs, analyzes best practices, and plays an integral part in defining and proposing business value solutions that meet or exceed client expectations
  • Program & Project Management:
    • Supports, and manages aspects of business applications implementations
    • Documents and maintains project milestones, phases, elements, and budget
    • Monitors project progress by tracking risks, actions, issues, decisions, and other activities
    • Develops references for users by writing and maintaining user documentation; providing help desk support; training users
  • Implementation and Support:
    • Provides functional support of EBA solutions and related technologies
    • Manages and resolves issues, defects, and change requests
    • Manages and performs systems configuration tasks (but not coding/development) for process workstreams as directed
    • Provides ongoing support during project implementations and post-go-live support
    • Responsible for configuration of solution based on requirements
  • Fosters a positive demeanor, learning attitude and client service mentality with the team
  • Travel – up to 25%, as needed
  • Other duties, as required

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Owns and drives completion of key workstreams as directed by project leaders
  • Manages project workstreams as directed
  • Mentors and develops entry level consultants and senior consultants


Education

Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Bachelor’s Degree and six (6) or more years of industry experience with ERP systems, required; OR
  • High School Diploma/GED and seven (7) or more years of industry experience with ERP systems, required


Experience

  • Six (6) or more years of business process analysis and/or business application education or experience, required
  • Four (4) or more years of education or experience with ERP or CRM Product, required
  • Some client facing best practice consulting experience, preferred


License/Certifications

  • One or more current business applications technology certifications, preferred


Software

  • Microsoft Visio, PowerPoint, Word, and SharePoint, required
  • Experience with one or more ERP/CRM/HCM Solutions technology, required:
    • Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365), CRM, Business Central, F&SCM), Ceridian Dayforce Solutions (Talent & Benefits Intelligence, Workforce Management (WFM), HR, Advanced HR Analytics, or Payroll), Salesforce, Oracle NetSuite, Acumatica, SAP, Infor, Sage, Syteline, JDE, IFS, or any other ERP/CRM Software
  • Smartsheet, preferred
  • Enterprise software strategy, selection, and implementation experience, preferred

Other Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong analytical, problem solving, facilitation, documentation, and communication skills
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, both verbal and written
  • Excellent interpersonal and customer relationship skills
  • Business process analysis, design, and process flow skills
  • Excels at operating in a fast-paced technical environment


Keywords

Salesforce, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Business Central, Microsoft Dynamics Business Central, Microsoft Dynamics Finance & Operations, Dynamics F&O, Microsoft Finance and Supply Chain Management, Microsoft F&SCM, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dynamics 365 CRM, Microsoft Customer Experience Platform, Business Analyst, BA, Enterprise Tester, Requirements Gathering, User Experience, User Enablement, Data Visualization, Software, Definition, Custom Applications, Data Analytics, Cloud Strategy, SharePoint, Office 365, O365, SFDC, D365, Acumatica, NetSuite. At BDO, how we show up matters. We build strong relationships by supporting one another, our clients, and our communities with care, curiosity, and a commitment to helping one another grow and succeed. Here, you’ll find meaningful work, leaders invested in your success, and opportunities to build a career around what matters most to you.

Our purpose is to be the people our clients count on to grow with confidence and achieve what matters most. Our values guide how we bring that purpose to life each day. Together, they shape how we work with one another, serve our clients, and create meaningful impact.

descriptionHtml:
The Emerging ERP Solutions practice is all about bringing you the best in cloud-based ERP applications like Workday and Infor. We're here to help transform finance and supply-chain processes, making them more efficient and cost-effective. Our teams use Deloitte's vast expertise to deliver lasting results for our clients. By working closely with CFOs, CIOs, and Business Unit leaders, we provide valuable business transformation and continuous support across various industries.

If you're seeking an exciting career with plenty of opportunities, consider joining us at Deloitte. We work on projects involving Workday Financials, Supply Chain Management, Infor Solutions, Microsoft Dynamics, and Sustainability Technology and Strategy. With such a variety of areas to explore, you'll have the chance to make a real impact while growing in your career. Come be part of a team that values innovation and strives for excellence. Apply now and let's achieve great things together!

Deloitte's Emerging ERP Solutions-Workday teams are market leaders working with clients across industries to deliver transformational solutions optimized for their unique business needs.

Recruiting for this role ends on 4/1/2026

Work you'll do

As a Workday Supply Chain Management Sr Consultant, you will lead project workstreams, identify and document business requirements, provide functional design, prototyping (including scenario design, flow mapping), testing, user training, defining support procedures. Additional duties may include: coordination of schedules, creation of documentation and collateral, creation and execution of test / use cases, configuration of Workday software, assisting with prioritization and sequencing of the workstream's efforts and assisting project leadership as required.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of consulting or industry experience in Workday SCM/ERP finance domain
  • 2+ years of experience leading SCM workstreams as well as project teams
  • Workday SCM Professional certification or capability to obtain upon joining
  • A minimum of 1 full life cycle Workday SCM implementation
  • Demonstrated knowledge in some combination of the following: Procure-to-Pay (PTP), Order-to-Cash (OTC)
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Bachelor's Degree or 8 years equivalent professional experience
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred

  • An advanced degree in the area of specialization
  • Functional knowledge around SCM systems and processes.
  • Experience defining systems strategy, developing systems requirements, designing and prototyping, testing, training, defining support procedures, and implementing practical business solutions under multiple deadlines Ability to work independently, manage small engagements or parts of large engagements
  • Experience as a lead and mentor to junior staff
  • Presentation skills (MS Visio, MS PowerPoint)

Wages + Salary

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $116,000 to $229,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance

Deloitte is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for people with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the recruiting process, please direct your inquiries to the Global Call Center (GCC) at USTalentCICInbox@deloitte.com.

Information for applicants with a need for accommodation: https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/pages/careers/articles/join-deloitte-assistance-for-disabled-applicants.html

descriptionHtml:
Founded in 1971, Marcus & Millichap (NYSE: MMI) is a premier commercial real estate brokerage firm specializing in investment sales, financing, research, and advisory services. With a national platform spanning 80+ offices across the U.S. and Canada, the firm completed over 8,800 transactions in 2025, with $50.8 billion in sales volume. Our mission is to help our clients create and preserve wealth through exceptional real estate investment expertise and service.

Marcus & Millichap, Inc, the nation’s one of the largest commercial real estate investment brokerage companies (about 80 offices in North America), is looking to hire a highly motivated Oracle Fusion ERP Functional Lead specializing in Order-to-Cash (O2C) & Project Accounting.

The successful candidate will support, enhance, and optimize our Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP environment. This role will serve as the functional subject matter expert for end-to-end O2C and Project-to-Cash processes, including Order Management, Accounts Receivable, Revenue Management, Project Costing, Project Contracts, Project Billing, and Project Revenue Recognition.

The successful candidate will partner with Revenue Accounting, Finance - operations, Accounts Receivable, Cash management, Project Management, IT, and external implementation partners to translate business requirements into scalable Oracle Fusion solutions, drive process improvements, support system enhancements, and strengthen post-go-live operations.

The salary range for this role is $150,000 - $175,000 per year. Actual pay will be determined by factors such as education, experience, and job-related skills relevant to the role. Marcus & Millichap is a multi-state employer and posted salary ranges are provided in good faith for compliance with all relevant pay-transparency regulations. These ranges may not reflect potential compensation for positions based in other states or regions.

Key Responsibilities

Order-to-Cash Functional Leadership

  • Lead functional design, configuration, testing, support, and continuous improvement for Oracle Fusion O2C processes.
  • Support Oracle Fusion modules and capabilities including Order Management, Accounts Receivable, Revenue Management, Collections, Customer Data Management, Pricing, and related billing functions.
