Job Description

General Motors is undergoing a major transformation, both in how we operate and in how we will influence the future of transportation. Our Software Services team is on the forefront of this work, emboldening our culture by seeking out determined, innovative individuals who will join our team to help move us forward and achieve our mission.

The General Motors Global IT Organization is seeking to identify highly motivated and qualified individuals for potential future opportunities as a Senior Systems Configurator - SAP Functional Analyst to design, configure, and support SAP solutions that enable our end-to-end value chain across:

  • Source-to-Deliver / Source-to-Pay (Supply Chain & Direct Material Sourcing and Procurement for Automotive)
  • Make-to-Ship (Manufacturing & Plant Operations)
  • Order-to-Delivery (Order Management & Distribution)


This requisition is intentionally broad across SAP specialties, including but not limited to SD, FI-CO, MM, PP, WM, EWM, Ariba Direct Material Sourcing and Procurement for Automotive, and S/4HANA. You do not need experience in all of the areas listed; we are seeking strong SAP talent across one or more of these modules and encourage candidates to apply even if their expertise is focused in specific domains.

Location: Warren, MI or Austin, TX

The Role

As an SAP Functional Analyst, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams in Product Lifecycle Management, Global Purchasing & Supply Chain (GPSC), Manufacturing, Logistics, and Order Management to gather requirements and to design, configure, and support SAP solutions that meet business needs across the Source-to-Deliver, Make-to-Ship, and Order-to-Delivery spaces. You will implement scalable SAP processes, ensure solutions align with industry best practices and GM’s IT Solution Delivery Methodology, optimize business operations, support and extend SAP modules, drive process improvements through automation and standardization, and help design and build new SAP-based landscapes that transform how work is done today. You will:

  • Translate business needs into robust, integrated SAP configurations and functional designs.
  • Optimize business operations in areas such as Order Management, Pricing, Billing, Supply Chain, Logistics, Direct Material Sourcing & Procurement, Purchasing, Production Planning & Execution, Warehousing, and Master Data.
  • Support GM’s journey to S/4HANA and SaaS-first solutions, helping rationalize and modernize the SAP and surrounding application landscape.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead SAP configuration and solution design for core business processes such as Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Production Planning & Execution, and related workflows.
  • Oversee financial postings, cost allocations, and supplier collaboration as they relate to your SAP functional domains.
  • Support sourcing, procurement, supplier management, production planning, logistics, inventory control, warehouse management, and goods movement processes.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, analysts, and technical teams to gather requirements and deliver SAP solutions that are scalable, secure, and aligned with GM standards.
  • Participate in testing, validation, and deployment of SAP enhancements and new functionalities; ensure strong end-to-end process validation.
  • Support integration of SAP with external systems, partnering with integration and infrastructure teams.
  • Help evaluate and rationalize the existing manufacturing, supply chain, and order management application landscape, determining which solutions are integrated with, absorbed into, or retired in favor of SAP S/4HANA and related SAP SaaS solutions.
  • Participate in SAP upgrades, migrations, and digital transformation initiatives, including S/4HANA and cloud/SaaS adoption.
  • Apply standard SAP functionality to meet business needs, minimizing custom development while still addressing critical gaps via RICEFW objects.
  • Contribute to application management and production support, including issue triage, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement in your functional areas.
  • Create and maintain process documentation, configuration guides, and training materials to support adoption and reuse.
  • Mentor junior team members and promote best practices in SAP solution delivery, testing, and operations.
  • Adhere to organizational IT standards, security protocols, and industry best practices, including relevant regulatory and internal control requirements.


Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Computing, Information Systems, Supply Chain) or equivalent experience.
  • Several years of hands-on SAP experience, including configuration of one or more relevant modules, for example:
  • SD Order Management, Pricing, Billing, Order-to-Cash.
  • FI-CO integration with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, or Order Management.
  • MM, WM, EWM procurement, inventory, warehouse, and logistics execution.
  • PP / Manufacturing production planning and execution, plan-to-produce.
  • DMe/DMC SAP Digital Manufacturing or other digital manufacturing solutions, and integration with plant-floor and logistics systems.
  • Ariba Direct Material Sourcing and Procurement for Automotive.
  • S/4HANA functional configuration and extensibility.
  • Strong understanding of SAP principles and extensibility approaches, including how to design upgrade-safe, cloud-compliant solutions.
  • Solid business process knowledge in areas such as Order Management, Pricing, Billing, Supply Chain, Logistics, Direct Material Sourcing & Procurement, Purchasing, Production Planning, Warehousing, and Master Data.
  • Experience supporting integration with other SAP modules and external systems, including familiarity with common interface technologies (e.g., IDocs, APIs, middleware).
  • Familiarity with software testing, automation, and quality assurance practices; ability to define and execute test plans and support automated/regression testing.
  • Ability to debug and analyze SAP systems, preferably with some ABAP knowledge to support issue analysis and collaboration with development teams.
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured approach to diagnosing issues and proposing options.
  • Strong commitment to continuous improvement, teamwork, and integrity, including willingness to learn new SAP and cloud capabilities.


What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • SAP certification in one or more relevant modules (e.g., SD, MM, PP, WM/EWM, FI-CO, Ariba, S/4HANA).
  • Experience with SAP Automotive Suite or similar industry-specific solutions supporting OEMs, suppliers, or complex manufacturing.
  • Familiarity with the SAP Integrated Tool Chain – including Signavio (process modeling), SAP Cloud ALM (CALM), and Tricentis (Tosca) – as well as SAP Fiori and SAP BTP, especially for cloud-based SAP extensions and integrations.
  • Exposure to SAP AI / analytics capabilities and apply analytics/AI in manufacturing, supply chain, or order management use cases.
  • Experience with EDI transaction sets (ANSI X12, EDIFACT) and related communication protocols, and/or other integration platforms (e.g., SAP PI/PO, SAP Integration Suite, Sterling, Connect Direct).
  • Background working with manufacturers, suppliers, or service providers, ideally in automotive or complex discrete manufacturing environments.
  • Prior consulting experience or working with global stakeholder groups, including experience in regulated environments (e.g., SOX, internal controls, legal/tax requirements).


Hybrid: This role is categorized as hybrid. The successful candidate is expected to report to Warren, MI or Austin, TX, three times per week, at minimum, or as dictated by business needs.

LVMH Beauty's activities benefit from exceptional dynamism that relies on both the longevity and development of key lines, and on the boldness of new creations.

All are driven by the same values: a quest for excellence, creativity, innovation, and perfect mastery of their image.

The brands cultivate what makes them unique and are guaranteed to make them stand out in a highly competitive global market. The success of the LVMH Beauty Division depends on finding the right balance between major historic Houses, such as Parfums Christian Dior, Parfums Givenchy, Acqua di Parma, Guerlain, and newer brands with strong potential like Kenzo Parfums, Fresh, and Make Up For Ever.

LVMH Beauty invites you today to join its North America teams.

LVMH Beauty is part of the LVMH Group.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA professional to support key phases of our SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Edition (PCE). This role spans the Explore, Realize, and Deploy phases, requiring a strong combination of business process understanding, integration expertise, data migration governance, and testing execution.

The consultant will provide functional expertise, governance, and validation rather than performing primary SAP configuration and implementation activities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Explore Phase (Design & Requirements)
  • Workshop Facilitation: Participate in business workshops and support the business in collecting inputs for workshop preparation.
  • Requirements Management: Bridge the gap between business and the system integrator by helping the integrator understand complex business requirements.
  • Organizational Structure & Golden Rules: Support the business in defining organizational data structures (e.g., plants, sales organizations, cost centers) and establishing golden rules.
  • Solution Enablement: Assist the business in fully understanding the SAP S/4HANA solution, end-to-end processes, and S/4 PCE WRICEF (Workflows, Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms) targets.
  • Design Challenge & Validation: Actively challenge the system integrator during the design phase to ensure optimal solution architecture and validate final target business processes.
  • Demo Preparation: Prepare test data for system and solution demonstrations.
  • Integration & Interface Scope: Participate in integration workshops, validate integration designs, and support the definition of SAP interface requirements, including business logic, field mapping, transformation rules, routing principles, and target interface mappings. Validate the overall data migration scope, strategy, methods, and tools.

Job Responsibilities

  • Realize Phase (Configuration, Testing & Migration)
  • SAP Interface Management: Define, review, and validate interface business logic, source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, error-handling requirements, and routing rules for application and SAP S/4 interfaces on mediation layers. Participate in integration design reviews and support end-to-end interface testing across applications and S/4 PCE prior to UAT.
  • Testing & Test Data: Prepare applications and systems for test data alignment. Support the business in writing test cases, execute and validate integration tests, and validate the scope of automatic tests (including test cases, APIs, and end-to-end scenarios).
  • Data Migration Execution:
    • Design, develop, and test extractors and mapping tools to fit target migration templates.
    • Define and validate mapping rules, data cleansing procedures, and data quality checks.
    • Execute data extraction from source systems (iterative cycles) and validate migration results for unit and integration testing.
    • Support the business in validating data migration outputs.
  • Deploy & Tool Kit Phase (Change Management & Testing)
  • Change Management & Training: Assist change management specialized training on SAP S/4 PCE (led by external partners) and support Key Users (KU) during end-user training sessions.
  • Toolkit & Planning: Contribute to the definition and execution of comprehensive testing plans.

Profile

Qualifications Proven hands-on experience implementing SAP S/4HANA (preferably Public Cloud Edition). Strong functional knowledge of core SAP modules (FI/CO) and organizational data definition, and basic understanding of the MM, SD, PP modules. Demonstrated experience in SAP interface management, including business logic definition, source-to-target mapping, transformation rules, middleware/mediation mapping, error handling, and end-to-end interface testing. Solid background in SAP Data Migration methodologies, extraction tools, data quality, and cleansing governance. Experience in test management, including writing test cases, automated testing validation, and execution across integrated environments. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills to effectively bridge business teams and external system integrators.

Additional Information

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on SAP configuration experience, with at least 2–3 full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementations or conversions.
  • Core Knowledge: Deep expertise in SAP FI/CO architecture, cross-module integration, financial close cockpit, and statutory/management reporting requirements.
  • Certifications: SAP Certified Application Associate – SAP S/4HANA for Financial Accounting Associates (or related S/4HANA Finance certification) preferred.
  • Technical Literacy: Familiarity with SAP Fiori apps, CDS views, and integration with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC).
  • Soft Skills: Strong analytical mindset, excellent cross-functional communication skills, and the ability to bridge business finance needs with technical configurations.

This job description is intended to cover the core accountabilities of the position and is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

LVMH Inc. uses the published salary range as a guideline to provide our employees with market competitive pay while allowing for flexibility to recognize and reward various levels of expertise, performance, and tenure.

While the published salary range is a good faith reflection of the targeted salary level for the position, LVMH Inc. reserves the right to pay outside of the published range of $140,000 - $170,000.

- Integration & Interface Scope: Participate in integration workshops, validate integration designs, and support the definition of SAP interface requirements, including business logic, field mapping, transformation rules, routing principles, and target interface mappings. Validate the overall data migration scope, strategy, methods, and tools. 

Job Responsibilities 



-  Realize Phase (Configuration, Testing & Migration)
- SAP Interface Management: Define, review, and validate interface business logic, source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, error-handling requirements, and routing rules for application and SAP S/4 interfaces on mediation layers. Participate in integration design reviews and support end-to-end interface testing across applications and S/4 PCE prior to UAT. 
- Testing & Test Data: Prepare applications and systems for test data alignment. Support the business in writing test cases, execute and validate integration tests, and validate the scope of automatic tests (including test cases, APIs, and end-to-end scenarios). 
- Data Migration Execution:

- Design, develop, and test extractors and mapping tools to fit target migration templates. 
- Define and validate mapping rules, data cleansing procedures, and data quality checks. 
- Execute data extraction from source systems (iterative cycles) and validate migration results for unit and integration testing. 
- Support the business in validating data migration outputs. 
-  Deploy & Tool Kit Phase (Change Management & Testing)
- Change Management & Training: Assist change management specialized training on SAP S/4 PCE (led by external partners) and support Key Users (KU) during end-user training sessions. 
- Toolkit & Planning: Contribute to the definition and execution of comprehensive testing plans. 

Profile

Qualifications Proven hands-on experience implementing SAP S/4HANA (preferably Public Cloud Edition). Strong functional knowledge of core SAP modules (FI/CO) and organizational data definition, and basic understanding of the MM, SD, PP modules. Demonstrated experience in SAP interface management, including business logic definition, source-to-target mapping, transformation rules, middleware/mediation mapping, error handling, and end-to-end interface testing. Solid background in SAP Data Migration methodologies, extraction tools, data quality, and cleansing governance. Experience in test management, including writing test cases, automated testing validation, and execution across integrated environments. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills to effectively bridge business teams and external system integrators.

Additional Information

Required Qualifications & Skills



- Experience: 5+ years of hands-on SAP configuration experience, with at least 2–3 full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementations or conversions. 
- Core Knowledge: Deep expertise in SAP FI/CO architecture, cross-module integration, financial close cockpit, and statutory/management reporting requirements. 
- Certifications: SAP Certified Application Associate – SAP S/4HANA for Financial Accounting Associates (or related S/4HANA Finance certification) preferred. 
- Technical Literacy: Familiarity with SAP Fiori apps, CDS views, and integration with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC).

Job Description

Must Have Technical/Functional Skills

Required Skills

  • 10+ years of SAP consulting experience with strong expertise in SAP EWM.
  • Multiple end-to-end SAP EWM implementation projects on SAP S/4HANA.
  • Strong knowledge of:
  • Inbound Processing
  • Outbound Processing
  • Internal Warehouse Processes
  • Physical Inventory
  • Replenishment
  • Production Supply & Staging
  • Stock Management
  • Warehouse Monitoring
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • POSC
  • LOSC
  • WOCR
  • Wave Management
  • HU Management
  • VAS
  • Yard Management
  • Resource Management
  • Experience integrating SAP EWM with MM, SD, PP, QM, and TM.
  • Experience with RF Framework, ITS Mobile, RFID integration, and warehouse automation.
  • Strong understanding of SAP interfaces including IDocs, APIs, middleware, CPI/BTP, and EDI.
  • Experience in data migration, cutover planning, and go-live support.
  • Strong knowledge of warehouse process optimization and solution architecture.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Roles & Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, configure, and implement SAP EWM solutions to support business and warehouse operations.
  • Lead end-to-end SAP EWM implementation projects, including requirement gathering, blueprinting, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.
  • Configure warehouse structures including Warehouse Number, Storage Types, Storage Sections, Storage Bins, Activity Areas, and Work Centers.
  • Implement and support inbound, outbound, internal warehouse movements, replenishment, production staging, physical inventory, stock transfers, and scrapping processes.
  • Configure advanced EWM functionalities including:
  • POSC (Process-Oriented Storage Control)
  • LOSC (Layout-Oriented Storage Control)
  • WOCR (Warehouse Order Creation Rules)
  • Wave Management
  • Handling Unit (HU) Management
  • Cross-Docking
  • Value Added Services (VAS)
  • Yard Management
  • Resource Management
  • Integrate SAP EWM with SAP S/4HANA modules including MM, SD, PP, QM, TM, and external applications.
  • Work on interfaces using IDocs, APIs, middleware, EDI, RF devices, RFID, and SAP Mobile Technologies (ITS Mobile/RF Framework).
  • Participate in master data preparation, data migration, cutover planning, and go-live activities using SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit.
  • Conduct Unit Testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and support defect resolution.
  • Collaborate with business users, technical teams, and cross-functional consultants to deliver scalable warehouse solutions.
  • Analyze business processes and recommend process improvements to enhance warehouse efficiency and productivity.
  • Prepare functional specifications and coordinate with ABAP developers for custom developments and enhancements.
  • Provide end-user training, documentation, knowledge transfer, and hypercare support after deployment.
  • Manage project deliverables, risks, timelines, and stakeholder communication throughout the project lifecycle.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Embedded EWM and Decentralized EWM.
  • Experience working in manufacturing, retail, logistics, or supply chain environments.

Job Summary

Join Our Team

Day & Zimmermann is seeking an experienced SAP SD & Billing Configuration Specialist to support and enhance our SAP ERP platform. This role is ideal for a hands-on SAP professional who enjoys solving complex business challenges, improving integrated processes, and partnering with business and technical teams to deliver reliable solutions.

The successful candidate will have strong expertise in Sales and Billing processes, Resource Related Billing, SAP configuration, reporting, integrations, testing, and production support. This position offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact across critical business operations while contributing to continuous ERP improvement and modernization initiatives.

Job Summary

The Specialist, ERP Configuration 3, SD supports Day & Zimmermann's SAP ERP platform by translating Sales, billing, distribution and business process needs into system configuration, functional specifications, testing, reporting, and end-user support. This job partners business users, ERP configuration leadership, ABAP/development resources, and technical teams to maintain reliable ERP systems, data integrity, and integrated ERP processes across assigned modules. The job contributes to business continuity and decision-making by ensuring ERP solutions are configured, documented, tested, and supported in alignment with operational requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Configure, maintain, and enhance SAP SD, Billing, and related business processes to support Sales, Contracts, Resource Related Billing, Deliveries, Invoicing, Reporting, and integrated ERP operations.
  • Design, configure, and support end-to-end Sales and Billing processes, including:
    • Hands-on experience with end-to-end Sales and Billing processes, including sales documents, contracts, sales orders, deliveries, goods movement integration, billing documents, billing plans, milestone billing, credit memos, debit memos, and related document flows.
    • Resource Related Billing processes, including contract-related billing, time and expense-based billing, DIP profiles, Dynamic Item Processor processes, and billing document creation.
  • Configure and support core SAP SD functions, including pricing procedures, condition techniques, copy controls, incompletion procedures, account determination, text determination, output determination, partner determination, billing relevance, and document controls.
  • Gather and translate requirements from business users, process owners, and technical teams into functional specifications, system designs, test scenarios, and implementation documentation.
  • Provide advanced issue analysis and resolution for SAP SD, Billing, data, reporting, and integration issues. Investigate root causes and recommend sustainable solutions.
  • Develop requirements for custom reports, interfaces, enhancements, forms, and ABAP programs. Create, maintain, and support ABAP Queries and other reporting solutions.
  • Work closely with ABAP and technical teams to review designs, troubleshoot defects, validate code results, and ensure that custom developments meet business requirements.
  • Support integration between SAP SD/Billing and other functional areas, including:
    • Human Resources and employee time or master data processes
    • Logistics, Materials Management, Procurement, and Project Systems
    • Finance, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, General Ledger, and controlling processes
  • Lead or support functional, integration, regression, user acceptance, and production validation testing.
  • Validate master data, transactional data, standard and custom table usage, reporting results, accounting documents, tax results, and integration outcomes.
  • Support data conversions, mass updates, system upgrades, enhancements, and deployment activities.
  • Create and maintain configuration documentation, functional specifications, test scripts, user procedures, training materials, and knowledge resources.
  • Provide guidance and mentoring to business users and junior team members.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives, SAP modernization efforts, and future migration activities, including SAP S/4HANA readiness and implementation initiatives.

KSAs (Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities)

  • Advanced knowledge of SAP ERP configuration concepts, SD and Billing processes, module integration, testing, implementation, and production support.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with SAP Sales Documents, Deliveries, Billing Documents, Contracts, document flow, and end-to-end order-to-cash processes.
  • Extensive knowledge of Resource Related Billing, including time and expense billing, contract-based billing, DIP profiles, billing plans, milestone billing, and related project or contract billing processes.
  • Strong knowledge of SAP pricing procedures, condition techniques, access sequences, condition records, account determination, copy controls, text determination, output determination, and partner determination.
  • Working knowledge of standard SAP tables, data structures, document relationships, billing and accounting document flow, and troubleshooting tools.
  • Experience with custom reports, ABAP Queries, functional specifications, enhancements, forms, interfaces, and custom SAP programs.
  • Ability to analyze complex business requirements, system limitations, data dependencies, integration impacts, and organizational needs.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex system, data, reporting, billing, accounting, and integration issues.
  • Strong understanding of integration points between SD/Billing and HR, Logistics, Materials Management, Project Systems, Finance, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, and Controlling.
  • Ability to develop clear functional specifications, test scenarios, user procedures, training materials, and support documentation.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage competing support, enhancement, and implementation priorities while maintaining customer focus, data integrity, and timely issue resolution.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP Fiori, or S/4HANA migration and readiness activities is a strong advantage.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (BA/BS) in Computer Information Systems, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Business Information Systems, Human Resources Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent related experience may be considered where appropriate.
  • 10 or more years of progressive ERP, SAP configuration, business systems analysis, or related information systems experience.
  • Significant experience supporting SAP ERP/SD, Sales and Billing, Resource Related Billing, requirements analysis, testing, integration, reporting, data validation, and end-user support.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience configuring and supporting SAP Sales Documents, Deliveries, Billing, Pricing, Standard Texts, Outputs, and related SD functions.
  • Experience preparing functional specifications and working collaboratively with ABAP developers, technical teams, business stakeholders, and system integration teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • SAP ECC experience, preferably in complex, integrated business environments.
  • SAP S/4HANA implementation, migration, conversion, or readiness experience.
  • Experience with Project Systems, contract billing, professional services billing, time entry, or resource-based business models.
  • Experience supporting HR, Logistics, Finance, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, and Controlling integrations.
  • Experience with custom reporting, ABAP Queries, interfaces, data conversion, and production support.

Why Join Day & Zimmermann?

At Day & Zimmermann, you will work with experienced professionals on business-critical SAP solutions that support customers, employees, finance, operations, and project teams. At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Our goal is to give clients a unique business perspective on how SAP technology can enhance their operations. By leveraging EY’s expertise in SAP, Supply Chain, FICO, BPC, Data & Analytics, Customer Solutions, Technology & Architecture, and SuccessFactors, we assist clients in enhancing performance and increasing productivity.

The Opportunity

Our SAP Procurement practice helps organizations modernize and optimize their source-to-pay operations through SAP S/4HANA. We work with clients to transform procurement processes, improve supplier collaboration, increase operational efficiency, and strengthen controls across purchasing, inventory management, and invoice processing.

As a Senior Technology Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You will interact with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, ensuring that newly implemented technology solutions meet their needs. Your collaboration with technical teams will be essential in designing and delivering effective system architecture solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for delivering top-notch business analysis and system configuration. Your day-to-day will involve:

  • Support SAP Procurement and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstreams within SAP S/4HANA implementation and transformation engagements.
  • Design and configure SAP Materials Management (MM) solutions across purchasing, inventory management, goods movements, and invoice verification processes.
  • Advise clients on procurement leading practices and SAP standard capabilities while balancing business requirements with scalable solutions.
  • Translating complex business requirements into detailed technical specifications
  • Develop functional specifications, process documentation, test scripts, training materials, and other project deliverables.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Sales to help deliver integrated business solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

On a typical engagement, you will work directly with procurement, supply chain, and finance leaders to understand business challenges and translate requirements into scalable SAP solutions. Success in this role requires a combination of functional procurement expertise, SAP configuration experience, and the ability to guide clients through large-scale transformation initiatives.

We are seeking professionals with demonstrated experience in one or more procurement specializations and an understanding of related end-to-end Procure-to-Pay processes.

Key skills include:

  • Deep understanding of Procure-to-Pay business processes and their integration points across the enterprise.
  • Experience designing SAP-enabled procurement solutions that balance business requirements with standard SAP functionality.
  • Ability to lead requirements gathering sessions, process design workshops, fit-gap assessments, and solution validation activities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex business and system challenges.
  • Proven ability to manage workstream deliverables, project risks, stakeholder expectations, and timelines.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

  • A bachelor's degree with at least 2-4 years of SAP Procurement, Supply Chain, or consulting experience.
  • Experience supporting at least one full lifecycle SAP implementation, preferably an SAP S/4HANA transformation.
  • Hands-on experience in one or more SAP Procurement specializations, including:
    • SAP S/4HANA Procurement (Direct Materials)
    • SAP Invoice Management and Accounts Payable Integration
    • SAP Inventory Management
    • SAP Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, or Contracts
    • SAP Ariba Buying and Invoicing
    • SAP Ariba Integration, including Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG)
  • Experience configuring SAP MM procurement processes, including material master, business partner (vendor), RFQs, contracts, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, approval workflows, output management, goods receipts, stock transport orders, ALE, and IDocs.
  • Experience in one or more SAP Ariba solutions, including Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, Contracts, Buying and Invoicing, Supply Chain Collaboration, Commerce Automation, or Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG).
  • Knowledge of integration points with Accounts Payable, Production Planning, Sales & Distribution, and other related SAP modules.
  • Experience leading the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstream, including facilitating solution design workshops and developing proof of concepts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills.
  • Knowledge of leading practices, benchmarking, peer company environments and prior advisory experience relevant to industry specific finance and technology functions.
  • A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

  • Previous consulting experience within a professional services environment.
  • SAP S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement certification or other relevant SAP certifications.

What We Look For

We seek individuals who are proactive, innovative, and eager to contribute to team success. Top performers are those who demonstrate strong analytical skills, the ability to communicate effectively, and a passion for technology and its impact on business.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

  • The salary range for this job is:
    • New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $122,900 to $204,900
    • Bay Area California offices – $128,100 to $213,400
    • All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $102,500 to $187,900
  • Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

  • To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.
  • EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.
  • For those living in California, please click here for additional information.
  • At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

All in to shape the future with confidence.

This role involves managing all aspects of the platform transition, including planning, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support. In this pivotal role, you will provide critical leadership and guidance to functions, utilizing your extensive knowledge and experience of the SAP S/4 HANA system.

Position Responsibilities: may include:

  • SAP S/4HANA Implementation: Oversee the full lifecycle of SAP S/4 HANA SD deployment, from initial system design, configuring and customizing the system to meet Daikin's unique requirements, to conducting comprehensive system and user acceptance testing, to finally deploying the system.
  • Planning and Strategy: Create a data-driven approach to plan for Daikin's end-to-end business transformation towards SAP S/4 standard processes. Evaluate our existing processes and create strategic plans to integrate these with S/4 HANA's functionalities.
  • Process Optimization: Understand business processes in the manufacturing area, identify areas for improvement, and ensure the solution aligns with SAP S/4HANA environment.
  • Stakeholder Management: Work closely with relevant internal and external stakeholders, including inventory, finance, logistics, to ensure seamless integration of S/4 HANA functions with other business operations. Also, manage relationships with external SAP consultants and solution providers.
  • Training and Support: Develop a comprehensive training program for end users, thus driving S/4 HANA adoption across the organization. This includes conceptualizing user manuals, training materials, and reference guides.
  • Vendor Management: Collaborate with SAP consultants and other technology partners to ensure project deliverables are met within timelines and budgets.
  • Data Integrity and Migration: Oversee the migration of sales and distribution data from legacy systems to SAP S/4HANA, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
  • Continuous Improvement: Post-implementation, continuously monitor manufacturing ERP (PP,MM) processes within SAP S/4HANA to identify and implement further enhancements.

Nature & Scope

  • Is recognized as a subject matter expert in job area
  • Manages large projects or processes with limited oversight from manager
  • Coaches, reviews, and delegates work to lower-level professionals
  • Problems faced are difficult and often complex

Knowledge & Skills

  • 5+ years of SAP functional experience with strong focus on Manufacturing (PP/MM or similar).
  • Extensive knowledge of the integral functions, features, and capabilities of SAP S/4 HANA SD
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven track record of driving large-scale technology transformation projects to completion.

At Syskoplan Reply, we are seeking a Senior SAP FICO Consultant to join our team. You are an individual who has technical and functional expertise of the SAP FICO module which allows you to solve problems and deliver optimum solutions for the client. You will act as both a strategic advisor and hands-on configurator, delivering best-in-class solutions aligned with SAP Activate methodology and SAP’s fit-to-standard approach. You have strong business acumen, technical expertise, and the ability to translate complex finance processes into standard cloud-based solutions using SAP Best Practices. You have hands on S/4HANA and S/4HANA Cloud experience including use case of standard Fiori applications.

Responsibilities
  • Act as a business consultant to help customers achieve their objectives understanding the importance of communication in a consultant's role
  • Problem solve with an extraordinary technical and functional understanding of business process and FICO Principles and SAP products
  • Support end users from a functional and/or technical perspective working closely with them and the business to analyze and review their business requirements or processes
  • Troubleshoot and configure SAP FICO including integration points with other modules and cross functional design/build of other modules. Working on multiple projects as a project team member or team lead.
  • Leads fit/gap and other types of working sessions to understand needs driven by business process requirements. Translate requirements into solutions, using SAP Best Practices
  • Prepare clear and concise documentation, as well as provide timely status updates
  • Proactively identify risks and develop strategies to mitigate potential issues. Assess corporate impacts of changes and recommend strategies to senior management
  • Provide knowledge transfer to clients and fellow consultants, in formal and ad hoc settings

Minimum Requirements
  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Travel up to 50%
  • 8 years of SAP experience with a minimum of 3 full-cycle SAP implementations; Implementation experience in SAP Cloud environments both public and private.
  • Proficient in the business processes associated with financial operations, which includes expertise in general ledger, accounts receivable, accounts payable, asset management, cost center accounting, product cost controlling, profitability analysis, and profit center accounting.
  • Expert in set-up and configuration of FICO as well as cross functional design/build of other module(s)
  • Proficient in all aspects of a project from requirement gathering and gapping to realization to testing, go-live prep and go-live execution as well as hyper-care support. Ability to lead sessions and create requirements to develop the right client solution
  • Highly skilled in FICO master data set-up, cleansing, harmonization and migration, including LSMW and Migration Cockpit
  • Ability to be a thought leader in your domain and contribute to ecosphere both within and external of Reply

Preferred Qualifications
  • International project or SAP configuration experience in NAFTA, LATAM and/or EMEA is a plus
  • S/4 Public and/or Private Cloud Certification
  • SAP Activate methodology and SAP’s fit-to-standard approach.

descriptionHtml:
Position Description

CGI is seeking a high‑potential Advanced SAP S/4HANA Functional Consultant with experience in the SAP ECC or S/4HANA Materials Management (MM) module, or SAP Procurement for Public Sector (PPS). The successful candidate will work closely with clients to lead workshops, understand requirements, design and present solutions, configure SAP, and complete full lifecycle implementations associated with the Request to Procure (R2P) and Procure to Pay (P2P) business process areas of the federal government. The primary focus is on design, configuration, and testing in SAP S/4HANA Public Sector, with the experience and/or desire to grow and mentor an agile team focused on R2P and P2P within PPS or the MM module. This role requires a strong understanding of SAP Federal Financial Accounting processes and solutions.

This position is located in one of CGI Federal's offices in Fairfax, VA, Lebanon, VA, Lafayette, LA or Knoxville, TN; however, a hybrid working model is acceptable. You will be required to work in a CGI Federal office two days per week.

Your future duties and responsibilities

  • Facilitate the implementation of requirements, design solutions, and configure SAP MM for the Public Sector to enhance client business functionality and overall performance while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.

Job Description

Must Have Technical/Functional Skills

  • 10+ years of relevant SAP experience, including at least one end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementation.
  • Hands-on SAP PEO configuration experience covering BOM handling, EBOM-to-MBOM handover using Visual Enterprise Manufacturing Planner (VEMP), shop floor routings, production models, and production versions.
  • Strong knowledge of discrete manufacturing for complex assemblies, manufacturing master data, digital thread concepts, and PLM integration.
  • Experience integrating engineering systems such as PLM and PDM with SAP S/4HANA.
  • Working knowledge of SAP Production Planning (PP), Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling (PP/DS), and Quality Management (QM).
  • Experience with Engineering Change Management, change records, and Change Impact Analysis.
  • Familiarity with SAP MII, SAP ME, SAP Digital Manufacturing Cloud, Teamcenter, or Windchill is preferred.
  • Experience in aerospace, automotive, high-tech manufacturing, medical devices, or another regulated manufacturing industry is preferred.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Lead SAP S/4HANA PEO implementation, configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization activities.
  • Elicit, analyze, and document business and technical requirements with client stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
  • Design solutions for complex discrete manufacturing processes, including engineering handover, EBOM-to-MBOM conversion, shop floor routings, production models, work instructions, and production execution.
  • Configure and support Engineering Change Management, change records, and Change Impact Analysis.
  • Ensure seamless integration of PEO with SAP PP, PP/DS, QM, PLM/PDM platforms, MES, and shop floor systems.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for SAP S/4HANA PEO engineering and manufacturing execution capabilities.
  • Manage assigned project timelines, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and resources to support successful completion.
  • Develop functional specifications, configuration documentation, test scenarios, and deployment artifacts.
  • Support system integration testing, user acceptance testing, defect resolution, troubleshooting, and production support.
  • Deliver Train-the-Trainer sessions and knowledge transfer for business and support teams.
  • Promote compliance with industry standards, implementation best practices, and solution governance.
  • Travel domestically and internationally at least 30%, based on project needs.

This role requires strong functional and hands-on configuration expertise, a deep understanding of purchasing and inventory management business processes, and the ability to translate client requirements into scalable solutions aligned with SAP Best Practices and the Fit-to-Standard approach.

The consultant will take ownership of end-to-end solution delivery, ensuring that SAP purchasing, materials, and inventory management processes are effectively integrated with other functional areas, meet client business objectives, and are delivered on time and to the highest quality standards.

The successful candidate will work across multiple industries, collaborating closely with client stakeholders, solution architects, and cross-functional project teams throughout the SAP implementation lifecycle, following the SAP Activate methodology.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Implementation: Lead the design, configuration, implementation, testing, data migration, cutover, and post-go-live support of SAP Purchasing (PTP) and Materials Management (MM) solutions in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud.
  • SAP Best Practices and Fit-to-Standard: Apply SAP Best Practices and follow the SAP Activate methodology, emphasizing the Fit-to-Standard approach and minimizing unnecessary customizations and extensions.
  • Business Process Analysis and Solution Design: Analyze clients' purchasing, materials, and inventory management processes. Translate business requirements into effective SAP solutions aligned with business objectives and industry best practices.
  • Hands-On System Configuration: Independently configure and validate SAP PTP/ MM functionality within SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, including Material Master management.
  • Cross-Functional Integration: Ensure seamless integration of SAP PTP/ MM processes with other functional areas, including Production Planning (PP), Sales and Distribution (SD), Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), and Finance/Controlling (FI/CO).
  • Testing and Quality Assurance: Develop and execute functional and integration test scenarios, support System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), troubleshoot issues, and ensure solutions meet business and functional requirements.
  • Data Migration and Cutover: Guide purchasing and inventory management-related master data migration, including data validation and reconciliation. Plan and execute SAP PTP/ MM cutover activities to ensure successful system deployment.
  • Client Collaboration and Advisory: Work closely with client business stakeholders, IT teams, and project leadership to provide expert functional guidance, resolve design challenges, and drive timely decisions.
  • Documentation and Knowledge Transfer: Prepare and maintain functional design documents, configuration documentation, business process flows, test scripts, and training materials. Conduct knowledge transfer and support end-user training.
  • Post-Go-Live Support: Provide hyper- care and production support, resolve functional issues, and recommend process improvements to optimize SAP purchasing and inventory management operations. Project Delivery Accountability: Take ownership of assigned PTP/ MM deliverables, proactively identify and escalate risks, coordinate dependencies with other workstreams, and ensure high-quality, on-time delivery in accordance with project plans and commitments.

This job can be performed from anywhere in the US.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Experience: Proven hands-on experience implementing and configuring SAP PTP/ MM solutions in SAP S/4HANA, with direct implementation experience in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud.
  • Functional Expertise: Strong functional knowledge of SAP Material management covering areas like materials and supplier master data, Sourcing and supplier selection, Request for Price, Purchase requisitions, Purchasing contracts and Scheduling Agreements, Purchase Order management, consumable purchasing, Service Procurement, subcontracting, Supplier consignment, goods receipt and supplier returns, batch management, Supplier evaluation and performance monitoring, Intercompany stock transfer/Advanced Intercompany Stock transfer, Invoice management, reporting and monitoring for procurement, Core Inventory management, physical inventory and cycle counting.
  • Hands-On Configuration: Demonstrated ability to independently configure, test, troubleshoot, and support SAP PTP/ MM functionality, preferably using SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud configuration tools and capabilities.
  • Implementation Methodology: Proven experience with SAP Activate methodology, including leading Fit-to-Standard workshops, identifying process gaps, and designing solutions aligned with SAP Best Practices.
  • Cross-Functional Integration: Solid understanding of SAP PTP/ MM integration with Production Planning (PP), Sales and Distribution (SD), Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), and Finance/Controlling (FI/CO).
  • Data Migration and Cutover: Practical experience with purchasing, materials, and inventory management-related master data migration, data validation, reconciliation, and execution of system cutover activities.
  • Testing and Deployment: Experience preparing and executing functional and integration testing, supporting SIT/UAT, resolving defects, and providing post-go-live hyper-care support.
  • Business Process Knowledge: Strong understanding of purchasing, materials, and inventory management business processes, with the ability to translate business requirements into practical SAP solutions.
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical capabilities and demonstrated ability to independently investigate functional issues, identify root causes, and develop effective solutions.
  • Communication and Consulting Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to lead client discussions, explain SAP solutions, and effectively collaborate with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Delivery and Accountability: Proven ability to independently manage assigned deliverables, prioritize competing tasks, meet project deadlines, and proactively communicate risks and issues.
  • Teamwork and Quality: Ability to work effectively both independently and within cross-functional, globally distributed teams, with strong attention to detail and commitment to high- quality project delivery.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Participation in at least three full-cycle SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation, preferably with direct responsibility for PTP/ MM configuration and deployment.
  • Experience workflow management.
  • Familiarity with SAP Cloud ALM for managing project deliverables, requirements, testing, and defects.
  • Experience with purchasing and inventory management-related SAP Fiori applications, SAP Central Business Configuration (CBC), and Public Cloud extensibility concepts.
  • SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition certification in Purchasing or a related functional area.

descriptionHtml:
Syskoplan Reply is a part of the Reply Network, focused on delivering transformative projects to our clients leveraging SAP solutions. Syskoplan Reply is an SAP Gold partner and has recognized expertise executing global projects in various industries and a wide range of competencies including business process consulting, customer experience, intelligent automation, ERP and more.

At Syskoplan Reply, we are seeking a Senior SAP FICO Consultant to join our team. You are an individual who has technical and functional expertise of the SAP FICO module which allows you to solve problems and deliver optimum solutions for the client. You will act as both a strategic advisor and hands-on configurator, delivering best-in-class solutions aligned with SAP Activate methodology and SAP’s fit-to-standard approach. You have strong business acumen, technical expertise, and the ability to translate complex finance processes into standard cloud-based solutions using SAP Best Practices. You have hands on S/4HANA and S/4HANA Cloud experience including use case of standard Fiori applications.

Responsibilities
  • Act as a business consultant to help customers achieve their objectives understanding the importance of communication in a consultant's role
  • Problem solve with an extraordinary technical and functional understanding of business process and FICO Principles and SAP products
  • Support end users from a functional and/or technical perspective working closely with them and the business to analyze and review their business requirements or processes
  • Troubleshoot and configure SAP FICO including integration points with other modules and cross functional design/build of other modules. Working on multiple projects as a project team member or team lead.
  • Leads fit/gap and other types of working sessions to understand needs driven by business process requirements. Translate requirements into solutions, using SAP Best Practices
  • Prepare clear and concise documentation, as well as provide timely status updates
  • Proactively identify risks and develop strategies to mitigate potential issues. Assess corporate impacts of changes and recommend strategies to senior management
  • Provide knowledge transfer to clients and fellow consultants, in formal and ad hoc settings

Minimum Requirements
  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Travel up to 50%
  • 8 years of SAP experience with a minimum of 3 full-cycle SAP implementations; Implementation experience in SAP Cloud environments both public and private.
  • Proficient in the business processes associated with financial operations, which includes expertise in general ledger, accounts receivable, accounts payable, asset management, cost center accounting, product cost controlling, profitability analysis, and profit center accounting.
  • Expert in set-up and configuration of FICO as well as cross functional design/build of other module(s)
  • Proficient in all aspects of a project from requirement gathering and gapping to realization to testing, go-live prep and go-live execution as well as hyper-care support. Ability to lead sessions and create requirements to develop the right client solution
  • Highly skilled in FICO master data set-up, cleansing, harmonization and migration, including LSMW and Migration Cockpit
  • Ability to be a thought leader in your domain and contribute to ecosphere both within and external of Reply

Preferred Qualifications
  • International project or SAP configuration experience in NAFTA, LATAM and/or EMEA is a plus
  • S/4 Public and/or Private Cloud Certification
  • SAP Activate methodology and SAP’s fit-to-standard approach.

Reply specializes in the design and implementation of solutions based on new communication channels and digital media. Reply is a network of highly specialized companies supporting global industrial groups operating in the telecom and media, industry and services, banking, insurance and public administration sectors in the definition and development of business models enabled for the new paradigms of AI, cloud computing, digital media and the Internet of Things. Today's finance leaders face increasing pressure to modernize operations, improve reporting accuracy, and scale efficiently as their businesses grow. As a NetSuite Senior Consultant at Deloitte, you will help clients design and implement NetSuite solutions that align with their business goals and deliver measurable results. This role fits professionals across core financial accounting, procure-to-pay, or order-to-cash implementation backgrounds. Join a team that is transforming how finance and accounting organizations operate by streamlining processes, improving reporting, and building lasting client relationships along the way.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant, you will implement and deploy NetSuite solutions:

  • Work within an engagement team, identifying business requirements, managing functional design, prototyping, and designing processes
  • Provide NetSuite consulting expertise, using industry experience, business analysis, and best practices to address clients' most complex requirements
  • Implement and deploy NetSuite solutions that accommodate unique industry, business, and regulatory requirements
  • Conduct business process mapping and requirements-gathering sessions with clients, on-site and remote
  • Prepare Business Requirements and Technical Scoping Documents for client approval
  • Build, develop, and test functional designs and scripted, customized solutions for business components and prototypes
  • Drive test planning, execution, and optimization support
  • Troubleshoot configuration issues and provide ongoing post-implementation support to optimize user adoption

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to build and maintain strong client and team relationships
  • Comfort managing multiple priorities across concurrent workstreams
  • Willingness to mentor and support the development of junior team members

The team

Our NetSuite practice helps upper mid-market and high-growth organizations modernize their financial and operational systems on a unified cloud platform. We work alongside clients to streamline processes, improve reporting, and support their next stage of growth. We're just as invested in our own team's growth, with hands-on learning and mentorship built into every engagement.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3+ years of relevant consulting or industry experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Record to Report: General Ledger, Consolidations, Multibook accounting, CTA Analysis, FX variances, and/or Financial Reporting
    • Procure to Pay: Accounts Payable
    • Order to Cash: Accounts Receivable
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Information Systems, or another related field
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
Preferred:

  • Certified NetSuite Professional (NetSuite Administrator / Suite Foundation / ERP Consultant / Multi-Book Consultant / ARM/Revenue Management)
  • Full lifecycle NetSuite implementation experience, including Design, Build, Test, Deploy, and Support phases
  • Experience with NetSuite integrations, customizations, and ERP data migration/cutover
  • Previous "Big 4" or large consulting firm experience
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage teams and stakeholders across global locations
  • Advanced degree in a relevant field
  • Eagerness to mentor junior staff

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. descriptionHtml:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

The Senior SAP PTP/ MM Consultant will be responsible for leading the design, configuration, implementation, testing, data migration, cutover, and post-go-live support of SAP Purchasing (PTP) and Materials Management (MM) solutions within SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud.

This role requires strong functional and hands-on configuration expertise, a deep understanding of purchasing and inventory management business processes, and the ability to translate client requirements into scalable solutions aligned with SAP Best Practices and the Fit-to-Standard approach.

The consultant will take ownership of end-to-end solution delivery, ensuring that SAP purchasing, materials, and inventory management processes are effectively integrated with other functional areas, meet client business objectives, and are delivered on time and to the highest quality standards.

The successful candidate will work across multiple industries, collaborating closely with client stakeholders, solution architects, and cross-functional project teams throughout the SAP implementation lifecycle, following the SAP Activate methodology.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Implementation: Lead the design, configuration, implementation, testing, data migration, cutover, and post-go-live support of SAP Purchasing (PTP) and Materials Management (MM) solutions in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud.
  • SAP Best Practices and Fit-to-Standard: Apply SAP Best Practices and follow the SAP Activate methodology, emphasizing the Fit-to-Standard approach and minimizing unnecessary customizations and extensions.
  • Business Process Analysis and Solution Design: Analyze clients' purchasing, materials, and inventory management processes. Translate business requirements into effective SAP solutions aligned with business objectives and industry best practices.
  • Hands-On System Configuration: Independently configure and validate SAP PTP/ MM functionality within SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, including Material Master management.
  • Cross-Functional Integration: Ensure seamless integration of SAP PTP/ MM processes with other functional areas, including Production Planning (PP), Sales and Distribution (SD), Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), and Finance/Controlling (FI/CO).
  • Testing and Quality Assurance: Develop and execute functional and integration test scenarios, support System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), troubleshoot issues, and ensure solutions meet business and functional requirements.
  • Data Migration and Cutover: Guide purchasing and inventory management-related master data migration, including data validation and reconciliation. Plan and execute SAP PTP/ MM cutover activities to ensure successful system deployment.
  • Client Collaboration and Advisory: Work closely with client business stakeholders, IT teams, and project leadership to provide expert functional guidance, resolve design challenges, and drive timely decisions.
  • Documentation and Knowledge Transfer: Prepare and maintain functional design documents, configuration documentation, business process flows, test scripts, and training materials. Conduct knowledge transfer and support end-user training.
  • Post-Go-Live Support: Provide hyper- care and production support, resolve functional issues, and recommend process improvements to optimize SAP purchasing and inventory management operations. Project Delivery Accountability: Take ownership of assigned PTP/ MM deliverables, proactively identify and escalate risks, coordinate dependencies with other workstreams, and ensure high-quality, on-time delivery in accordance with project plans and commitments.

This job can be performed from anywhere in the US.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Experience: Proven hands-on experience implementing and configuring SAP PTP/ MM solutions in SAP S/4HANA, with direct implementation experience in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud.
  • Functional Expertise: Strong functional knowledge of SAP Material management covering areas like materials and supplier master data, Sourcing and supplier selection, Request for Price, Purchase requisitions, Purchasing contracts and Scheduling Agreements, Purchase Order management, consumable purchasing, Service Procurement, subcontracting, Supplier consignment, goods receipt and supplier returns, batch management, Supplier evaluation and performance monitoring, Intercompany stock transfer/Advanced Intercompany Stock transfer, Invoice management, reporting and monitoring for procurement, Core Inventory management, physical inventory and cycle counting.
  • Hands-On Configuration: Demonstrated ability to independently configure, test, troubleshoot, and support SAP PTP/ MM functionality, preferably using SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud configuration tools and capabilities.
  • Implementation Methodology: Proven experience with SAP Activate methodology, including leading Fit-to-Standard workshops, identifying process gaps, and designing solutions aligned with SAP Best Practices.
  • Cross-Functional Integration: Solid understanding of SAP PTP/ MM integration with Production Planning (PP), Sales and Distribution (SD), Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), and Finance/Controlling (FI/CO).
  • Data Migration and Cutover: Practical experience with purchasing, materials, and inventory management-related master data migration, data validation, reconciliation, and execution of system cutover activities.
  • Testing and Deployment: Experience preparing and executing functional and integration testing, supporting SIT/UAT, resolving defects, and providing post-go-live hyper-care support.
  • Business Process Knowledge: Strong understanding of purchasing, materials, and inventory management business processes, with the ability to translate business requirements into practical SAP solutions.
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical capabilities and demonstrated ability to independently investigate functional issues, identify root causes, and develop effective solutions.
  • Communication and Consulting Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to lead client discussions, explain SAP solutions, and effectively collaborate with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Delivery and Accountability: Proven ability to independently manage assigned deliverables, prioritize competing tasks, meet project deadlines, and proactively communicate risks and issues.
  • Teamwork and Quality: Ability to work effectively both independently and within cross-functional, globally distributed teams, with strong attention to detail and commitment to high- quality project delivery.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Participation in at least three full-cycle SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation, preferably with direct responsibility for PTP/ MM configuration and deployment.
  • Experience workflow management.
  • Familiarity with SAP Cloud ALM for managing project deliverables, requirements, testing, and defects.
  • Experience with purchasing and inventory management-related SAP Fiori applications, SAP Central Business Configuration (CBC), and Public Cloud extensibility concepts.
  • SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition certification in Purchasing or a related functional area.

descriptionHtml:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Our goal is to give clients a unique business perspective on how SAP technology can enhance their operations. By leveraging EY’s expertise in SAP, Supply Chain, FICO, BPC, Data & Analytics, Customer Solutions, Technology & Architecture, and SuccessFactors, we assist clients in enhancing performance and increasing productivity.

The Opportunity

Our SAP Procurement practice helps organizations modernize and optimize their source-to-pay operations through SAP S/4HANA. We work with clients to transform procurement processes, improve supplier collaboration, increase operational efficiency, and strengthen controls across purchasing, inventory management, and invoice processing.

As a Senior Technology Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You will interact with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, ensuring that newly implemented technology solutions meet their needs. Your collaboration with technical teams will be essential in designing and delivering effective system architecture solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for delivering top-notch business analysis and system configuration. Your day-to-day will involve:

  • Support SAP Procurement and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstreams within SAP S/4HANA implementation and transformation engagements.
  • Design and configure SAP Materials Management (MM) solutions across purchasing, inventory management, goods movements, and invoice verification processes.
  • Advise clients on procurement leading practices and SAP standard capabilities while balancing business requirements with scalable solutions.
  • Translating complex business requirements into detailed technical specifications
  • Develop functional specifications, process documentation, test scripts, training materials, and other project deliverables.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Sales to help deliver integrated business solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

On a typical engagement, you will work directly with procurement, supply chain, and finance leaders to understand business challenges and translate requirements into scalable SAP solutions. Success in this role requires a combination of functional procurement expertise, SAP configuration experience, and the ability to guide clients through large-scale transformation initiatives.

We are seeking professionals with demonstrated experience in one or more procurement specializations and an understanding of related end-to-end Procure-to-Pay processes.

Key skills include:

  • Deep understanding of Procure-to-Pay business processes and their integration points across the enterprise.
  • Experience designing SAP-enabled procurement solutions that balance business requirements with standard SAP functionality.
  • Ability to lead requirements gathering sessions, process design workshops, fit-gap assessments, and solution validation activities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex business and system challenges.
  • Proven ability to manage workstream deliverables, project risks, stakeholder expectations, and timelines.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

  • A bachelor's degree with at least 2-4 years of SAP Procurement, Supply Chain, or consulting experience.
  • Experience supporting at least one full lifecycle SAP implementation, preferably an SAP S/4HANA transformation.
  • Hands-on experience in one or more SAP Procurement specializations, including:
    • SAP S/4HANA Procurement (Direct Materials)
    • SAP Invoice Management and Accounts Payable Integration
    • SAP Inventory Management
    • SAP Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, or Contracts
    • SAP Ariba Buying and Invoicing
    • SAP Ariba Integration, including Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG)
  • Experience configuring SAP MM procurement processes, including material master, business partner (vendor), RFQs, contracts, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, approval workflows, output management, goods receipts, stock transport orders, ALE, and IDocs.
  • Experience in one or more SAP Ariba solutions, including Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, Contracts, Buying and Invoicing, Supply Chain Collaboration, Commerce Automation, or Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG).
  • Knowledge of integration points with Accounts Payable, Production Planning, Sales & Distribution, and other related SAP modules.
  • Experience leading the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstream, including facilitating solution design workshops and developing proof of concepts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills.
  • Knowledge of leading practices, benchmarking, peer company environments and prior advisory experience relevant to industry specific finance and technology functions.
  • A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

  • Previous consulting experience within a professional services environment.
  • SAP S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement certification or other relevant SAP certifications.

What We Look For

We seek individuals who are proactive, innovative, and eager to contribute to team success. Top performers are those who demonstrate strong analytical skills, the ability to communicate effectively, and a passion for technology and its impact on business.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

  • The salary range for this job is:
    • New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $122,900 to $204,900
    • Bay Area California offices – $128,100 to $213,400
    • All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $102,500 to $187,900
  • Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

  • To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.
  • EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.
  • For those living in California, please click here for additional information.
  • At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.
