As a NetSuite Senior Consultant at Deloitte, you will help clients design and implement NetSuite solutions that align with their business goals and deliver measurable results. This role fits professionals across core financial accounting, procure-to-pay, or order-to-cash implementation backgrounds. Join a team that is transforming how finance and accounting organizations operate by streamlining processes, improving reporting, and building lasting client relationships along the way.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant, you will implement and deploy NetSuite solutions:

  • Work within an engagement team, identifying business requirements, managing functional design, prototyping, and designing processes
  • Provide NetSuite consulting expertise, using industry experience, business analysis, and best practices to address clients' most complex requirements
  • Implement and deploy NetSuite solutions that accommodate unique industry, business, and regulatory requirements
  • Conduct business process mapping and requirements-gathering sessions with clients, on-site and remote
  • Prepare Business Requirements and Technical Scoping Documents for client approval
  • Build, develop, and test functional designs and scripted, customized solutions for business components and prototypes
  • Drive test planning, execution, and optimization support
  • Troubleshoot configuration issues and provide ongoing post-implementation support to optimize user adoption

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to build and maintain strong client and team relationships
  • Comfort managing multiple priorities across concurrent workstreams
  • Willingness to mentor and support the development of junior team members

The team

Our NetSuite practice helps upper mid-market and high-growth organizations modernize their financial and operational systems on a unified cloud platform. We work alongside clients to streamline processes, improve reporting, and support their next stage of growth. We're just as invested in our own team's growth, with hands-on learning and mentorship built into every engagement.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3+ years of relevant consulting or industry experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Record to Report: General Ledger, Consolidations, Multibook accounting, CTA Analysis, FX variances, and/or Financial Reporting
    • Procure to Pay: Accounts Payable
    • Order to Cash: Accounts Receivable
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Information Systems, or another related field
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
Preferred:

  • Certified NetSuite Professional (NetSuite Administrator / Suite Foundation / ERP Consultant / Multi-Book Consultant / ARM/Revenue Management)
  • Full lifecycle NetSuite implementation experience, including Design, Build, Test, Deploy, and Support phases
  • Experience with NetSuite integrations, customizations, and ERP data migration/cutover
  • Previous "Big 4" or large consulting firm experience
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage teams and stakeholders across global locations
  • Advanced degree in a relevant field
  • Eagerness to mentor junior staff

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,700 to $218,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Our goal is to give clients a unique business perspective on how SAP technology can enhance their operations. By leveraging EY’s expertise in SAP, Supply Chain, FICO, BPC, Data & Analytics, Customer Solutions, Technology & Architecture, and SuccessFactors, we assist clients in enhancing performance and increasing productivity.

The Opportunity

Our SAP Procurement practice helps organizations modernize and optimize their source-to-pay operations through SAP S/4HANA. We work with clients to transform procurement processes, improve supplier collaboration, increase operational efficiency, and strengthen controls across purchasing, inventory management, and invoice processing.

As a Senior Technology Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You will interact with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, ensuring that newly implemented technology solutions meet their needs. Your collaboration with technical teams will be essential in designing and delivering effective system architecture solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for delivering top-notch business analysis and system configuration. Your day-to-day will involve:

  • Support SAP Procurement and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstreams within SAP S/4HANA implementation and transformation engagements.
  • Design and configure SAP Materials Management (MM) solutions across purchasing, inventory management, goods movements, and invoice verification processes.
  • Advise clients on procurement leading practices and SAP standard capabilities while balancing business requirements with scalable solutions.
  • Translating complex business requirements into detailed technical specifications
  • Develop functional specifications, process documentation, test scripts, training materials, and other project deliverables.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Sales to help deliver integrated business solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

On a typical engagement, you will work directly with procurement, supply chain, and finance leaders to understand business challenges and translate requirements into scalable SAP solutions. Success in this role requires a combination of functional procurement expertise, SAP configuration experience, and the ability to guide clients through large-scale transformation initiatives.

We are seeking professionals with demonstrated experience in one or more procurement specializations and an understanding of related end-to-end Procure-to-Pay processes.

Key skills include:

  • Deep understanding of Procure-to-Pay business processes and their integration points across the enterprise.
  • Experience designing SAP-enabled procurement solutions that balance business requirements with standard SAP functionality.
  • Ability to lead requirements gathering sessions, process design workshops, fit-gap assessments, and solution validation activities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex business and system challenges.
  • Proven ability to manage workstream deliverables, project risks, stakeholder expectations, and timelines.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

  • A bachelor's degree with at least 2-4 years of SAP Procurement, Supply Chain, or consulting experience.
  • Experience supporting at least one full lifecycle SAP implementation, preferably an SAP S/4HANA transformation.
  • Hands-on experience in one or more SAP Procurement specializations, including:
    • SAP S/4HANA Procurement (Direct Materials)
    • SAP Invoice Management and Accounts Payable Integration
    • SAP Inventory Management
    • SAP Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, or Contracts
    • SAP Ariba Buying and Invoicing
    • SAP Ariba Integration, including Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG)
  • Experience configuring SAP MM procurement processes, including material master, business partner (vendor), RFQs, contracts, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, approval workflows, output management, goods receipts, stock transport orders, ALE, and IDocs.
  • Experience in one or more SAP Ariba solutions, including Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, Contracts, Buying and Invoicing, Supply Chain Collaboration, Commerce Automation, or Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG).
  • Knowledge of integration points with Accounts Payable, Production Planning, Sales & Distribution, and other related SAP modules.
  • Experience leading the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstream, including facilitating solution design workshops and developing proof of concepts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills.
  • Knowledge of leading practices, benchmarking, peer company environments and prior advisory experience relevant to industry specific finance and technology functions.
  • A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

  • Previous consulting experience within a professional services environment.
  • SAP S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement certification or other relevant SAP certifications.

What We Look For

We seek individuals who are proactive, innovative, and eager to contribute to team success. Top performers are those who demonstrate strong analytical skills, the ability to communicate effectively, and a passion for technology and its impact on business.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

  • The salary range for this job is:
    • New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $122,900 to $204,900
    • Bay Area California offices – $128,100 to $213,400
    • All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $102,500 to $187,900
  • Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

  • To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.
  • EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.
  • For those living in California, please click here for additional information.
  • At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

All in to shape the future with confidence.

Our SAP Procurement practice helps organizations modernize and optimize their source-to-pay operations through SAP S/4HANA. As a Senior Technology Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You will interact with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, ensuring that newly implemented technology solutions meet their needs. Your collaboration with technical teams will be essential in designing and delivering effective system architecture solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for delivering top-notch business analysis and system configuration. Your day-to-day will involve:

  • Support SAP Procurement and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstreams within SAP S/4HANA implementation and transformation engagements.
  • Design and configure SAP Materials Management (MM) solutions across purchasing, inventory management, goods movements, and invoice verification processes.
  • Advise clients on procurement leading practices and SAP standard capabilities while balancing business requirements with scalable solutions.
  • Translating complex business requirements into detailed technical specifications
  • Develop functional specifications, process documentation, test scripts, training materials, and other project deliverables.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Sales to help deliver integrated business solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

On a typical engagement, you will work directly with procurement, supply chain, and finance leaders to understand business challenges and translate requirements into scalable SAP solutions. Success in this role requires a combination of functional procurement expertise, SAP configuration experience, and the ability to guide clients through large-scale transformation initiatives.

We are seeking professionals with demonstrated experience in one or more procurement specializations and an understanding of related end-to-end Procure-to-Pay processes.

Key skills include:

  • Deep understanding of Procure-to-Pay business processes and their integration points across the enterprise.
  • Experience designing SAP-enabled procurement solutions that balance business requirements with standard SAP functionality.
  • Ability to lead requirements gathering sessions, process design workshops, fit-gap assessments, and solution validation activities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex business and system challenges.
  • Proven ability to manage workstream deliverables, project risks, stakeholder expectations, and timelines.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

  • A bachelor's degree with at least 2-4 years of SAP Procurement, Supply Chain, or consulting experience.
  • Experience supporting at least one full lifecycle SAP implementation, preferably an SAP S/4HANA transformation.
  • Hands-on experience in one or more SAP Procurement specializations, including:
    • SAP S/4HANA Procurement (Direct Materials)
    • SAP Invoice Management and Accounts Payable Integration
    • SAP Inventory Management
    • SAP Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, or Contracts
    • SAP Ariba Buying and Invoicing
    • SAP Ariba Integration, including Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG)
  • Experience configuring SAP MM procurement processes, including material master, business partner (vendor), RFQs, contracts, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, approval workflows, output management, goods receipts, stock transport orders, ALE, and IDocs.
  • Experience in one or more SAP Ariba solutions, including Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, Contracts, Buying and Invoicing, Supply Chain Collaboration, Commerce Automation, or Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG).
  • Knowledge of integration points with Accounts Payable, Production Planning, Sales & Distribution, and other related SAP modules.
  • Experience leading the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstream, including facilitating solution design workshops and developing proof of concepts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills.
  • Knowledge of leading practices, benchmarking, peer company environments and prior advisory experience relevant to industry specific finance and technology functions.
  • A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.

  • Previous consulting experience within a professional services environment.

We work with clients to transform procurement processes, improve supplier collaboration, increase operational efficiency, and strengthen controls across purchasing, inventory management, and invoice processing.

As a Senior Technology Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You will interact with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, ensuring that newly implemented technology solutions meet their needs. Your collaboration with technical teams will be essential in designing and delivering effective system architecture solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for delivering top-notch business analysis and system configuration. Your day-to-day will involve:

  • Support SAP Procurement and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstreams within SAP S/4HANA implementation and transformation engagements.
  • Design and configure SAP Materials Management (MM) solutions across purchasing, inventory management, goods movements, and invoice verification processes.
  • Advise clients on procurement leading practices and SAP standard capabilities while balancing business requirements with scalable solutions.
  • Translating complex business requirements into detailed technical specifications
  • Develop functional specifications, process documentation, test scripts, training materials, and other project deliverables.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Sales to help deliver integrated business solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

On a typical engagement, you will work directly with procurement, supply chain, and finance leaders to understand business challenges and translate requirements into scalable SAP solutions. Success in this role requires a combination of functional procurement expertise, SAP configuration experience, and the ability to guide clients through large-scale transformation initiatives.

We are seeking professionals with demonstrated experience in one or more procurement specializations and an understanding of related end-to-end Procure-to-Pay processes.

Key skills include:

  • Deep understanding of Procure-to-Pay business processes and their integration points across the enterprise.
  • Experience designing SAP-enabled procurement solutions that balance business requirements with standard SAP functionality.
  • Ability to lead requirements gathering sessions, process design workshops, fit-gap assessments, and solution validation activities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex business and system challenges.
  • Proven ability to manage workstream deliverables, project risks, stakeholder expectations, and timelines.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

  • A bachelor's degree with at least 2-4 years of SAP Procurement, Supply Chain, or consulting experience.
  • Experience supporting at least one full lifecycle SAP implementation, preferably an SAP S/4HANA transformation.
  • Hands-on experience in one or more SAP Procurement specializations, including:
    • SAP S/4HANA Procurement (Direct Materials)
    • SAP Invoice Management and Accounts Payable Integration
    • SAP Inventory Management
    • SAP Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, or Contracts
    • SAP Ariba Buying and Invoicing
    • SAP Ariba Integration, including Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG)
  • Experience configuring SAP MM procurement processes, including material master, business partner (vendor), RFQs, contracts, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, approval workflows, output management, goods receipts, stock transport orders, ALE, and IDocs.
  • Experience in one or more SAP Ariba solutions, including Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, Contracts, Buying and Invoicing, Supply Chain Collaboration, Commerce Automation, or Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG).
  • Knowledge of integration points with Accounts Payable, Production Planning, Sales & Distribution, and other related SAP modules.
  • Experience leading the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstream, including facilitating solution design workshops and developing proof of concepts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills.
  • Knowledge of leading practices, benchmarking, peer company environments and prior advisory experience relevant to industry specific finance and technology functions.
  • A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

  • Previous consulting experience within a professional services environment.
  • SAP S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement certification or other relevant SAP certifications.

We seek individuals who are proactive, innovative, and eager to contribute to team success. Top performers are those who demonstrate strong analytical skills, the ability to communicate effectively, and a passion for technology and its impact on business.

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

  • Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Our goal is to give clients a unique business perspective on how SAP technology can enhance their operations. The Opportunity

Our SAP Procurement practice helps organizations modernize and optimize their source-to-pay operations through SAP S/4HANA. We work with clients to transform procurement processes, improve supplier collaboration, increase operational efficiency, and strengthen controls across purchasing, inventory management, and invoice processing.

As a Senior Technology Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You will interact with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, ensuring that newly implemented technology solutions meet their needs. Your collaboration with technical teams will be essential in designing and delivering effective system architecture solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for delivering top-notch business analysis and system configuration. Your day-to-day will involve:

  • Support SAP Procurement and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstreams within SAP S/4HANA implementation and transformation engagements.
  • Design and configure SAP Materials Management (MM) solutions across purchasing, inventory management, goods movements, and invoice verification processes.
  • Advise clients on procurement leading practices and SAP standard capabilities while balancing business requirements with scalable solutions.
  • Translating complex business requirements into detailed technical specifications
  • Develop functional specifications, process documentation, test scripts, training materials, and other project deliverables.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Sales to help deliver integrated business solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

On a typical engagement, you will work directly with procurement, supply chain, and finance leaders to understand business challenges and translate requirements into scalable SAP solutions. Success in this role requires a combination of functional procurement expertise, SAP configuration experience, and the ability to guide clients through large-scale transformation initiatives.

We are seeking professionals with demonstrated experience in one or more procurement specializations and an understanding of related end-to-end Procure-to-Pay processes.

Key skills include:

  • Deep understanding of Procure-to-Pay business processes and their integration points across the enterprise.
  • Experience designing SAP-enabled procurement solutions that balance business requirements with standard SAP functionality.
  • Ability to lead requirements gathering sessions, process design workshops, fit-gap assessments, and solution validation activities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex business and system challenges.
  • Proven ability to manage workstream deliverables, project risks, stakeholder expectations, and timelines.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

  • A bachelor's degree with at least 2-4 years of SAP Procurement, Supply Chain, or consulting experience.
  • Experience supporting at least one full lifecycle SAP implementation, preferably an SAP S/4HANA transformation.
  • Hands-on experience in one or more SAP Procurement specializations, including:
    • SAP S/4HANA Procurement (Direct Materials)
    • SAP Invoice Management and Accounts Payable Integration
    • SAP Inventory Management
    • SAP Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, or Contracts
    • SAP Ariba Buying and Invoicing
    • SAP Ariba Integration, including Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG)
  • Experience configuring SAP MM procurement processes, including material master, business partner (vendor), RFQs, contracts, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, approval workflows, output management, goods receipts, stock transport orders, ALE, and IDocs.
  • Experience in one or more SAP Ariba solutions, including Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, Contracts, Buying and Invoicing, Supply Chain Collaboration, Commerce Automation, or Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG).
  • Knowledge of integration points with Accounts Payable, Production Planning, Sales & Distribution, and other related SAP modules.
  • Experience leading the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstream, including facilitating solution design workshops and developing proof of concepts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills.
  • Knowledge of leading practices, benchmarking, peer company environments and prior advisory experience relevant to industry specific finance and technology functions.
  • A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

  • Previous consulting experience within a professional services environment.
  • SAP S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement certification or other relevant SAP certifications.

What We Look For

We seek individuals who are proactive, innovative, and eager to contribute to team success. Top performers are those who demonstrate strong analytical skills, the ability to communicate effectively, and a passion for technology and its impact on business.

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

  • Integration experience with MM, SD, EWM, QM, PM/EAM, Product Costing, TM, and SAP Digital Manufacturing or third-party MES.
  • Experience supporting data migration, interfaces, functional specifications, SIT, UAT, cutover, go-live, and hypercare.
  • Strong knowledge of SAP Fiori, SAP Activate, global template deployment, and manufacturing process standardization.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Manufacturing and Production Planning solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization for the Helix transformation program.
  • Facilitate fit-to-standard workshops and translate business requirements into scalable global manufacturing process designs.
  • Design Discrete Manufacturing processes covering make-to-stock, make-to-order, engineer-to-order, production orders, confirmations, backflushing, and component staging.
  • Design Process Manufacturing processes covering master recipes, resources, process orders, phases, process instructions, co-products, by-products, and batch execution.
  • Design Repetitive Manufacturing processes including rate-based planning, production versions, reporting points, planned orders, and material staging.
  • Define planning processes for demand management, MRP Live, lot sizing, scheduling, capacity evaluation, production leveling, and exception management.
  • Lead PP/DS solution design for finite scheduling, sequencing, setup optimization, heuristics, pegging, and planner alerts.
  • Define Batch Management, classification, batch determination, shelf-life, genealogy, and traceability requirements across manufacturing and quality processes.
  • Own cross-functional integration with MM, SD, EWM, QM, PM/EAM, Product Costing, TM, SAP Digital Manufacturing, and shop-floor systems.
  • Guide MES, SCADA, PLC, and equipment integration requirements in collaboration with Digital Manufacturing, BTP, and integration teams.
  • Prepare functional specifications, test scenarios, security requirements, conversion rules, cutover plans, operating procedures, and training inputs.
  • Lead defect resolution, deployment readiness, mock cutovers, production cutover, hypercare, and transition to support.
  • Coordinate onshore and offshore teams, manage dependencies and risks, and communicate decisions and progress to business and program stakeholders.

descriptionHtml:
Today's finance leaders face increasing pressure to modernize operations, improve reporting accuracy, and scale efficiently as their businesses grow. As a NetSuite Senior Consultant at Deloitte, you will help clients design and implement NetSuite solutions that align with their business goals and deliver measurable results. This role fits professionals across core financial accounting, procure-to-pay, or order-to-cash implementation backgrounds. Join a team that is transforming how finance and accounting organizations operate by streamlining processes, improving reporting, and building lasting client relationships along the way.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant, you will implement and deploy NetSuite solutions:

  • Work within an engagement team, identifying business requirements, managing functional design, prototyping, and designing processes
  • Provide NetSuite consulting expertise, using industry experience, business analysis, and best practices to address clients' most complex requirements
  • Implement and deploy NetSuite solutions that accommodate unique industry, business, and regulatory requirements
  • Conduct business process mapping and requirements-gathering sessions with clients, on-site and remote
  • Prepare Business Requirements and Technical Scoping Documents for client approval
  • Build, develop, and test functional designs and scripted, customized solutions for business components and prototypes
  • Drive test planning, execution, and optimization support
  • Troubleshoot configuration issues and provide ongoing post-implementation support to optimize user adoption

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to build and maintain strong client and team relationships
  • Comfort managing multiple priorities across concurrent workstreams
  • Willingness to mentor and support the development of junior team members

The team

Our NetSuite practice helps upper mid-market and high-growth organizations modernize their financial and operational systems on a unified cloud platform. We work alongside clients to streamline processes, improve reporting, and support their next stage of growth. We're just as invested in our own team's growth, with hands-on learning and mentorship built into every engagement.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3+ years of relevant consulting or industry experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Record to Report: General Ledger, Consolidations, Multibook accounting, CTA Analysis, FX variances, and/or Financial Reporting
    • Procure to Pay: Accounts Payable
    • Order to Cash: Accounts Receivable
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Information Systems, or another related field
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
Preferred:

  • Certified NetSuite Professional (NetSuite Administrator / Suite Foundation / ERP Consultant / Multi-Book Consultant / ARM/Revenue Management)
  • Full lifecycle NetSuite implementation experience, including Design, Build, Test, Deploy, and Support phases
  • Experience with NetSuite integrations, customizations, and ERP data migration/cutover
  • Previous "Big 4" or large consulting firm experience
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage teams and stakeholders across global locations
  • Advanced degree in a relevant field
  • Eagerness to mentor junior staff

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. descriptionHtml:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Our goal is to give clients a unique business perspective on how SAP technology can enhance their operations. By leveraging EY’s expertise in SAP, Supply Chain, FICO, BPC, Data & Analytics, Customer Solutions, Technology & Architecture, and SuccessFactors, we assist clients in enhancing performance and increasing productivity.

The Opportunity

Our SAP Procurement practice helps organizations modernize and optimize their source-to-pay operations through SAP S/4HANA. We work with clients to transform procurement processes, improve supplier collaboration, increase operational efficiency, and strengthen controls across purchasing, inventory management, and invoice processing.

As a Senior Technology Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You will interact with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, ensuring that newly implemented technology solutions meet their needs. Your collaboration with technical teams will be essential in designing and delivering effective system architecture solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for delivering top-notch business analysis and system configuration. Your day-to-day will involve:

  • Support SAP Procurement and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstreams within SAP S/4HANA implementation and transformation engagements.
  • Design and configure SAP Materials Management (MM) solutions across purchasing, inventory management, goods movements, and invoice verification processes.
  • Advise clients on procurement leading practices and SAP standard capabilities while balancing business requirements with scalable solutions.
  • Translating complex business requirements into detailed technical specifications
  • Develop functional specifications, process documentation, test scripts, training materials, and other project deliverables.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Sales to help deliver integrated business solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

On a typical engagement, you will work directly with procurement, supply chain, and finance leaders to understand business challenges and translate requirements into scalable SAP solutions. Success in this role requires a combination of functional procurement expertise, SAP configuration experience, and the ability to guide clients through large-scale transformation initiatives.

We are seeking professionals with demonstrated experience in one or more procurement specializations and an understanding of related end-to-end Procure-to-Pay processes.

Key skills include:

  • Deep understanding of Procure-to-Pay business processes and their integration points across the enterprise.
  • Experience designing SAP-enabled procurement solutions that balance business requirements with standard SAP functionality.
  • Ability to lead requirements gathering sessions, process design workshops, fit-gap assessments, and solution validation activities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex business and system challenges.
  • Proven ability to manage workstream deliverables, project risks, stakeholder expectations, and timelines.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

  • A bachelor's degree with at least 2-4 years of SAP Procurement, Supply Chain, or consulting experience.
  • Experience supporting at least one full lifecycle SAP implementation, preferably an SAP S/4HANA transformation.
  • Hands-on experience in one or more SAP Procurement specializations, including:
    • SAP S/4HANA Procurement (Direct Materials)
    • SAP Invoice Management and Accounts Payable Integration
    • SAP Inventory Management
    • SAP Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, or Contracts
    • SAP Ariba Buying and Invoicing
    • SAP Ariba Integration, including Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG)
  • Experience configuring SAP MM procurement processes, including material master, business partner (vendor), RFQs, contracts, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, approval workflows, output management, goods receipts, stock transport orders, ALE, and IDocs.
  • Experience in one or more SAP Ariba solutions, including Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, Contracts, Buying and Invoicing, Supply Chain Collaboration, Commerce Automation, or Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG).
  • Knowledge of integration points with Accounts Payable, Production Planning, Sales & Distribution, and other related SAP modules.
  • Experience leading the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstream, including facilitating solution design workshops and developing proof of concepts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills.
  • Knowledge of leading practices, benchmarking, peer company environments and prior advisory experience relevant to industry specific finance and technology functions.
  • A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

  • Previous consulting experience within a professional services environment.
  • SAP S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement certification or other relevant SAP certifications.

What We Look For

We seek individuals who are proactive, innovative, and eager to contribute to team success. Top performers are those who demonstrate strong analytical skills, the ability to communicate effectively, and a passion for technology and its impact on business.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

  • The salary range for this job is:
    • New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $122,900 to $204,900
    • Bay Area California offices – $128,100 to $213,400
    • All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $102,500 to $187,900
  • Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

  • To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.
  • EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.
  • For those living in California, please click here for additional information.
  • At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.

    • SAP Ariba Buying and Invoicing

  • Knowledge of leading practices, benchmarking, peer company environments and prior advisory experience relevant to industry specific finance and technology functions.
  • A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.

  • Previous consulting experience within a professional services environment.
  • SAP S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement certification or other relevant SAP certifications.

We seek individuals who are proactive, innovative, and eager to contribute to team success. Top performers are those who demonstrate strong analytical skills, the ability to communicate effectively, and a passion for technology and its impact on business.

Role: SAP MM/EWM Consultant– ECC

Location: Austin TX

Duration: Fulltime

Work Type: Hybrid ( 3 Days Onsite)


We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior SAP MM/EWM Consultant to join our team. The ideal candidate will possess extensive knowledge in SAP Material Management (MM) and Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) within both SAP ECC and SAP S/4 HANA environments. This role is critical for our ongoing projects, particularly in facilitating the migration from ECC to S/4 HANA. The consultant will be responsible for configuring and optimizing our SAP MM/EWM solutions to meet business needs and enhance operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

Lead the configuration and implementation of SAP MM and EWM modules, ensuring alignment with business processes and requirements.

Conduct thorough analysis of existing ECC systems and develop migration strategies to transition to SAP S/4 HANA.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, design solutions, and deliver high-quality SAP configurations.

Provide expert guidance and support during the testing phase, ensuring that all configurations meet business expectations.

Develop and maintain documentation related to system configurations, processes, and user guides.

Train and mentor junior consultants and end-users on SAP MM/EWM functionalities and best practices.

Stay updated with the latest SAP technologies and trends to continuously improve system performance and user experience.

Mandatory Skills

Proven expertise in SAP Material Management (MM) and Extended Warehouse Management (EWM).

Strong experience with SAP ECC and SAP S/4 HANA, particularly in migration projects.

In-depth knowledge of SAP configuration and integration processes.

Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with stakeholders.

Preferred Skills

Experience with SAP Fiori and other SAP UI technologies.

Knowledge of additional SAP modules such as SD, PP, or WM.

Familiarity with Agile methodologies and project management tools.

Certifications in SAP MM/EWM or related fields.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.

10-15 years of relevant experience in SAP MM/EWM consulting.

Proven track record of successful SAP implementations and migrations.

Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

If you are a dedicated professional with a passion for SAP solutions and a desire to drive business success, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.


The pay range for this role is USD $140,000- $145,000 per annum including any bonuses or variable pay. descriptionHtml:
Today's finance leaders face increasing pressure to modernize operations, improve reporting accuracy, and scale efficiently as their businesses grow. As a NetSuite Senior Consultant at Deloitte, you will help clients design and implement NetSuite solutions that align with their business goals and deliver measurable results. This role fits professionals across core financial accounting, procure-to-pay, or order-to-cash implementation backgrounds. Join a team that is transforming how finance and accounting organizations operate by streamlining processes, improving reporting, and building lasting client relationships along the way.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant, you will implement and deploy NetSuite solutions:

  • Work within an engagement team, identifying business requirements, managing functional design, prototyping, and designing processes
  • Provide NetSuite consulting expertise, using industry experience, business analysis, and best practices to address clients' most complex requirements
  • Implement and deploy NetSuite solutions that accommodate unique industry, business, and regulatory requirements
  • Conduct business process mapping and requirements-gathering sessions with clients, on-site and remote
  • Prepare Business Requirements and Technical Scoping Documents for client approval
  • Build, develop, and test functional designs and scripted, customized solutions for business components and prototypes
  • Drive test planning, execution, and optimization support
  • Troubleshoot configuration issues and provide ongoing post-implementation support to optimize user adoption

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to build and maintain strong client and team relationships
  • Comfort managing multiple priorities across concurrent workstreams
  • Willingness to mentor and support the development of junior team members

The team

Our NetSuite practice helps upper mid-market and high-growth organizations modernize their financial and operational systems on a unified cloud platform. We work alongside clients to streamline processes, improve reporting, and support their next stage of growth. We're just as invested in our own team's growth, with hands-on learning and mentorship built into every engagement.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3+ years of relevant consulting or industry experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Record to Report: General Ledger, Consolidations, Multibook accounting, CTA Analysis, FX variances, and/or Financial Reporting
    • Procure to Pay: Accounts Payable
    • Order to Cash: Accounts Receivable
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Information Systems, or another related field
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
Preferred:

  • Certified NetSuite Professional (NetSuite Administrator / Suite Foundation / ERP Consultant / Multi-Book Consultant / ARM/Revenue Management)
  • Full lifecycle NetSuite implementation experience, including Design, Build, Test, Deploy, and Support phases
  • Experience with NetSuite integrations, customizations, and ERP data migration/cutover
  • Previous "Big 4" or large consulting firm experience
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage teams and stakeholders across global locations
  • Advanced degree in a relevant field
  • Eagerness to mentor junior staff

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,700 to $218,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Our goal is to give clients a unique business perspective on how SAP technology can enhance their operations. By leveraging EY’s expertise in SAP, Supply Chain, FICO, BPC, Data & Analytics, Customer Solutions, Technology & Architecture, and SuccessFactors, we assist clients in enhancing performance and increasing productivity.

The Opportunity

Our SAP Procurement practice helps organizations modernize and optimize their source-to-pay operations through SAP S/4HANA. We work with clients to transform procurement processes, improve supplier collaboration, increase operational efficiency, and strengthen controls across purchasing, inventory management, and invoice processing.

As a Senior Technology Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You will interact with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, ensuring that newly implemented technology solutions meet their needs. Your collaboration with technical teams will be essential in designing and delivering effective system architecture solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for delivering top-notch business analysis and system configuration. Your day-to-day will involve:

  • Support SAP Procurement and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstreams within SAP S/4HANA implementation and transformation engagements.
  • Design and configure SAP Materials Management (MM) solutions across purchasing, inventory management, goods movements, and invoice verification processes.
  • Advise clients on procurement leading practices and SAP standard capabilities while balancing business requirements with scalable solutions.
  • Translating complex business requirements into detailed technical specifications
  • Develop functional specifications, process documentation, test scripts, training materials, and other project deliverables.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Sales to help deliver integrated business solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

On a typical engagement, you will work directly with procurement, supply chain, and finance leaders to understand business challenges and translate requirements into scalable SAP solutions. Success in this role requires a combination of functional procurement expertise, SAP configuration experience, and the ability to guide clients through large-scale transformation initiatives.

We are seeking professionals with demonstrated experience in one or more procurement specializations and an understanding of related end-to-end Procure-to-Pay processes.

Key skills include:

  • Deep understanding of Procure-to-Pay business processes and their integration points across the enterprise.
  • Experience designing SAP-enabled procurement solutions that balance business requirements with standard SAP functionality.
  • Ability to lead requirements gathering sessions, process design workshops, fit-gap assessments, and solution validation activities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex business and system challenges.
  • Proven ability to manage workstream deliverables, project risks, stakeholder expectations, and timelines.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

  • A bachelor's degree with at least 2-4 years of SAP Procurement, Supply Chain, or consulting experience.
  • Experience supporting at least one full lifecycle SAP implementation, preferably an SAP S/4HANA transformation.
  • Hands-on experience in one or more SAP Procurement specializations, including:
    • SAP S/4HANA Procurement (Direct Materials)
    • SAP Invoice Management and Accounts Payable Integration
    • SAP Inventory Management
    • SAP Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, or Contracts
    • SAP Ariba Buying and Invoicing
    • SAP Ariba Integration, including Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG)
  • Experience configuring SAP MM procurement processes, including material master, business partner (vendor), RFQs, contracts, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, approval workflows, output management, goods receipts, stock transport orders, ALE, and IDocs.
  • Experience in one or more SAP Ariba solutions, including Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, Contracts, Buying and Invoicing, Supply Chain Collaboration, Commerce Automation, or Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG).
  • Knowledge of integration points with Accounts Payable, Production Planning, Sales & Distribution, and other related SAP modules.
  • Experience leading the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstream, including facilitating solution design workshops and developing proof of concepts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills.
  • Knowledge of leading practices, benchmarking, peer company environments and prior advisory experience relevant to industry specific finance and technology functions.
  • A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

  • Previous consulting experience within a professional services environment.
  • SAP S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement certification or other relevant SAP certifications.

What We Look For

We seek individuals who are proactive, innovative, and eager to contribute to team success. Top performers are those who demonstrate strong analytical skills, the ability to communicate effectively, and a passion for technology and its impact on business.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

  • The salary range for this job is:
    • New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $122,900 to $204,900
    • Bay Area California offices – $128,100 to $213,400
    • All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $102,500 to $187,900
  • Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

  • To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.
  • EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.
  • For those living in California, please click here for additional information.
  • At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.

descriptionHtml:
Today's finance leaders face increasing pressure to modernize operations, improve reporting accuracy, and scale efficiently as their businesses grow. As a NetSuite Senior Consultant at Deloitte, you will help clients design and implement NetSuite solutions that align with their business goals and deliver measurable results. This role fits professionals across core financial accounting, procure-to-pay, or order-to-cash implementation backgrounds. Join a team that is transforming how finance and accounting organizations operate by streamlining processes, improving reporting, and building lasting client relationships along the way.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant, you will implement and deploy NetSuite solutions:

  • Work within an engagement team, identifying business requirements, managing functional design, prototyping, and designing processes
  • Provide NetSuite consulting expertise, using industry experience, business analysis, and best practices to address clients' most complex requirements
  • Implement and deploy NetSuite solutions that accommodate unique industry, business, and regulatory requirements
  • Conduct business process mapping and requirements-gathering sessions with clients, on-site and remote
  • Prepare Business Requirements and Technical Scoping Documents for client approval
  • Build, develop, and test functional designs and scripted, customized solutions for business components and prototypes
  • Drive test planning, execution, and optimization support
  • Troubleshoot configuration issues and provide ongoing post-implementation support to optimize user adoption

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to build and maintain strong client and team relationships
  • Comfort managing multiple priorities across concurrent workstreams
  • Willingness to mentor and support the development of junior team members

The team

Our NetSuite practice helps upper mid-market and high-growth organizations modernize their financial and operational systems on a unified cloud platform. We work alongside clients to streamline processes, improve reporting, and support their next stage of growth. We're just as invested in our own team's growth, with hands-on learning and mentorship built into every engagement.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3+ years of relevant consulting or industry experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Record to Report: General Ledger, Consolidations, Multibook accounting, CTA Analysis, FX variances, and/or Financial Reporting
    • Procure to Pay: Accounts Payable
    • Order to Cash: Accounts Receivable
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Information Systems, or another related field
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
Preferred:

  • Certified NetSuite Professional (NetSuite Administrator / Suite Foundation / ERP Consultant / Multi-Book Consultant / ARM/Revenue Management)
  • Full lifecycle NetSuite implementation experience, including Design, Build, Test, Deploy, and Support phases
  • Experience with NetSuite integrations, customizations, and ERP data migration/cutover
  • Previous "Big 4" or large consulting firm experience
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage teams and stakeholders across global locations
  • Advanced degree in a relevant field
  • Eagerness to mentor junior staff

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,700 to $218,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

descriptionHtml:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced SAP EWM Consultant with a proven track record in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition implementations.

In this role, you will lead the end-to-end implementation, configuration, and optimization of Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) solutions. Unlike traditional on-premise roles, this position requires a strong focus on SAP Activate methodology, Fit-to-Standard delivery model, and SAP Central Business Configuration (CBC) with clean core extension principles. You will collaborate closely with clients to streamline supply chain operations, enhance inventory visibility, and maximize warehouse efficiency.

Fit-to-Standard & Solution Design: Lead and facilitate Fit-to-Standard workshops to analyze business requirements against SAP standard cloud processes. Guide clients toward standard public cloud solutions rather than heavy customizations.

Cloud Configuration: Configure SAP S/4HANA Cloud Warehouse Management capabilities using SAP Central Business Configuration (CBC) and standard browser apps. Manage standard cloud extensions without utilizing classic SPRO/ABAP modifications.

Core EWM Implementation: Design and configure core EWM processes, including Inbound Logistics, Outbound Logistics, Internal Warehouse Movements, Putaway & Picking strategies, Inventory Management, Handling Units, and Replenishment.

Integration & Systems Management: Ensure seamless system integration using qRFC, CIF, and cloud APIs to bridge the EWM footprint with core ERP and other cloud solutions. Oversee standard data migration concepts utilizing SAP toolsets.

Testing & Deployment: Prepare and manage test deliverables (test plans, test cases, and results) via standard quality tools. Support the project through deployment, cutover, and post-go-live hyper care optimization.

Client Collaboration: Serve as a trusted advisor and "Template Defender," helping stakeholders adopt native cloud best practices and manage organizational change.

This job can be performed from anywhere in the US.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • SAP Experience: Minimum of 5–7+ years of SAP EWM consulting experience, with strong functional knowledge of supply chain operations.
  • Public Cloud Expertise: Successfully completed at least 1–2 full-lifecycle implementations of SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition (EWM module).
  • Methodology: Practical experience with SAP Activate methodology phases (Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, Run).
  • Technical Understanding: Firm grasp of clean core concepts, standard cloud extensibility, and the lack of traditional SPRO/custom ABAP environments in public cloud setups.
  • Soft Skills: Exceptional client-facing, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to work independently within remote or hybrid consulting teams.

You are an individual who has technical and functional expertise of the SAP FICO module which allows you to solve problems and deliver optimum solutions for the client. You will act as both a strategic advisor and hands-on configurator, delivering best-in-class solutions aligned with SAP Activate methodology and SAP’s fit-to-standard approach. You have strong business acumen, technical expertise, and the ability to translate complex finance processes into standard cloud-based solutions using SAP Best Practices. You have hands on S/4HANA and S/4HANA Cloud experience including use case of standard Fiori applications.

Responsibilities


- Act as a business consultant to help customers achieve their objectives understanding the importance of communication in a consultant's role
- Problem solve with an extraordinary technical and functional understanding of business process and FICO Principles and SAP products
- Support end users from a functional and/or technical perspective working closely with them and the business to analyze and review their business requirements or processes
- Troubleshoot and configure SAP FICO including integration points with other modules and cross functional design/build of other modules. Working on multiple projects as a project team member or team lead. 
- Leads fit/gap and other types of working sessions to understand needs driven by business process requirements. Translate requirements into solutions, using SAP Best Practices
- Prepare clear and concise documentation, as well as provide timely status updates
- Proactively identify risks and develop strategies to mitigate potential issues. Assess corporate impacts of changes and recommend strategies to senior management
- Provide knowledge transfer to clients and fellow consultants, in formal and ad hoc settings

Minimum Requirements


- Bachelor’s Degree 
- Travel up to 50%
- 8 years of SAP experience with a minimum of 3 full-cycle SAP implementations; Implementation experience in SAP Cloud environments both public and private. 
- Proficient in the business processes associated with financial operations, which includes expertise in general ledger, accounts receivable, accounts payable, asset management, cost center accounting, product cost controlling, profitability analysis, and profit center accounting. 
- Expert in set-up and configuration of FICO as well as cross functional design/build of other module(s)
- Proficient in all aspects of a project from requirement gathering and gapping to realization to testing, go-live prep and go-live execution as well as hyper-care support. Ability to lead sessions and create requirements to develop the right client solution

- Ability to be a thought leader in your domain and contribute to ecosphere both within and external of Reply

- International project or SAP configuration experience in NAFTA, LATAM and/or EMEA is a plus

- SAP Activate methodology and SAP’s fit-to-standard approach.

Today's finance leaders face increasing pressure to modernize operations, improve reporting accuracy, and scale efficiently as their businesses grow. As a NetSuite Senior Consultant at Deloitte, you will help clients design and implement NetSuite solutions that align with their business goals and deliver measurable results. This role fits professionals across core financial accounting, procure-to-pay, or order-to-cash implementation backgrounds. Join a team that is transforming how finance and accounting organizations operate by streamlining processes, improving reporting, and building lasting client relationships along the way.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant, you will implement and deploy NetSuite solutions:

  • Work within an engagement team, identifying business requirements, managing functional design, prototyping, and designing processes
  • Provide NetSuite consulting expertise, using industry experience, business analysis, and best practices to address clients' most complex requirements
  • Implement and deploy NetSuite solutions that accommodate unique industry, business, and regulatory requirements
  • Conduct business process mapping and requirements-gathering sessions with clients, on-site and remote
  • Prepare Business Requirements and Technical Scoping Documents for client approval
  • Build, develop, and test functional designs and scripted, customized solutions for business components and prototypes
  • Drive test planning, execution, and optimization support
  • Troubleshoot configuration issues and provide ongoing post-implementation support to optimize user adoption

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to build and maintain strong client and team relationships
  • Comfort managing multiple priorities across concurrent workstreams
  • Willingness to mentor and support the development of junior team members

The team

Our NetSuite practice helps upper mid-market and high-growth organizations modernize their financial and operational systems on a unified cloud platform. We work alongside clients to streamline processes, improve reporting, and support their next stage of growth. We're just as invested in our own team's growth, with hands-on learning and mentorship built into every engagement.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3+ years of relevant consulting or industry experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Record to Report: General Ledger, Consolidations, Multibook accounting, CTA Analysis, FX variances, and/or Financial Reporting
    • Procure to Pay: Accounts Payable
    • Order to Cash: Accounts Receivable
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Information Systems, or another related field
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
Preferred:

  • Certified NetSuite Professional (NetSuite Administrator / Suite Foundation / ERP Consultant / Multi-Book Consultant / ARM/Revenue Management)
  • Full lifecycle NetSuite implementation experience, including Design, Build, Test, Deploy, and Support phases
  • Experience with NetSuite integrations, customizations, and ERP data migration/cutover
  • Previous "Big 4" or large consulting firm experience
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage teams and stakeholders across global locations
  • Advanced degree in a relevant field
  • Eagerness to mentor junior staff

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,700 to $218,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.
