Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant, you will implement and deploy NetSuite solutions:

  • Work within an engagement team, identifying business requirements, managing functional design, prototyping, and designing processes
  • Provide NetSuite consulting expertise, using industry experience, business analysis, and best practices to address clients' most complex requirements
  • Implement and deploy NetSuite solutions that accommodate unique industry, business, and regulatory requirements
  • Conduct business process mapping and requirements-gathering sessions with clients, on-site and remote
  • Prepare Business Requirements and Technical Scoping Documents for client approval
  • Build, develop, and test functional designs and scripted, customized solutions for business components and prototypes
  • Drive test planning, execution, and optimization support
  • Troubleshoot configuration issues and provide ongoing post-implementation support to optimize user adoption

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to build and maintain strong client and team relationships
  • Comfort managing multiple priorities across concurrent workstreams
  • Willingness to mentor and support the development of junior team members

The team

Our NetSuite practice helps upper mid-market and high-growth organizations modernize their financial and operational systems on a unified cloud platform. We work alongside clients to streamline processes, improve reporting, and support their next stage of growth. We're just as invested in our own team's growth, with hands-on learning and mentorship built into every engagement.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3+ years of relevant consulting or industry experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Record to Report: General Ledger, Consolidations, Multibook accounting, CTA Analysis, FX variances, and/or Financial Reporting
    • Procure to Pay: Accounts Payable
    • Order to Cash: Accounts Receivable
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Information Systems, or another related field
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
Preferred:

  • Certified NetSuite Professional (NetSuite Administrator / Suite Foundation / ERP Consultant / Multi-Book Consultant / ARM/Revenue Management)
  • Full lifecycle NetSuite implementation experience, including Design, Build, Test, Deploy, and Support phases
  • Experience with NetSuite integrations, customizations, and ERP data migration/cutover
  • Previous "Big 4" or large consulting firm experience
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage teams and stakeholders across global locations
  • Advanced degree in a relevant field
  • Eagerness to mentor junior staff

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

The Opportunity

Our SAP Procurement practice helps organizations modernize and optimize their source-to-pay operations through SAP S/4HANA. We work with clients to transform procurement processes, improve supplier collaboration, increase operational efficiency, and strengthen controls across purchasing, inventory management, and invoice processing.

As a Senior Technology Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You will interact with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, ensuring that newly implemented technology solutions meet their needs. Your collaboration with technical teams will be essential in designing and delivering effective system architecture solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for delivering top-notch business analysis and system configuration. Your day-to-day will involve:

  • Support SAP Procurement and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstreams within SAP S/4HANA implementation and transformation engagements.
  • Design and configure SAP Materials Management (MM) solutions across purchasing, inventory management, goods movements, and invoice verification processes.
  • Advise clients on procurement leading practices and SAP standard capabilities while balancing business requirements with scalable solutions.
  • Translating complex business requirements into detailed technical specifications
  • Develop functional specifications, process documentation, test scripts, training materials, and other project deliverables.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Sales to help deliver integrated business solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

On a typical engagement, you will work directly with procurement, supply chain, and finance leaders to understand business challenges and translate requirements into scalable SAP solutions. Success in this role requires a combination of functional procurement expertise, SAP configuration experience, and the ability to guide clients through large-scale transformation initiatives.

We are seeking professionals with demonstrated experience in one or more procurement specializations and an understanding of related end-to-end Procure-to-Pay processes.

Key skills include:

  • Deep understanding of Procure-to-Pay business processes and their integration points across the enterprise.
  • Experience designing SAP-enabled procurement solutions that balance business requirements with standard SAP functionality.
  • Ability to lead requirements gathering sessions, process design workshops, fit-gap assessments, and solution validation activities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex business and system challenges.
  • Proven ability to manage workstream deliverables, project risks, stakeholder expectations, and timelines.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

  • A bachelor's degree with at least 2-4 years of SAP Procurement, Supply Chain, or consulting experience.
  • Experience supporting at least one full lifecycle SAP implementation, preferably an SAP S/4HANA transformation.
  • Hands-on experience in one or more SAP Procurement specializations, including:
    • SAP S/4HANA Procurement (Direct Materials)
    • SAP Invoice Management and Accounts Payable Integration
    • SAP Inventory Management
    • SAP Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, or Contracts
    • SAP Ariba Buying and Invoicing
    • SAP Ariba Integration, including Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG)
  • Experience configuring SAP MM procurement processes, including material master, business partner (vendor), RFQs, contracts, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, approval workflows, output management, goods receipts, stock transport orders, ALE, and IDocs.
  • Experience in one or more SAP Ariba solutions, including Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, Contracts, Buying and Invoicing, Supply Chain Collaboration, Commerce Automation, or Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG).
  • Knowledge of integration points with Accounts Payable, Production Planning, Sales & Distribution, and other related SAP modules.
  • Experience leading the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstream, including facilitating solution design workshops and developing proof of concepts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills.
  • Knowledge of leading practices, benchmarking, peer company environments and prior advisory experience relevant to industry specific finance and technology functions.
  • A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

  • Previous consulting experience within a professional services environment.
  • SAP S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement certification or other relevant SAP certifications.

What We Look For

We seek individuals who are proactive, innovative, and eager to contribute to team success. Top performers are those who demonstrate strong analytical skills, the ability to communicate effectively, and a passion for technology and its impact on business.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

    • New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $122,900 to $204,900
    • Bay Area California offices – $128,100 to $213,400
    • All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $102,500 to $187,900
  • Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Finance Transformation team practices to help chief financial officers, controllers, and finance teams define and execute their finance and global business services agendas and strategies. You will work with leading-class teams and solutions, helping clients navigate challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.

Work you'll do

As part of our Accounting and Finance Technology practice within the Finance Transformation team, you will serve as a finance-process expert who also configures, supports, and analyzes the financial technology platforms state, local, and higher education clients rely on. You will translate accounting and budgeting requirements into system design, lead implementation and optimization workstreams, and help clients get more value from their ERP, financial reporting, budgeting, and related fintech investments. Example responsibilities include:

  • Lead functional workstreams for ERP and financial system implementations, upgrades, and optimizations, including SAP, Workday Financials, Oracle Cloud ERP, PeopleSoft, Banner, Ellucian, and similar platforms used by public and higher education institutions.
  • Gather and document business requirements for general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, procurement, grants and sponsored programs, capital assets, cash and treasury, and budgeting, translating them into system configuration specifications.
  • Configure and test system functionality, including chart of accounts structures (fund, function, object, and program), approval workflows, accounting rules, and security roles that align with segregation-of-duties requirements.
  • Support budget development and monitoring processes using budgeting and planning solutions such as Anaplan, OneStream, Hyperion, or similar tools, including position budgeting and allocation models.
  • Advise on financial reporting solutions, including the design of management, grant, and fund-level reports, and the preparation of Annual Comprehensive Financial Report (ACFR) and board reporting outputs.
  • Ensure systems support accounting standards and compliance requirements, including GASB and FASB guidance, GASB 87, 96, and 101 considerations, Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200), and state reporting requirements.
  • Analyze financial data from system outputs to validate configurations, identify process gaps, and recommend improvements, using SQL, Excel, or reporting tools as needed.
  • Support system testing, data conversion, cutover planning, and go-live readiness, including user acceptance testing and reconciliation of legacy and new system balances.
  • Design and deliver training and process documentation for client finance and IT staff, and help build internal capability so clients can sustain their systems after go-live.
  • Lead project workstreams and manage deliverables, timelines, and risks, coordinating with client stakeholders, technical teams, and other consultants.
  • Provide clear guidance and direction to junior consultants and analysts on functional design, accounting treatment, and system usage.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Finance Transformation offering focuses on the transformation of corporate functions through the centralization and optimization of how these services are delivered - delivering resilient, agile, and cost-effective outcomes that drive the CFO agenda, including solutions and capabilities to drive ERP enabled transformation through functional design, implementation and governance of process, controls, and policies. Our Controllership and Treasury Transformation offering modernizes the finance function to support the evolving business objectives of the organization. We work with the CFO, CAO, controller, and treasurer to develop an efficient, high quality, data-driven, tech-enabled controllership and treasury function that empowers our clients to drive more value to their business partners and to their investors.

Qualifications

Required:

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

The Opportunity

Our SAP Procurement practice helps organizations modernize and optimize their source-to-pay operations through SAP S/4HANA. We work with clients to transform procurement processes, improve supplier collaboration, increase operational efficiency, and strengthen controls across purchasing, inventory management, and invoice processing.

As a Senior Technology Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You will interact with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, ensuring that newly implemented technology solutions meet their needs. Your collaboration with technical teams will be essential in designing and delivering effective system architecture solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for delivering top-notch business analysis and system configuration. Your day-to-day will involve:

  • Support SAP Procurement and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstreams within SAP S/4HANA implementation and transformation engagements.
  • Design and configure SAP Materials Management (MM) solutions across purchasing, inventory management, goods movements, and invoice verification processes.
  • Advise clients on procurement leading practices and SAP standard capabilities while balancing business requirements with scalable solutions.
  • Translating complex business requirements into detailed technical specifications
  • Develop functional specifications, process documentation, test scripts, training materials, and other project deliverables.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Sales to help deliver integrated business solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

On a typical engagement, you will work directly with procurement, supply chain, and finance leaders to understand business challenges and translate requirements into scalable SAP solutions. Success in this role requires a combination of functional procurement expertise, SAP configuration experience, and the ability to guide clients through large-scale transformation initiatives.

We are seeking professionals with demonstrated experience in one or more procurement specializations and an understanding of related end-to-end Procure-to-Pay processes.

Key skills include:

  • Deep understanding of Procure-to-Pay business processes and their integration points across the enterprise.
  • Experience designing SAP-enabled procurement solutions that balance business requirements with standard SAP functionality.
  • Ability to lead requirements gathering sessions, process design workshops, fit-gap assessments, and solution validation activities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex business and system challenges.
  • Proven ability to manage workstream deliverables, project risks, stakeholder expectations, and timelines.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

  • A bachelor's degree with at least 2-4 years of SAP Procurement, Supply Chain, or consulting experience.
  • Experience supporting at least one full lifecycle SAP implementation, preferably an SAP S/4HANA transformation.
  • Hands-on experience in one or more SAP Procurement specializations, including:
    • SAP S/4HANA Procurement (Direct Materials)
    • SAP Invoice Management and Accounts Payable Integration
    • SAP Inventory Management
    • SAP Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, or Contracts
    • SAP Ariba Buying and Invoicing
    • SAP Ariba Integration, including Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG)
  • Experience configuring SAP MM procurement processes, including material master, business partner (vendor), RFQs, contracts, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, approval workflows, output management, goods receipts, stock transport orders, ALE, and IDocs.
  • Experience in one or more SAP Ariba solutions, including Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, Contracts, Buying and Invoicing, Supply Chain Collaboration, Commerce Automation, or Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG).
  • Knowledge of integration points with Accounts Payable, Production Planning, Sales & Distribution, and other related SAP modules.
  • Experience leading the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstream, including facilitating solution design workshops and developing proof of concepts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills.
  • Knowledge of leading practices, benchmarking, peer company environments and prior advisory experience relevant to industry specific finance and technology functions.
  • A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

  • Previous consulting experience within a professional services environment.
  • SAP S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement certification or other relevant SAP certifications.

What We Look For

We seek individuals who are proactive, innovative, and eager to contribute to team success. Top performers are those who demonstrate strong analytical skills, the ability to communicate effectively, and a passion for technology and its impact on business.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

  • The salary range for this job is:
    • New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $122,900 to $204,900
    • Bay Area California offices – $128,100 to $213,400
    • All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $102,500 to $187,900
  • Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

  • EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Finance Transformation team practices to help chief financial officers, controllers, and finance teams define and execute their finance and global business services agendas and strategies. You will work with leading-class teams and solutions, helping clients navigate challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.

Work you'll do

As part of our Accounting and Finance Technology practice within the Finance Transformation team, you will serve as a finance-process expert who also configures, supports, and analyzes the financial technology platforms state, local, and higher education clients rely on. You will translate accounting and budgeting requirements into system design, lead implementation and optimization workstreams, and help clients get more value from their ERP, financial reporting, budgeting, and related fintech investments. Example responsibilities include:

  • Lead functional workstreams for ERP and financial system implementations, upgrades, and optimizations, including SAP, Workday Financials, Oracle Cloud ERP, PeopleSoft, Banner, Ellucian, and similar platforms used by public and higher education institutions.
  • Gather and document business requirements for general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, procurement, grants and sponsored programs, capital assets, cash and treasury, and budgeting, translating them into system configuration specifications.
  • Configure and test system functionality, including chart of accounts structures (fund, function, object, and program), approval workflows, accounting rules, and security roles that align with segregation-of-duties requirements.
  • Support budget development and monitoring processes using budgeting and planning solutions such as Anaplan, OneStream, Hyperion, or similar tools, including position budgeting and allocation models.
  • Advise on financial reporting solutions, including the design of management, grant, and fund-level reports, and the preparation of Annual Comprehensive Financial Report (ACFR) and board reporting outputs.
  • Ensure systems support accounting standards and compliance requirements, including GASB and FASB guidance, GASB 87, 96, and 101 considerations, Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200), and state reporting requirements.
  • Analyze financial data from system outputs to validate configurations, identify process gaps, and recommend improvements, using SQL, Excel, or reporting tools as needed.
  • Support system testing, data conversion, cutover planning, and go-live readiness, including user acceptance testing and reconciliation of legacy and new system balances.
  • Design and deliver training and process documentation for client finance and IT staff, and help build internal capability so clients can sustain their systems after go-live.
  • Lead project workstreams and manage deliverables, timelines, and risks, coordinating with client stakeholders, technical teams, and other consultants.
  • Provide clear guidance and direction to junior consultants and analysts on functional design, accounting treatment, and system usage.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Finance Transformation offering focuses on the transformation of corporate functions through the centralization and optimization of how these services are delivered - delivering resilient, agile, and cost-effective outcomes that drive the CFO agenda, including solutions and capabilities to drive ERP enabled transformation through functional design, implementation and governance of process, controls, and policies. Our Controllership and Treasury Transformation offering modernizes the finance function to support the evolving business objectives of the organization. We work with the CFO, CAO, controller, and treasurer to develop an efficient, high quality, data-driven, tech-enabled controllership and treasury function that empowers our clients to drive more value to their business partners and to their investors.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, information systems, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience in governmental, higher education, or similar finance environments, with hands-on accounting or finance responsibilities such as general ledger, reconciliations, budgeting, grants accounting, or financial reporting.
  • Working knowledge of GASB and FASB standards, fund accounting, and the chart of accounts structures used by public and higher education institutions.
  • Experience leading or contributing to system implementations, upgrades, or process redesign projects, including requirements gathering, testing, and go-live support.
  • Ability to obtain/maintain any security clearance needed for the project and/or client.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Demonstrated experience configuring, supporting, or analyzing at least one major ERP, Experience with ERP (such as SAP, Workday, Oracle, PeopleSoft) or other systems (for example Workiva, Balckline, One Stream, Anaplan, etc), is preferred.
  • Experience documenting business requirements, process flows, or test scripts
  • Experience in government or public sector environments
  • Experience with finance transformation, shared services, or global business services initiatives
  • Certified Public Accountant or Certified Management Accountant credential
  • Project Management Professional
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams, manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, and meet deadlines.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical and accounting concepts clearly to finance leaders, IT teams, and end users.
  • Ability to analyze data using SQL, Excel, or reporting tools to validate system configurations and support decision-making.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, a professional demeanor, and the ability to build and sustain professional relationships with client stakeholders.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400 to $207,800.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

- Lead functional workstreams for ERP and financial system implementations, upgrades, and optimizations, including SAP, Workday Financials, Oracle Cloud ERP, PeopleSoft, Banner, Ellucian, and similar platforms used by public and higher education institutions.
- Gather and document business requirements for general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, procurement, grants and sponsored programs, capital assets, cash and treasury, and budgeting, translating them into system configuration specifications.
- Configure and test system functionality, including chart of accounts structures (fund, function, object, and program), approval workflows, accounting rules, and security roles that align with segregation-of-duties requirements.
- Support budget development and monitoring processes using budgeting and planning solutions such as Anaplan, OneStream, Hyperion, or similar tools, including position budgeting and allocation models.
- Advise on financial reporting solutions, including the design of management, grant, and fund-level reports, and the preparation of Annual Comprehensive Financial Report (ACFR) and board reporting outputs.
- Ensure systems support accounting standards and compliance requirements, including GASB and FASB guidance, GASB 87, 96, and 101 considerations, Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200), and state reporting requirements.
- Analyze financial data from system outputs to validate configurations, identify process gaps, and recommend improvements, using SQL, Excel, or reporting tools as needed.
- Support system testing, data conversion, cutover planning, and go-live readiness, including user acceptance testing and reconciliation of legacy and new system balances.
- Design and deliver training and process documentation for client finance and IT staff, and help build internal capability so clients can sustain their systems after go-live.
- Lead project workstreams and manage deliverables, timelines, and risks, coordinating with client stakeholders, technical teams, and other consultants.
- Provide clear guidance and direction to junior consultants and analysts on functional design, accounting treatment, and system usage.

- Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
- Effective written and verbal communication skills
- Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
- Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
- Ability to lead projects or workstreams
- Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
- Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
- Ability to meet deadlines
- Ability to provide clear guidance to others

Required:



- Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, information systems, or a related field
- 3+ years of experience in governmental, higher education, or similar finance environments, with hands-on accounting or finance responsibilities such as general ledger, reconciliations, budgeting, grants accounting, or financial reporting.
- Working knowledge of GASB and FASB standards, fund accounting, and the chart of accounts structures used by public and higher education institutions.

Syskoplan Reply is a part of the Reply Network, focused on delivering transformative projects to our clients leveraging SAP solutions. Syskoplan Reply is an SAP Gold partner and has recognized expertise executing global projects in various industries and a wide range of competencies including business process consulting, customer experience, intelligent automation, ERP and more.

At Syskoplan Reply, we are seeking a Senior SAP MM/Purchasing Consultant to join our team. You are an individual who has technical and functional expertise of the SAP MM module which allows you to solve problems and deliver optimum solutions for the client. You will act as both a strategic advisor and hands-on configurator, delivering best-in-class solutions aligned with SAP Activate methodology and SAP’s fit-to-standard approach. You have strong business acumen, technical expertise, and the ability to translate complex MM processes into standard cloud-based solutions using SAP Best Practices. You have hands on S/4HANA and S/4HANA Cloud experience including use case of standard Fiori applications.

Responsibilities
  • Act as a business consultant to help customers achieve their objectives understanding the importance of communication in a consultant's role
  • Problem solve with an extraordinary technical and functional understanding of business process and MM Principles and SAP products
  • Support end users from a functional and/or technical perspective working closely with them and the business to analyze and review their business requirements or processes
  • Troubleshoot and configure SAP MM including integration points with other modules and cross functional design/build of other modules. Working on multiple projects as a project team member or team lead.
  • Lead fit/gap and other types of working sessions to understand needs driven by business process requirements. Translate requirements into solutions, using SAP Best Practices
  • Prepare clear and concise documentation, as well as provide timely status updates
  • Proactively identify risks and develop strategies to mitigate potential issues. Assess corporate impacts of changes and recommend strategies to senior management
  • Provide knowledge transfer to clients and fellow consultants, in formal and ad hoc settings

Minimum Requirements
  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Travel up to 50%
  • 8 years of SAP experience with a minimum of 3 full-cycle SAP implementations including both public and private cloud
  • Deep expertise in SAP MM/Purchasing within manufacturing environments, including procurement processes, purchasing operations, source determination, inventory and materials management, vendor evaluation and management, goods receipt/invoice verification, subcontracting, batch management/traceability, integration with warehouse and production processes, and SAP Fiori apps.
  • Expert in set-up/configuration of MM and cross functional design/build of other module(s)
  • Proficient in all aspects of a project from requirement gathering and gapping to realization to testing, go-live prep and go-live execution as well as hyper-care support. Ability to lead sessions and create requirements to develop the right client solution
  • Highly skilled in MM master data set-up, cleansing, harmonization and migration, including LSMW and Migration Cockpit
  • Ability to be a though leader in your domain and contribute to ecosphere both within and external of Reply

Preferred Qualifications
  • International project or SAP configuration experience in NAFTA, LATAM and/or EMEA
  • S/4 Public and/or Private Cloud Certification
  • Experience with SAP Activate methodology and SAP’s fit-to-standard approach.

Reply specializes in the design and implementation of solutions based on new communication channels and digital media. Reply is a network of highly specialized companies supporting global industrial groups operating in the telecom and media, industry and services, banking, insurance and public administration sectors in the definition and development of business models enabled for the new paradigms of AI, cloud computing, digital media and the Internet of Things. Reply services include Consulting, System Integration and Digital Services. www.reply.com

Compensation decisions are supported through market data, where regional variances may exist based on cost of labor. If you have questions regarding compensation, the talent acquisition team can provide details during the interview process.

Reply is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to provide equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you need assistance and reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, email us at jobusa@reply.com. Visit our website at www.reply.com to learn more about our open roles.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. With such a variety of areas to explore, you'll have the chance to make a real impact while growing in your career. Come be part of a team that values innovation and strives for excellence. Apply now and let's achieve great things together!

Recruiting for this role ends on 4/1/2026

Work you'll do

As a Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Sr Consultant, your role will be to understand the client's business, modeling their processes into the ERP, playing with the product's strength to meet requirements and to bridge gaps to bring value. You will design and help manage end-to-end implementations of D365 F&O, providing the best of industry processes. In addition, you will play a key role in building the company's tools and assets, improve our delivery processes, select our software and ISVs, and train on new versions and tools, keeping your knowledge sharp.

Senior Consultants provide deep domain expertise in one or more vertical industries establishing credibility with the customer and/or prospect. Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the platforms and products. Lead the activities of one of the project's workstreams (Deloitte and Client personnel), which may include things such as planning the activities of the workstream, leading design and refinement sessions, configuration of D365, coordinating cross-functional activities where interaction with other workstreams is needed, maintaining documentation and statistics on the workstream's progress, oversight of the workstream's testing activities, and management of Risks, Actions, Issues and Decisions related to your team. will manage the technical workstreams of end-to-end implementations of D365 F&O, review functional and craft technical documentation, develop integrations, data migrations, collaborate through testing phases.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant consulting experience in a professional services environment, with a large or boutique consulting firm, or serving as an internal consultant within industry.
  • 5+ years of MS Dynamics 365 F&O experience
  • 3+ full-life cycle implementations in Finance or Operations
  • 5+ years of experience in business requirement documentation & design documentation, preparing and leading workshops with key stakeholders
  • Bachelor's degree. In lieu of degree, 8 years of experience in D365/AX ERP implementation
  • Ability to travel up to 50%
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred

  • 5+ years of data migration tools and processes within Dynamics 365 experience
  • 5+ years of experience with D365 SCM or Finance, solution Data model
  • D365 Retail

Wages + Salary

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • SAP FICO Module Configuration:
  • Lead the design, configuration, and implementation of the SAP FI (Financial Accounting) and SAP CO (Controlling) modules.
  • Configuration/design Chart of accounts, Hands on in General Ledger (G/L), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Asset Accounting (AA), and Bank Accounting (BA) within SAP FI.
  • Configure Cost Center Accounting (CCA), Internal Orders (IO), Profit Center Accounting (PCA), Activity-Based Costing (ABC), and Product Costing (PC) within SAP CO.
  • Implement and manage SAP integration points between SAP FI/CO and other modules like MM (Material Management), SD (Sales and Distribution), PP (Production Planning), and HR (Human Resources).
  • Hands on Experience in to analyze and resolve any issues in end-to-end scenario of MTS, MTO & ETO.
  • Hands on experience in configuration of Result Analysis key and analysis of RA along with WIP Variance and Settlement.
  • Hands on experience in configuration of Completed Contract Method and Percentage of completion method.
  • AI Lead automations like AI-Driven Cash Application, Predictive Accounting, Intercompany reconciliation.
  • Must have deep Excel skills – Hlookup, Vlookup, Excel based analysis, good in number crunching , creating reports in Power BI.
  • Financial Close and Reporting:
  • Hands-on experience in resolving month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities in SAP FICO, ensuring timely and accurate financial reporting.
  • Design and implement financial reporting solutions (standard and custom) including Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss Statement, Cash Flow reports, Segment Reporting, and others.
  • Implement consolidation processes and intercompany reconciliation procedures within SAP.
  • Ensure compliance with both local and international financial accounting standards such as IFRS or GAAP.
  • Project Management and Stakeholder Management:
  • Lead and manage end-to-end SAP FICO implementation projects, including gathering requirements, blueprinting, solution design, testing, and Go-Live support.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including business users, SAP technical teams, and third-party consultants, to ensure the SAP FICO solution meets business requirements.
  • Provide guidance to junior consultants and lead project teams in the design and implementation of FICO solutions.
  • Collaborate with business teams to define project milestones, deliverables, and timelines, ensuring efficient resource allocation and project delivery.
  • System Integration and Data Migration:
  • Lead the integration of SAP FICO with external systems such as banks, third-party financial applications, and legacy systems.
  • Oversee data migration activities for financial data from legac y systems into SAP, ensuring data accuracy and consistency across all modules.
  • Conduct data reconciliation and validation to ensure seamless system integration and minimize post-Go-Live issues.
  • Continuous Improvement and Optimization:
  • Identify areas for improvement and propose optimizations in SAP FICO processes to increase efficiency, reduce costs, and ensure scalability.
  • Provide post-Go-Live support, ensuring the system operates smoothly and addressing any issues related to financial transactions, reporting, or configuration.
  • Stay up to date with SAP FICO best practices, new SAP features, and the latest industry trends, and incorporate them into the existing system for continuous improvement.
  • Documentation and Knowledge Transfer:
  • Prepare comprehensive documentation for all configuration settings, business processes, and end-user procedures.
  • Ensure the handover of knowledge and best practices to business users and junior consultants.
  • Provide training to end-users on SAP FICO functionalities, ensuring smooth adoption and effective system usage.
  • Financial Controlling and Budgeting:
  • Configure and manage Internal Orders for controlling cost allocation and ensure alignment with business units' cost and profit centers.
  • Implement and maintain Costing Sheets, Profitability Analysis (CO-PA), and Cost Center Accounting (CCA) for effective financial performance tracking.
  • Support budgeting and forecasting processes, ensuring that financial data aligns with business projections.
  • SAP FICO Enhancements and Support:
  • Handle SAP FICO ticket resolution in production environments, addressing issues raised by business users.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues related to financial transactions, system errors, or reporting discrepancies.
  • Implement SAP S/4HANA enhancements or transition initiatives, migrating legacy SAP FICO systems to the latest technologies.
  • Compliance and Audit:
  • Ensure SAP FICO modules comply with tax regulations, audit requirements, and internal control standards.

With such a variety of areas to explore, you'll have the chance to make a real impact while growing in your career. Come be part of a team that values innovation and strives for excellence. Apply now and let's achieve great things together!

Recruiting for this role ends on 4/1/2026

Work you'll do

As a Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Sr Consultant, your role will be to understand the client's business, modeling their processes into the ERP, playing with the product's strength to meet requirements and to bridge gaps to bring value. You will design and help manage end-to-end implementations of D365 F&O, providing the best of industry processes. In addition, you will play a key role in building the company's tools and assets, improve our delivery processes, select our software and ISVs, and train on new versions and tools, keeping your knowledge sharp.

Senior Consultants provide deep domain expertise in one or more vertical industries establishing credibility with the customer and/or prospect. Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the platforms and products. Lead the activities of one of the project's workstreams (Deloitte and Client personnel), which may include things such as planning the activities of the workstream, leading design and refinement sessions, configuration of D365, coordinating cross-functional activities where interaction with other workstreams is needed, maintaining documentation and statistics on the workstream's progress, oversight of the workstream's testing activities, and management of Risks, Actions, Issues and Decisions related to your team. will manage the technical workstreams of end-to-end implementations of D365 F&O, review functional and craft technical documentation, develop integrations, data migrations, collaborate through testing phases.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant consulting experience in a professional services environment, with a large or boutique consulting firm, or serving as an internal consultant within industry.
  • 5+ years of MS Dynamics 365 F&O experience
  • 3+ full-life cycle implementations in Finance or Operations
  • 5+ years of experience in business requirement documentation & design documentation, preparing and leading workshops with key stakeholders
  • Bachelor's degree. In lieu of degree, 8 years of experience in D365/AX ERP implementation
  • Ability to travel up to 50%
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred

  • 5+ years of data migration tools and processes within Dynamics 365 experience
  • 5+ years of experience with D365 SCM or Finance, solution Data model
  • D365 Retail

Wages + Salary

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. Our NetSuite practice helps upper mid-market and high-growth organizations modernize their financial and operational systems on a unified cloud platform. descriptionHtml:
Syskoplan Reply is a part of the Reply Network, focused on delivering transformative projects to our clients leveraging SAP solutions. Syskoplan Reply is an SAP Gold partner and has recognized expertise executing global projects in various industries and a wide range of competencies including business process consulting, customer experience, intelligent automation, ERP and more.

At Syskoplan Reply, we are seeking a Senior SAP MM/Purchasing Consultant to join our team. You are an individual who has technical and functional expertise of the SAP MM module which allows you to solve problems and deliver optimum solutions for the client. You will act as both a strategic advisor and hands-on configurator, delivering best-in-class solutions aligned with SAP Activate methodology and SAP’s fit-to-standard approach. You have strong business acumen, technical expertise, and the ability to translate complex MM processes into standard cloud-based solutions using SAP Best Practices. You have hands on S/4HANA and S/4HANA Cloud experience including use case of standard Fiori applications.

Responsibilities
  • Act as a business consultant to help customers achieve their objectives understanding the importance of communication in a consultant's role
  • Problem solve with an extraordinary technical and functional understanding of business process and MM Principles and SAP products
  • Support end users from a functional and/or technical perspective working closely with them and the business to analyze and review their business requirements or processes
  • Troubleshoot and configure SAP MM including integration points with other modules and cross functional design/build of other modules. Working on multiple projects as a project team member or team lead.
  • Lead fit/gap and other types of working sessions to understand needs driven by business process requirements. Translate requirements into solutions, using SAP Best Practices
  • Prepare clear and concise documentation, as well as provide timely status updates
  • Proactively identify risks and develop strategies to mitigate potential issues. Assess corporate impacts of changes and recommend strategies to senior management
  • Provide knowledge transfer to clients and fellow consultants, in formal and ad hoc settings

Minimum Requirements
  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Travel up to 50%
  • 8 years of SAP experience with a minimum of 3 full-cycle SAP implementations including both public and private cloud
  • Deep expertise in SAP MM/Purchasing within manufacturing environments, including procurement processes, purchasing operations, source determination, inventory and materials management, vendor evaluation and management, goods receipt/invoice verification, subcontracting, batch management/traceability, integration with warehouse and production processes, and SAP Fiori apps.
  • Expert in set-up/configuration of MM and cross functional design/build of other module(s)
  • Proficient in all aspects of a project from requirement gathering and gapping to realization to testing, go-live prep and go-live execution as well as hyper-care support. Ability to lead sessions and create requirements to develop the right client solution
  • Highly skilled in MM master data set-up, cleansing, harmonization and migration, including LSMW and Migration Cockpit
  • Ability to be a though leader in your domain and contribute to ecosphere both within and external of Reply

Preferred Qualifications
  • International project or SAP configuration experience in NAFTA, LATAM and/or EMEA
  • S/4 Public and/or Private Cloud Certification
  • Experience with SAP Activate methodology and SAP’s fit-to-standard approach.

About Reply
Reply specializes in the design and implementation of solutions based on new communication channels and digital media. Reply is a network of highly specialized companies supporting global industrial groups operating in the telecom and media, industry and services, banking, insurance and public administration sectors in the definition and development of business models enabled for the new paradigms of AI, cloud computing, digital media and the Internet of Things. Reply services include Consulting, System Integration and Digital Services. www.reply.com

Today's finance leaders face increasing pressure to modernize operations, improve reporting accuracy, and scale efficiently as their businesses grow. As a NetSuite Senior Consultant at Deloitte, you will help clients design and implement NetSuite solutions that align with their business goals and deliver measurable results. This role fits professionals across core financial accounting, procure-to-pay, or order-to-cash implementation backgrounds. Join a team that is transforming how finance and accounting organizations operate by streamlining processes, improving reporting, and building lasting client relationships along the way.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant, you will implement and deploy NetSuite solutions:

  • Work within an engagement team, identifying business requirements, managing functional design, prototyping, and designing processes
  • Provide NetSuite consulting expertise, using industry experience, business analysis, and best practices to address clients' most complex requirements
  • Implement and deploy NetSuite solutions that accommodate unique industry, business, and regulatory requirements
  • Conduct business process mapping and requirements-gathering sessions with clients, on-site and remote
  • Prepare Business Requirements and Technical Scoping Documents for client approval
  • Build, develop, and test functional designs and scripted, customized solutions for business components and prototypes
  • Drive test planning, execution, and optimization support
  • Troubleshoot configuration issues and provide ongoing post-implementation support to optimize user adoption

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to build and maintain strong client and team relationships
  • Comfort managing multiple priorities across concurrent workstreams
  • Willingness to mentor and support the development of junior team members

The team

Our NetSuite practice helps upper mid-market and high-growth organizations modernize their financial and operational systems on a unified cloud platform. We work alongside clients to streamline processes, improve reporting, and support their next stage of growth. We're just as invested in our own team's growth, with hands-on learning and mentorship built into every engagement.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3+ years of relevant consulting or industry experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Record to Report: General Ledger, Consolidations, Multibook accounting, CTA Analysis, FX variances, and/or Financial Reporting
    • Procure to Pay: Accounts Payable
    • Order to Cash: Accounts Receivable
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Information Systems, or another related field
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
Preferred:

  • Certified NetSuite Professional (NetSuite Administrator / Suite Foundation / ERP Consultant / Multi-Book Consultant / ARM/Revenue Management)
  • Full lifecycle NetSuite implementation experience, including Design, Build, Test, Deploy, and Support phases
  • Experience with NetSuite integrations, customizations, and ERP data migration/cutover
  • Previous "Big 4" or large consulting firm experience
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage teams and stakeholders across global locations
  • Advanced degree in a relevant field
  • Eagerness to mentor junior staff

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,700 to $218,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Join Deloitte's SAP practice and build a career at the forefront of business transformation, where innovation, industry insight, and leading technology come together to solve complex challenges. You'll work with dynamic teams and leading organizations to modernize core processes, enable digital transformation, and help clients unlock lasting value through SAP-enabled solutions.

In this SAP AI Transformation role, you'll contribute to Agentic ERP transformations that help clients advance toward the autonomous enterprise. Combining SAP expertise with AI-enabled delivery approaches, cross-functional collaboration, and industry insight, you'll help address complex business challenges and create measurable client impact.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/15/2027

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant in Deloitte's SAP practice, with a focus on SAP Supply Chain, you will work side by side with functional and technical client team members to rapidly prototype and deliver high-impact solutions that support Agentic ERP transformations. With Deloitte Ascend™, you'll leverage AI accelerators and SAP capabilities to help clients modernize business processes and advance toward the autonomous enterprise.

This role requires a highly motivated professional who moves with speed and precision, builds practical solutions, and engages confidently with senior stakeholders and delivery teams to help generate measurable business impact.

  • Own assigned SAP Supply Chainwork streams, including work-plan execution, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, stakeholder coordination, and quality of deliverables.
  • Lead and facilitate opportunity-identification, fit-to-standard, autonomous solution-design, and playback workshops with client stakeholders and technical teams.
  • Translate supply chain requirements into SAP S/4HANA solutions and drive functional design and configuration across Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), third-party logistics (3PL) integrations, Production Planning (PP), Transportation Management (TM), Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), and Materials Management (MM).
  • Coordinate cross-functional integration requirements across procurement, sales, accounting, tax, treasury, reporting, and other relevant workstreams.
  • Lead or oversee data migration, testing, defect resolution, cutover, deployment, hypercare, and stabilization activities.
  • Assess supply chain processes and design AI-enabled and automated improvements for close, reporting, controls, analytics, and process performance; use Deloitte Ascend™ accelerators where applicable, with human review and validation of AI-generated outputs.
  • Serve as a day-to-day client advisor by communicating progress, decisions, risks, and recommendations to business and senior client stakeholders.
  • Coach junior team members, review work products, and contribute to proposals, estimates, reusable assets, and SAP practice development.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's SAP practice helps clients design, implement, and sustain SAP-enabled transformations to enable an Autonomous Enterprise. Our teams combine industry knowledge, functional experience, and technology capabilities to support first-time implementations, business-led enhancements, and large-scale SAP S/4HANA programs.

Professionals in the practice work with leading organizations across industries to modernize operations, improve process performance, and unlock value through cloud, automation, analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree; or an associate degree and 6+ years of SAP, enterprise resource planning (ERP), or consulting experience in lieu of a bachelor's degree.
  • 5+ years of experience in SAP consulting, enterprise resource planning (ERP) implementation, or SAP/ERP technology transformation in a consulting or industry environment.
  • Experience supporting at least two full-lifecycle SAP implementations from project initiation through go-live and hypercare, with demonstrated ownership or leadership of an SAP Supply Chain workstream or workstream area on at least one implementation, and experience supporting an SAP S/4HANA implementation.
  • 2+ years of hands-on functional configuration experience in at least one of the following SAP Supply Chain modules: SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), SAP Transportation Management (TM), SAP Production Planning (PP), SAP Production Planning for Process Industries (PP-PI), SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), SAP Materials Management (MM), or SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP).
  • Experience managing work plans, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, deliverables, and team coordination.
  • Experience collaborating directly with client supply chain stakeholders to gather and document business requirements and support SAP Supply Chain solution design, configuration, testing, or deployment on at least one SAP implementation, transformation, or support project.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred:

  • Experience applying artificial intelligence (AI) tools-including generative AI, intelligent automation, machine learning, conversational AI, or AI agents-to support enterprise transformation initiatives, including solution design, implementation, testing, or human-in-the-loop review and validation.
  • Experience supporting SAP cloud programs or SAP transformation programs deployed across multiple countries.
  • Experience applying SAP Activate, Agile, or Waterfall methodologies on SAP implementation programs.
  • Experience contributing to proposals, estimates, solution designs, or client presentations.
  • Experience coaching or mentoring junior team members.
  • One or more SAP certifications

descriptionHtml:
Today's finance leaders face increasing pressure to modernize operations, improve reporting accuracy, and scale efficiently as their businesses grow. As a NetSuite Senior Consultant at Deloitte, you will help clients design and implement NetSuite solutions that align with their business goals and deliver measurable results. This role fits professionals across core financial accounting, procure-to-pay, or order-to-cash implementation backgrounds. Join a team that is transforming how finance and accounting organizations operate by streamlining processes, improving reporting, and building lasting client relationships along the way.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant, you will implement and deploy NetSuite solutions:

  • Work within an engagement team, identifying business requirements, managing functional design, prototyping, and designing processes
  • Provide NetSuite consulting expertise, using industry experience, business analysis, and best practices to address clients' most complex requirements
  • Implement and deploy NetSuite solutions that accommodate unique industry, business, and regulatory requirements
  • Conduct business process mapping and requirements-gathering sessions with clients, on-site and remote
  • Prepare Business Requirements and Technical Scoping Documents for client approval
  • Build, develop, and test functional designs and scripted, customized solutions for business components and prototypes
  • Drive test planning, execution, and optimization support
  • Troubleshoot configuration issues and provide ongoing post-implementation support to optimize user adoption

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to build and maintain strong client and team relationships
  • Comfort managing multiple priorities across concurrent workstreams
  • Willingness to mentor and support the development of junior team members

The team

Our NetSuite practice helps upper mid-market and high-growth organizations modernize their financial and operational systems on a unified cloud platform. We work alongside clients to streamline processes, improve reporting, and support their next stage of growth. We're just as invested in our own team's growth, with hands-on learning and mentorship built into every engagement.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3+ years of relevant consulting or industry experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Record to Report: General Ledger, Consolidations, Multibook accounting, CTA Analysis, FX variances, and/or Financial Reporting
    • Procure to Pay: Accounts Payable
    • Order to Cash: Accounts Receivable
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Information Systems, or another related field
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
Preferred:

  • Certified NetSuite Professional (NetSuite Administrator / Suite Foundation / ERP Consultant / Multi-Book Consultant / ARM/Revenue Management)
  • Full lifecycle NetSuite implementation experience, including Design, Build, Test, Deploy, and Support phases
  • Experience with NetSuite integrations, customizations, and ERP data migration/cutover
  • Previous "Big 4" or large consulting firm experience
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage teams and stakeholders across global locations
  • Advanced degree in a relevant field
  • Eagerness to mentor junior staff

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,700 to $218,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job Description

Must Have Technical/Functional Skills

  • 10+ years of SAP Materials Management and procurement experience, including 7+ years in Procure-to-Pay and strategic sourcing processes.
  • Minimum three full-cycle SAP implementations, including at least two SAP S/4HANA Procurement implementations.
  • Strong expertise in direct, indirect, service, and project procurement using purchase requisitions, purchase orders, contracts, and scheduling agreements.
  • Hands-on configuration experience with purchasing organizations, purchasing groups, document types, release strategies/workflows, source determination, pricing, account assignment, and output management.
  • Experience with subcontracting, consignment, stock transport orders, third-party procurement, returns, intercompany procurement, and evaluated receipt settlement.
  • Strong knowledge of supplier, material, purchasing info record, source list, quota arrangement, and business partner master data.
  • Experience with S/4HANA flexible workflow, Fiori procurement applications, approval design, situation handling, and embedded analytics.
  • Strong integration experience with Inventory Management, EWM, Manufacturing, Quality Management, Plant Maintenance, Project Systems, Finance, and Accounts Payable.
  • Experience with invoice verification, GR/IR, tax and payment-relevant data, blocked invoice resolution, and three-way match processes.
  • Experience integrating SAP S/4HANA with SAP Ariba Sourcing, Contracts, Buying and Invoicing, Business Network, or other supplier platforms is preferred.
  • Experience supporting data migration, interfaces, functional specifications, SIT, UAT, cutover, go-live, and hypercare.
  • Strong knowledge of SAP Activate, global template deployment, procurement controls, and process standardization.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Procure-to-Pay and sourcing solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization for the Helix transformation program.
  • Facilitate fit-to-standard workshops and translate business requirements into scalable global procurement process designs.
  • Design requisitioning, sourcing, contract, purchase order, receiving, service entry, invoice verification, and supplier collaboration processes.
  • Define direct material, indirect material, service, project, subcontracting, consignment, stock transport, and intercompany procurement scenarios.
  • Configure procurement organizational structures, document types, item categories, account assignments, pricing procedures, source determination, tolerances, and output management.
  • Design approval processes using S/4HANA flexible workflows, including agent determination, escalations, substitutions, and exception handling.
  • Define supplier and purchasing master data requirements, governance rules, migration objects, validation controls, and data quality measures.
  • Own cross-functional integration with Inventory Management, EWM, PP, QM, PM/EAM, PS, Finance, Controlling, Accounts Payable, and tax processes.
  • Coordinate integration with SAP Ariba, SAP Business Network, supplier portals, catalog providers, EDI, BTP, and other external procurement platforms.
  • Guide functional specifications, reports, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, forms, workflows, security roles, and Fiori applications.
  • Define procurement controls, segregation-of-duties considerations, audit requirements, approval limits, and exception-monitorin g processes.
  • Lead test planning, defect resolution, deployment readiness, mock cutovers, production cutover, hypercare, and transition to support.
  • Coordinate onshore and offshore teams, manage dependencies and risks, and communicate decisions and progress to business and program stakeholders.
  • Proactively challenge unnecessary customizations and guide stakeholders toward standard, sustainable SAP procurement capabilities.

Generic Managerial Skills, If any

  • Strong leadership, ownership, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.
  • Ability to lead global design workshops and align Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, Operations, and technology teams.
  • Experience coordinating onshore and offshore teams in a large, multi-site transformation program.
  • Strong governance, risk management, decision facilitation, and issue-resolution skills.
  • Ability to mentor team members and maintain accountability for solution quality, schedule, compliance, and business outcomes.

Salary Range: $160,000 - $180,000 a year

Discretionary Annual Incentive.

Comprehensive Medical Coverage: Medical & Health, Dental & Vision, Disability Planning & Insurance, Pet Insurance Plans.

Family Support: Maternal & Parental Leaves.

Insurance Options: Auto & Home Insurance, Identity Theft Protection.

Convenience & Professional Growth: Commuter Benefits & Certification & Training Reimbursement.

Time Off: Vacation, Time Off, Sick Leave & Holidays.

Legal & Financial Assistance: Legal Assistance, 401K Plan, Performance Bonus, College Fund, Student Loan Refinancing.
