descriptionHtml:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Our goal is to give clients a unique business perspective on how SAP technology can enhance their operations. By leveraging EY’s expertise in SAP, Supply Chain, FICO, BPC, Data & Analytics, Customer Solutions, Technology & Architecture, and SuccessFactors, we assist clients in enhancing performance and increasing productivity.

The Opportunity

Our SAP Procurement practice helps organizations modernize and optimize their source-to-pay operations through SAP S/4HANA. We work with clients to transform procurement processes, improve supplier collaboration, increase operational efficiency, and strengthen controls across purchasing, inventory management, and invoice processing.

As a Senior Technology Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You will interact with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, ensuring that newly implemented technology solutions meet their needs. Your collaboration with technical teams will be essential in designing and delivering effective system architecture solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for delivering top-notch business analysis and system configuration. Your day-to-day will involve:

  • Support SAP Procurement and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstreams within SAP S/4HANA implementation and transformation engagements.
  • Design and configure SAP Materials Management (MM) solutions across purchasing, inventory management, goods movements, and invoice verification processes.
  • Advise clients on procurement leading practices and SAP standard capabilities while balancing business requirements with scalable solutions.
  • Translating complex business requirements into detailed technical specifications
  • Develop functional specifications, process documentation, test scripts, training materials, and other project deliverables.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Sales to help deliver integrated business solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

On a typical engagement, you will work directly with procurement, supply chain, and finance leaders to understand business challenges and translate requirements into scalable SAP solutions. Success in this role requires a combination of functional procurement expertise, SAP configuration experience, and the ability to guide clients through large-scale transformation initiatives.

We are seeking professionals with demonstrated experience in one or more procurement specializations and an understanding of related end-to-end Procure-to-Pay processes.

Key skills include:

  • Deep understanding of Procure-to-Pay business processes and their integration points across the enterprise.
  • Experience designing SAP-enabled procurement solutions that balance business requirements with standard SAP functionality.
  • Ability to lead requirements gathering sessions, process design workshops, fit-gap assessments, and solution validation activities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex business and system challenges.
  • Proven ability to manage workstream deliverables, project risks, stakeholder expectations, and timelines.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

  • A bachelor's degree with at least 2-4 years of SAP Procurement, Supply Chain, or consulting experience.
  • Experience supporting at least one full lifecycle SAP implementation, preferably an SAP S/4HANA transformation.
  • Hands-on experience in one or more SAP Procurement specializations, including:
    • SAP S/4HANA Procurement (Direct Materials)
    • SAP Invoice Management and Accounts Payable Integration
    • SAP Inventory Management
    • SAP Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, or Contracts
    • SAP Ariba Buying and Invoicing
    • SAP Ariba Integration, including Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG)
  • Experience configuring SAP MM procurement processes, including material master, business partner (vendor), RFQs, contracts, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, approval workflows, output management, goods receipts, stock transport orders, ALE, and IDocs.
  • Experience in one or more SAP Ariba solutions, including Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, Contracts, Buying and Invoicing, Supply Chain Collaboration, Commerce Automation, or Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG).
  • Knowledge of integration points with Accounts Payable, Production Planning, Sales & Distribution, and other related SAP modules.
  • Experience leading the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstream, including facilitating solution design workshops and developing proof of concepts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills.
  • Knowledge of leading practices, benchmarking, peer company environments and prior advisory experience relevant to industry specific finance and technology functions.
  • A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

  • Previous consulting experience within a professional services environment.
  • SAP S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement certification or other relevant SAP certifications.

What We Look For

We seek individuals who are proactive, innovative, and eager to contribute to team success. Top performers are those who demonstrate strong analytical skills, the ability to communicate effectively, and a passion for technology and its impact on business.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

  • The salary range for this job is:
    • New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $122,900 to $204,900
    • Bay Area California offices – $128,100 to $213,400
    • All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $102,500 to $187,900
  • Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

  • To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.
  • EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.
  • For those living in California, please click here for additional information.
  • At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.

All in to shape the future with confidence.

Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Our goal is to give clients a unique business perspective on how SAP technology can enhance their operations. By leveraging EY’s expertise in SAP, Supply Chain, FICO, BPC, Data & Analytics, Customer Solutions, Technology & Architecture, and SuccessFactors, we assist clients in enhancing performance and increasing productivity.

The Opportunity

Our SAP Procurement practice helps organizations modernize and optimize their source-to-pay operations through SAP S/4HANA. We work with clients to transform procurement processes, improve supplier collaboration, increase operational efficiency, and strengthen controls across purchasing, inventory management, and invoice processing.

As a Senior Technology Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You will interact with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, ensuring that newly implemented technology solutions meet their needs. Your collaboration with technical teams will be essential in designing and delivering effective system architecture solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for delivering top-notch business analysis and system configuration. Your day-to-day will involve:

  • Support SAP Procurement and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstreams within SAP S/4HANA implementation and transformation engagements.
  • Design and configure SAP Materials Management (MM) solutions across purchasing, inventory management, goods movements, and invoice verification processes.
  • Advise clients on procurement leading practices and SAP standard capabilities while balancing business requirements with scalable solutions.
  • Translating complex business requirements into detailed technical specifications
  • Develop functional specifications, process documentation, test scripts, training materials, and other project deliverables.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Sales to help deliver integrated business solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

On a typical engagement, you will work directly with procurement, supply chain, and finance leaders to understand business challenges and translate requirements into scalable SAP solutions. Success in this role requires a combination of functional procurement expertise, SAP configuration experience, and the ability to guide clients through large-scale transformation initiatives.

We are seeking professionals with demonstrated experience in one or more procurement specializations and an understanding of related end-to-end Procure-to-Pay processes.

Key skills include:

  • Deep understanding of Procure-to-Pay business processes and their integration points across the enterprise.
  • Experience designing SAP-enabled procurement solutions that balance business requirements with standard SAP functionality.
  • Ability to lead requirements gathering sessions, process design workshops, fit-gap assessments, and solution validation activities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex business and system challenges.
  • Proven ability to manage workstream deliverables, project risks, stakeholder expectations, and timelines.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

  • A bachelor's degree with at least 2-4 years of SAP Procurement, Supply Chain, or consulting experience.
  • Experience supporting at least one full lifecycle SAP implementation, preferably an SAP S/4HANA transformation.
  • Hands-on experience in one or more SAP Procurement specializations, including:
    • SAP S/4HANA Procurement (Direct Materials)
    • SAP Invoice Management and Accounts Payable Integration
    • SAP Inventory Management
    • SAP Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, or Contracts
    • SAP Ariba Buying and Invoicing
    • SAP Ariba Integration, including Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG)
  • Experience configuring SAP MM procurement processes, including material master, business partner (vendor), RFQs, contracts, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, approval workflows, output management, goods receipts, stock transport orders, ALE, and IDocs.
  • Experience in one or more SAP Ariba solutions, including Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, Contracts, Buying and Invoicing, Supply Chain Collaboration, Commerce Automation, or Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG).
  • Knowledge of integration points with Accounts Payable, Production Planning, Sales & Distribution, and other related SAP modules.
  • Experience leading the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstream, including facilitating solution design workshops and developing proof of concepts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills.
  • Knowledge of leading practices, benchmarking, peer company environments and prior advisory experience relevant to industry specific finance and technology functions.
  • A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

  • Previous consulting experience within a professional services environment.
  • SAP S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement certification or other relevant SAP certifications.

What We Look For

We seek individuals who are proactive, innovative, and eager to contribute to team success. Top performers are those who demonstrate strong analytical skills, the ability to communicate effectively, and a passion for technology and its impact on business.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

  • The salary range for this job is:
    • New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $122,900 to $204,900
    • Bay Area California offices – $128,100 to $213,400
    • All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $102,500 to $187,900
  • Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

  • To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.
  • EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.
  • For those living in California, please click here for additional information.
  • At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

All in to shape the future with confidence.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Our goal is to give clients a unique business perspective on how SAP technology can enhance their operations. By leveraging EY’s expertise in SAP, Supply Chain, FICO, BPC, Data & Analytics, Customer Solutions, Technology & Architecture, and SuccessFactors, we assist clients in enhancing performance and increasing productivity.

The Opportunity

Our SAP Procurement practice helps organizations modernize and optimize their source-to-pay operations through SAP S/4HANA. We work with clients to transform procurement processes, improve supplier collaboration, increase operational efficiency, and strengthen controls across purchasing, inventory management, and invoice processing.

As a Senior Technology Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You will interact with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, ensuring that newly implemented technology solutions meet their needs. Your collaboration with technical teams will be essential in designing and delivering effective system architecture solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for delivering top-notch business analysis and system configuration. Your day-to-day will involve:

  • Support SAP Procurement and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstreams within SAP S/4HANA implementation and transformation engagements.
  • Design and configure SAP Materials Management (MM) solutions across purchasing, inventory management, goods movements, and invoice verification processes.
  • Advise clients on procurement leading practices and SAP standard capabilities while balancing business requirements with scalable solutions.
  • Translating complex business requirements into detailed technical specifications
  • Develop functional specifications, process documentation, test scripts, training materials, and other project deliverables.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Sales to help deliver integrated business solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

On a typical engagement, you will work directly with procurement, supply chain, and finance leaders to understand business challenges and translate requirements into scalable SAP solutions. Success in this role requires a combination of functional procurement expertise, SAP configuration experience, and the ability to guide clients through large-scale transformation initiatives.

We are seeking professionals with demonstrated experience in one or more procurement specializations and an understanding of related end-to-end Procure-to-Pay processes.

Key skills include:

  • Deep understanding of Procure-to-Pay business processes and their integration points across the enterprise.
  • Experience designing SAP-enabled procurement solutions that balance business requirements with standard SAP functionality.
  • Ability to lead requirements gathering sessions, process design workshops, fit-gap assessments, and solution validation activities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex business and system challenges.
  • Proven ability to manage workstream deliverables, project risks, stakeholder expectations, and timelines.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

  • A bachelor's degree with at least 2-4 years of SAP Procurement, Supply Chain, or consulting experience.
  • Experience supporting at least one full lifecycle SAP implementation, preferably an SAP S/4HANA transformation.
  • Hands-on experience in one or more SAP Procurement specializations, including:
    • SAP S/4HANA Procurement (Direct Materials)
    • SAP Invoice Management and Accounts Payable Integration
    • SAP Inventory Management
    • SAP Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, or Contracts
    • SAP Ariba Buying and Invoicing
    • SAP Ariba Integration, including Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG)
  • Experience configuring SAP MM procurement processes, including material master, business partner (vendor), RFQs, contracts, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, approval workflows, output management, goods receipts, stock transport orders, ALE, and IDocs.
  • Experience in one or more SAP Ariba solutions, including Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, Contracts, Buying and Invoicing, Supply Chain Collaboration, Commerce Automation, or Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG).
  • Knowledge of integration points with Accounts Payable, Production Planning, Sales & Distribution, and other related SAP modules.
  • Experience leading the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstream, including facilitating solution design workshops and developing proof of concepts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills.
  • Knowledge of leading practices, benchmarking, peer company environments and prior advisory experience relevant to industry specific finance and technology functions.
  • A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

  • Previous consulting experience within a professional services environment.
  • SAP S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement certification or other relevant SAP certifications.

What We Look For

We seek individuals who are proactive, innovative, and eager to contribute to team success. Top performers are those who demonstrate strong analytical skills, the ability to communicate effectively, and a passion for technology and its impact on business.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

  • The salary range for this job is:
    • New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $122,900 to $204,900
    • Bay Area California offices – $128,100 to $213,400
    • All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $102,500 to $187,900
  • Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

descriptionHtml:
Today's finance leaders face increasing pressure to modernize operations, improve reporting accuracy, and scale efficiently as their businesses grow. As a NetSuite Senior Consultant at Deloitte, you will help clients design and implement NetSuite solutions that align with their business goals and deliver measurable results. This role fits professionals across core financial accounting, procure-to-pay, or order-to-cash implementation backgrounds. Join a team that is transforming how finance and accounting organizations operate by streamlining processes, improving reporting, and building lasting client relationships along the way.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant, you will implement and deploy NetSuite solutions:

  • Work within an engagement team, identifying business requirements, managing functional design, prototyping, and designing processes
  • Provide NetSuite consulting expertise, using industry experience, business analysis, and best practices to address clients' most complex requirements
  • Implement and deploy NetSuite solutions that accommodate unique industry, business, and regulatory requirements
  • Conduct business process mapping and requirements-gathering sessions with clients, on-site and remote
  • Prepare Business Requirements and Technical Scoping Documents for client approval
  • Build, develop, and test functional designs and scripted, customized solutions for business components and prototypes
  • Drive test planning, execution, and optimization support
  • Troubleshoot configuration issues and provide ongoing post-implementation support to optimize user adoption

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to build and maintain strong client and team relationships
  • Comfort managing multiple priorities across concurrent workstreams
  • Willingness to mentor and support the development of junior team members

The team

Our NetSuite practice helps upper mid-market and high-growth organizations modernize their financial and operational systems on a unified cloud platform. We work alongside clients to streamline processes, improve reporting, and support their next stage of growth. We're just as invested in our own team's growth, with hands-on learning and mentorship built into every engagement.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3+ years of relevant consulting or industry experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Record to Report: General Ledger, Consolidations, Multibook accounting, CTA Analysis, FX variances, and/or Financial Reporting
    • Procure to Pay: Accounts Payable
    • Order to Cash: Accounts Receivable
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Information Systems, or another related field
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
Preferred:

  • Certified NetSuite Professional (NetSuite Administrator / Suite Foundation / ERP Consultant / Multi-Book Consultant / ARM/Revenue Management)
  • Full lifecycle NetSuite implementation experience, including Design, Build, Test, Deploy, and Support phases
  • Experience with NetSuite integrations, customizations, and ERP data migration/cutover
  • Previous "Big 4" or large consulting firm experience
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage teams and stakeholders across global locations
  • Advanced degree in a relevant field
  • Eagerness to mentor junior staff

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,700 to $218,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

- Proven ability to manage workstream deliverables, project risks, stakeholder expectations, and timelines. 
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.

- SAP Inventory Management

If you're seeking an exciting career with plenty of opportunities, consider joining us at Deloitte. We work on projects involving Workday Financials, Supply Chain Management, Infor Solutions, Microsoft Dynamics, and Sustainability Technology and Strategy. With such a variety of areas to explore, you'll have the chance to make a real impact while growing in your career. Come be part of a team that values innovation and strives for excellence. Apply now and let's achieve great things together!

Deloitte's Emerging ERP Solutions-Workday teams are market leaders working with clients across industries to deliver transformational solutions optimized for their unique business needs.

Recruiting for this role ends on 4/1/2026

Work you'll do

As a Workday Financials Sr Consultant, you will lead project workstreams, identify and document business requirements, provide functional design, prototyping (including scenario design, flow mapping), testing, user training, defining support procedures. Additional duties may include: coordination of schedules, creation of documentation and collateral, creation and execution of test / use cases, configuration of Workday software, assisting with prioritization and sequencing of the workstream's efforts and assisting project leadership as required.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of consulting or industry experience in Workday Financials/ERP finance domain
  • 2+ years of experience leading Financials workstreams as well as project teams
  • Workday Financials Professional certification or capability to obtain upon joining
  • A minimum of 1 full life cycle Workday Financial implementation
  • Demonstrated knowledge in some combination of the following: Record to Report, Procure-to-Pay (PTP), Order-to-Cash (OTC)
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Bachelor's Degree or 8 years equivalent professional experience
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred

  • An advanced degree in the area of specialization
  • Functional knowledge around financial systems and processes.
  • Experience defining systems strategy, developing systems requirements, designing and prototyping, testing, training, defining support procedures, and implementing practical business solutions under multiple deadlines Ability to work independently, manage small engagements or parts of large engagements
  • Experience as a lead and mentor to junior staff
  • Presentation skills (MS Visio, MS PowerPoint)

Wages + Salary

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $116,000 to $229,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance

Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Our goal is to give clients a unique business perspective on how SAP technology can enhance their operations. By leveraging EY’s expertise in SAP, Supply Chain, FICO, BPC, Data & Analytics, Customer Solutions, Technology & Architecture, and SuccessFactors, we assist clients in enhancing performance and increasing productivity.

The Opportunity

Our SAP Procurement practice helps organizations modernize and optimize their source-to-pay operations through SAP S/4HANA. We work with clients to transform procurement processes, improve supplier collaboration, increase operational efficiency, and strengthen controls across purchasing, inventory management, and invoice processing.

As a Senior Technology Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You will interact with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, ensuring that newly implemented technology solutions meet their needs. Your collaboration with technical teams will be essential in designing and delivering effective system architecture solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for delivering top-notch business analysis and system configuration. Your day-to-day will involve:

  • Support SAP Procurement and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstreams within SAP S/4HANA implementation and transformation engagements.
  • Design and configure SAP Materials Management (MM) solutions across purchasing, inventory management, goods movements, and invoice verification processes.
  • Advise clients on procurement leading practices and SAP standard capabilities while balancing business requirements with scalable solutions.
  • Translating complex business requirements into detailed technical specifications
  • Develop functional specifications, process documentation, test scripts, training materials, and other project deliverables.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Sales to help deliver integrated business solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

On a typical engagement, you will work directly with procurement, supply chain, and finance leaders to understand business challenges and translate requirements into scalable SAP solutions. Success in this role requires a combination of functional procurement expertise, SAP configuration experience, and the ability to guide clients through large-scale transformation initiatives.

We are seeking professionals with demonstrated experience in one or more procurement specializations and an understanding of related end-to-end Procure-to-Pay processes.

Key skills include:

  • Deep understanding of Procure-to-Pay business processes and their integration points across the enterprise.
  • Experience designing SAP-enabled procurement solutions that balance business requirements with standard SAP functionality.
  • Ability to lead requirements gathering sessions, process design workshops, fit-gap assessments, and solution validation activities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex business and system challenges.
  • Proven ability to manage workstream deliverables, project risks, stakeholder expectations, and timelines.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

  • A bachelor's degree with at least 2-4 years of SAP Procurement, Supply Chain, or consulting experience.
  • Experience supporting at least one full lifecycle SAP implementation, preferably an SAP S/4HANA transformation.
  • Hands-on experience in one or more SAP Procurement specializations, including:
    • SAP S/4HANA Procurement (Direct Materials)
    • SAP Invoice Management and Accounts Payable Integration
    • SAP Inventory Management
    • SAP Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, or Contracts
    • SAP Ariba Buying and Invoicing
    • SAP Ariba Integration, including Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG)
  • Experience configuring SAP MM procurement processes, including material master, business partner (vendor), RFQs, contracts, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, approval workflows, output management, goods receipts, stock transport orders, ALE, and IDocs.
  • Experience in one or more SAP Ariba solutions, including Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, Contracts, Buying and Invoicing, Supply Chain Collaboration, Commerce Automation, or Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG).
  • Knowledge of integration points with Accounts Payable, Production Planning, Sales & Distribution, and other related SAP modules.
  • Experience leading the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstream, including facilitating solution design workshops and developing proof of concepts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills.
  • Knowledge of leading practices, benchmarking, peer company environments and prior advisory experience relevant to industry specific finance and technology functions.
  • A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

  • Previous consulting experience within a professional services environment.
  • SAP S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement certification or other relevant SAP certifications.

What We Look For

We seek individuals who are proactive, innovative, and eager to contribute to team success. Top performers are those who demonstrate strong analytical skills, the ability to communicate effectively, and a passion for technology and its impact on business.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

  • The salary range for this job is:
    • New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $122,900 to $204,900
    • Bay Area California offices – $128,100 to $213,400
    • All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $102,500 to $187,900
  • Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

  • EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.

descriptionHtml:
This role involves managing all aspects of the platform transition, including planning, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support. In this pivotal role, you will provide critical leadership and guidance to functions, utilizing your extensive knowledge and experience of the SAP S/4 HANA system.

Position Responsibilities: may include:

  • SAP S/4HANA Implementation: Oversee the full lifecycle of SAP S/4 HANA SD deployment, from initial system design, configuring and customizing the system to meet Daikin's unique requirements, to conducting comprehensive system and user acceptance testing, to finally deploying the system.
  • Planning and Strategy: Create a data-driven approach to plan for Daikin's end-to-end business transformation towards SAP S/4 standard processes. Evaluate our existing processes and create strategic plans to integrate these with S/4 HANA's functionalities.
  • Process Optimization: Understand business processes for P2P (Branch and Corporate), identify areas for improvement, and ensure the solution aligns with SAP S/4HANA environment.
  • Stakeholder Management: Work closely with relevant internal and external stakeholders, including inventory, finance, logistics, to ensure seamless integration of S/4 HANA functions with other business operations. Also, manage relationships with external SAP consultants and solution providers.
  • Training and Support: Develop a comprehensive training program for end users, thus driving S/4 HANA adoption across the organization. This includes conceptualizing user manuals, training materials, and reference guides.
  • Vendor Management: Collaborate with SAP consultants and other technology partners to ensure project deliverables are met within timelines and budgets.
  • Data Integrity and Migration: Oversee the migration of sales and distribution data from legacy systems to SAP S/4HANA, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
  • Continuous Improvement: Post-implementation, continuously monitor processes within SAP S/4HANA to identify and implement further enhancements.

Nature & Scope

  • Is recognized as a subject matter expert in job area
  • Manages large projects or processes with limited oversight from manager
  • Coaches, reviews, and delegates work to lower-level professionals
  • Problems faced are difficult and often complex

Knowledge & Skills

  • 5+ years of SAP functional experience with strong focus in P2P.
  • Extensive knowledge of the integral functions, features, and capabilities of SAP S/4 HANA SD
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven track record of driving large-scale technology transformation projects to completion.
  • Exceptional problem-solving capabilities, meticulous attention to detail, and robust decision-making abilities.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels.

Experience

  • 10 plus years of direct experience with SAP modules

Education/Certification

  • A bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

People Management: No

Physical Requirements / Work Environment

  • Must be able to perform essential responsibilities with or without reasonable accommodations

Reports To

  • SAP Enterprise Architecture and Solution Leader

Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Our goal is to give clients a unique business perspective on how SAP technology can enhance their operations. By leveraging EY’s expertise in SAP, Supply Chain, FICO, BPC, Data & Analytics, Customer Solutions, Technology & Architecture, and SuccessFactors, we assist clients in enhancing performance and increasing productivity.

The Opportunity

Our SAP Procurement practice helps organizations modernize and optimize their source-to-pay operations through SAP S/4HANA. We work with clients to transform procurement processes, improve supplier collaboration, increase operational efficiency, and strengthen controls across purchasing, inventory management, and invoice processing.

As a Senior Technology Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You will interact with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, ensuring that newly implemented technology solutions meet their needs. Your collaboration with technical teams will be essential in designing and delivering effective system architecture solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for delivering top-notch business analysis and system configuration. Your day-to-day will involve:

  • Support SAP Procurement and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstreams within SAP S/4HANA implementation and transformation engagements.
  • Design and configure SAP Materials Management (MM) solutions across purchasing, inventory management, goods movements, and invoice verification processes.
  • Advise clients on procurement leading practices and SAP standard capabilities while balancing business requirements with scalable solutions.
  • Translating complex business requirements into detailed technical specifications
  • Develop functional specifications, process documentation, test scripts, training materials, and other project deliverables.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Sales to help deliver integrated business solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

On a typical engagement, you will work directly with procurement, supply chain, and finance leaders to understand business challenges and translate requirements into scalable SAP solutions. Success in this role requires a combination of functional procurement expertise, SAP configuration experience, and the ability to guide clients through large-scale transformation initiatives.

We are seeking professionals with demonstrated experience in one or more procurement specializations and an understanding of related end-to-end Procure-to-Pay processes.

Key skills include:

  • Deep understanding of Procure-to-Pay business processes and their integration points across the enterprise.
  • Experience designing SAP-enabled procurement solutions that balance business requirements with standard SAP functionality.
  • Ability to lead requirements gathering sessions, process design workshops, fit-gap assessments, and solution validation activities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex business and system challenges.
  • Proven ability to manage workstream deliverables, project risks, stakeholder expectations, and timelines.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

  • A bachelor's degree with at least 2-4 years of SAP Procurement, Supply Chain, or consulting experience.
  • Experience supporting at least one full lifecycle SAP implementation, preferably an SAP S/4HANA transformation.
  • Hands-on experience in one or more SAP Procurement specializations, including:
    • SAP S/4HANA Procurement (Direct Materials)
    • SAP Invoice Management and Accounts Payable Integration
    • SAP Inventory Management
    • SAP Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, or Contracts
    • SAP Ariba Buying and Invoicing
    • SAP Ariba Integration, including Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG)
  • Experience configuring SAP MM procurement processes, including material master, business partner (vendor), RFQs, contracts, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, approval workflows, output management, goods receipts, stock transport orders, ALE, and IDocs.
  • Experience in one or more SAP Ariba solutions, including Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, Contracts, Buying and Invoicing, Supply Chain Collaboration, Commerce Automation, or Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG).
  • Knowledge of integration points with Accounts Payable, Production Planning, Sales & Distribution, and other related SAP modules.
  • Experience leading the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstream, including facilitating solution design workshops and developing proof of concepts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills.
  • Knowledge of leading practices, benchmarking, peer company environments and prior advisory experience relevant to industry specific finance and technology functions.
  • A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

  • Previous consulting experience within a professional services environment.
  • SAP S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement certification or other relevant SAP certifications.

What We Look For

We seek individuals who are proactive, innovative, and eager to contribute to team success. Top performers are those who demonstrate strong analytical skills, the ability to communicate effectively, and a passion for technology and its impact on business.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

  • The salary range for this job is:
    • New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $122,900 to $204,900
    • Bay Area California offices – $128,100 to $213,400
    • All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $102,500 to $187,900
  • Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

  • To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.
  • EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.
  • For those living in California, please click here for additional information.
  • At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.

  • Experience designing SAP-enabled procurement solutions that balance business requirements with standard SAP functionality.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex business and system challenges.
  • Proven ability to manage workstream deliverables, project risks, stakeholder expectations, and timelines.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills.

  • A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.

descriptionHtml:
Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

Job Description:

What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

About The Team

Crowe’s NetSuite consulting practice helps organizations transform their finance and operational systems through the implementation and optimization of Oracle NetSuite ERP, a leading cloud-based enterprise resource planning platform. Our team works with clients across a range of industries to design, implement, and support scalable ERP solutions that improve financial visibility, streamline operations, and enable data-driven decision-making.

Our professionals combine deep accounting and operational expertise with technical NetSuite capabilities—including financial modules, workflows, reporting, integrations, and automation—to deliver end-to-end implementations and process improvements. As part of our growing consulting practice, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions that help organizations modernize their finance functions and support long-term growth.

About The Role

Crowe seeks a NetSuite Implementation Senior Consultant to support ERP implementations for Manufacturing and Distribution clients. This role works directly with clients and project teams throughout implementation engagements, helping translate business requirements into effective NetSuite solutions. You will contribute across the full implementation lifecycle, including discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.

The ideal candidate combines ERP consulting experience with strong NetSuite functional knowledge and an understanding of supply chain processes. Experience supporting manufacturing operations, inventory management, supply chain, order management, and related business processes is highly valued.

This role requires strong client-facing and problem-solving skills, along with the ability to manage key project responsibilities and deliver high-quality work with limited oversight. You will collaborate with client stakeholders across finance, operations, supply chain, warehouse, and production teams to understand business needs, configure solutions, and support successful implementations. Together with Crowe’s project teams, you will help design scalable NetSuite solutions that improve operational efficiency, streamline processes, and enhance inventory visibility.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead NetSuite solution design across all core and advanced modules (Financials, Advanced Inventory, WMS, Advanced Manufacturing), ensuring business needs are met through scalable configuration and best-fit system architecture.
  • Own functional configuration of NetSuite, including workflows, saved searches, dashboards, custom forms, roles, and permissions – without performing hands-on coding, but with a strong understanding of SuiteScript, Suitelets, and SuiteCloud architecture to guide technical teams effectively.
  • Collaborate with integration leads to design and validate data flows and interface architecture between NetSuite and external systems, including field mapping, API methods (SuiteTalk/RESTlet), and middleware approaches (e.g., Celigo, Boomi).
  • Evaluate and recommend solution approaches (standard vs. custom vs. SuiteApp) during design workshops and RTM reviews, balancing implementation speed, cost, and long-term maintainability.
  • Support the development of Functional Design Documents (FDDs) and ensure alignment between functional requirements, system design, and technical specifications throughout the build lifecycle.
  • Act as a solutioning lead during Design Phase, partnering with functional consultants to drive business process mapping, gap-fit assessments, and solution documentation aligned to PE-backed client scaling needs.
  • Provide configuration oversight and quality assurance, reviewing proposed scripts, workflows, custom records, and data models for adherence to Crowe and NetSuite standards.
  • Serve as a cross-functional escalation point for architecture or solution design decisions, ensuring technical feasibility and stakeholder alignment across workstreams.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, Supply Chain, Engineering, or related field
  • NetSuite Certifications – Suite Foundations, Administrator and ERP Consultant required.

Experience:

  • 4+ years of NetSuite experience with a focus on solution design, module architecture, or technical oversight roles.
  • Prior experience in multi-entity, multi-currency, or fast-scaling environments.

The Opportunity

Our SAP Procurement practice helps organizations modernize and optimize their source-to-pay operations through SAP S/4HANA. We work with clients to transform procurement processes, improve supplier collaboration, increase operational efficiency, and strengthen controls across purchasing, inventory management, and invoice processing.

As a Senior Technology Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You will interact with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, ensuring that newly implemented technology solutions meet their needs. Your collaboration with technical teams will be essential in designing and delivering effective system architecture solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for delivering top-notch business analysis and system configuration. Your day-to-day will involve:

  • Support SAP Procurement and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstreams within SAP S/4HANA implementation and transformation engagements.
  • Design and configure SAP Materials Management (MM) solutions across purchasing, inventory management, goods movements, and invoice verification processes.
  • Advise clients on procurement leading practices and SAP standard capabilities while balancing business requirements with scalable solutions.
  • Translating complex business requirements into detailed technical specifications
  • Develop functional specifications, process documentation, test scripts, training materials, and other project deliverables.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Sales to help deliver integrated business solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

On a typical engagement, you will work directly with procurement, supply chain, and finance leaders to understand business challenges and translate requirements into scalable SAP solutions. Success in this role requires a combination of functional procurement expertise, SAP configuration experience, and the ability to guide clients through large-scale transformation initiatives.

We are seeking professionals with demonstrated experience in one or more procurement specializations and an understanding of related end-to-end Procure-to-Pay processes.

Key skills include:

  • Deep understanding of Procure-to-Pay business processes and their integration points across the enterprise.
  • Experience designing SAP-enabled procurement solutions that balance business requirements with standard SAP functionality.
  • Ability to lead requirements gathering sessions, process design workshops, fit-gap assessments, and solution validation activities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex business and system challenges.
  • Proven ability to manage workstream deliverables, project risks, stakeholder expectations, and timelines.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

  • A bachelor's degree with at least 2-4 years of SAP Procurement, Supply Chain, or consulting experience.
  • Experience supporting at least one full lifecycle SAP implementation, preferably an SAP S/4HANA transformation.
  • Hands-on experience in one or more SAP Procurement specializations, including:
    • SAP S/4HANA Procurement (Direct Materials)
    • SAP Invoice Management and Accounts Payable Integration
    • SAP Inventory Management
    • SAP Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, or Contracts
    • SAP Ariba Buying and Invoicing
    • SAP Ariba Integration, including Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG)
  • Experience configuring SAP MM procurement processes, including material master, business partner (vendor), RFQs, contracts, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, approval workflows, output management, goods receipts, stock transport orders, ALE, and IDocs.
  • Experience in one or more SAP Ariba solutions, including Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, Contracts, Buying and Invoicing, Supply Chain Collaboration, Commerce Automation, or Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG).
  • Knowledge of integration points with Accounts Payable, Production Planning, Sales & Distribution, and other related SAP modules.
  • Experience leading the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstream, including facilitating solution design workshops and developing proof of concepts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills.
  • Knowledge of leading practices, benchmarking, peer company environments and prior advisory experience relevant to industry specific finance and technology functions.
  • A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

  • Previous consulting experience within a professional services environment.
  • SAP S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement certification or other relevant SAP certifications.

What We Look For

We seek individuals who are proactive, innovative, and eager to contribute to team success. Top performers are those who demonstrate strong analytical skills, the ability to communicate effectively, and a passion for technology and its impact on business.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

  • Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Excellent client-facing and consulting experience.

The Emerging ERP Solutions practice is all about bringing you the best in cloud-based ERP applications like Workday and Infor. We're here to help transform finance and supply-chain processes, making them more efficient and cost-effective. Our teams use Deloitte's vast expertise to deliver lasting results for our clients. By working closely with CFOs, CIOs, and Business Unit leaders, we provide valuable business transformation and continuous support across various industries.

If you're seeking an exciting career with plenty of opportunities, consider joining us at Deloitte. We work on projects involving Workday Financials, Supply Chain Management, Infor Solutions, Microsoft Dynamics, and Sustainability Technology and Strategy. With such a variety of areas to explore, you'll have the chance to make a real impact while growing in your career. Come be part of a team that values innovation and strives for excellence. Apply now and let's achieve great things together!

Deloitte's Emerging ERP Solutions-Workday teams are market leaders working with clients across industries to deliver transformational solutions optimized for their unique business needs.

Recruiting for this role ends on 4/1/2026

Work you'll do

As a Workday Supply Chain Management Sr Consultant, you will lead project workstreams, identify and document business requirements, provide functional design, prototyping (including scenario design, flow mapping), testing, user training, defining support procedures. Additional duties may include: coordination of schedules, creation of documentation and collateral, creation and execution of test / use cases, configuration of Workday software, assisting with prioritization and sequencing of the workstream's efforts and assisting project leadership as required.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of consulting or industry experience in Workday SCM/ERP finance domain
  • 2+ years of experience leading SCM workstreams as well as project teams
  • Workday SCM Professional certification or capability to obtain upon joining
  • A minimum of 1 full life cycle Workday SCM implementation
  • Demonstrated knowledge in some combination of the following: Procure-to-Pay (PTP), Order-to-Cash (OTC)
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Bachelor's Degree or 8 years equivalent professional experience
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred

  • An advanced degree in the area of specialization
  • Functional knowledge around SCM systems and processes.
  • Experience defining systems strategy, developing systems requirements, designing and prototyping, testing, training, defining support procedures, and implementing practical business solutions under multiple deadlines Ability to work independently, manage small engagements or parts of large engagements
  • Experience as a lead and mentor to junior staff
  • Presentation skills (MS Visio, MS PowerPoint)

Wages + Salary

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $116,000 to $229,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance

Deloitte is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for people with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the recruiting process, please direct your inquiries to the Global Call Center (GCC) at USTalentCICInbox@deloitte.com.

Information for applicants with a need for accommodation: https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/pages/careers/articles/join-deloitte-assistance-for-disabled-applicants.html

descriptionHtml:
A career in our Microsoft Dynamics team will provide the opportunity to help our clients transform their technology landscape across Front, Back and Mid-Office functions leveraging Microsoft Dynamics. We focus on contributing to PwC’s value proposition of “strategy led and technology enabled”, by aligning our Consulting Solutions’ industry focus with the Microsoft technologies such as Dynamics 365, Azure, Power Platform and Power BI.

To really stand out and make us fit for the future in a constantly changing world, each and every one of us at PwC needs to be a purpose-led and values-driven leader at every level. To help us achieve this we have the PwC Professional; our global leadership development framework. It gives us a single set of expectations across our lines, geographies and career paths, and provides transparency on the skills we need as individuals to be successful and progress in our careers, now and in the future.

As a Senior Associate, You'll Work As Part Of a Team Of Problem Solvers, Helping To Solve Complex Business Issues From Strategy To Execution. PwC Professional Skills And Responsibilities For This Management Level Include But Are Not Limited To:

Use feedback and reflection to develop self awareness, personal strengths and address development areas.

Delegate to others to provide stretch opportunities, coaching them to deliver results.

Demonstrate critical thinking and the ability to bring order to unstructured problems.

Use a broad range of tools and techniques to extract insights from current industry or sector trends.

Review your work and that of others for quality, accuracy and relevance.

Know how and when to use tools available for a given situation and can explain the reasons for this choice.

Seek and embrace opportunities which give exposure to different situations, environments and perspectives.

Use straightforward communication, in a structured way, when influencing and connecting with others.

Able to read situations and modify behavior to build quality relationships.

Uphold the firm's code of ethics and business conduct.

The Opportunity

As part of the Business Application Consulting team you leverage Dynamics 365 Applications to deliver solutions tailored to client needs. As a Senior Associate you analyze complex problems, mentor others, and uphold professional standards while building meaningful client connections. You engage in client-facing roles, manage project tasks, and contribute to the lifecycle stages of Dynamics 365 solutions, enhancing your technical strengths and personal growth.

Responsibilities

  • Utilize Dynamics 365 Applications to craft impactful solutions
  • Interpret client needs and provide guidance on D365 business cases
  • Oversee project tasks to achieve timely and budget-friendly completion
  • Foster meaningful connections with clients while navigating uncertainties
  • Mentor team members to uphold elevated standards
  • Analyze intricate issues and develop strategic solutions
  • Maintain a profound understanding of client requirements
  • Achieve delivery of quality solutions

What You Must Have

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • 4 to 7 years of experience
  • Microsoft Dynamics 365 certification
  • Demonstrating thorough knowledge and/or a proven record of success leveraging Dynamics 365 Applications (F&O, CE, Project Operations, or others), as well as other Microsoft solution offerings
  • Possessing experience with configuration and customization of Microsoft Dynamics 365 products

What Sets You Apart

  • One or more certifications within Dynamics 365 applications preferred
  • Leading efforts to understand and implement D365 solutions
  • Interacting with clients to understand key requirements
  • Advising on complex D365 business cases
  • Conducting business process analysis and creating process flows
  • Developing project plans and managing tasks on time
  • Demonstrating abilities as a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Functional Consultant
  • Leveraging project management skills to lead engagements
  • Providing guidance and feedback to less-experienced staff

The salary range for this position is: $77,000 - $202,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. All hired individuals are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. PwC offers a wide range of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401k, holiday pay, vacation, personal and family sick leave, and more. To view our benefits at a glance, please visit the following link: https://pwc.to/benefits-at-a-glance

As PwC is an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment at PwC without regard to race; color; religion; national origin; sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity); age; disability; genetic information (including family medical history); veteran, marital, or citizenship status; or, any other status protected by law. 

PwC does not intend to hire experienced or entry level job seekers who will need, now or in the future, PwC sponsorship through the H-1B lottery, except as set forth within the following policy: https://pwc.to/H-1B-Lottery-Policy.

Learn more about how we work: https://pwc.to/how-we-work

For only those qualified applicants that are impacted by the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, San Diego County Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act, where applicable, arrest or conviction records will be considered for Employment in accordance with these laws. We evaluate these factors thoughtfully to establish a secure and trusted workplace for all.

descriptionHtml:
Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

Job Description:

What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

About The Team

Crowe’s NetSuite consulting practice helps organizations transform their finance and operational systems through the implementation and optimization of Oracle NetSuite ERP, a leading cloud-based enterprise resource planning platform. Our team works with clients across a range of industries to design, implement, and support scalable ERP solutions that improve financial visibility, streamline operations, and enable data-driven decision-making.

Our professionals combine deep accounting and operational expertise with technical NetSuite capabilities—including financial modules, workflows, reporting, integrations, and automation—to deliver end-to-end implementations and process improvements. As part of our growing consulting practice, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions that help organizations modernize their finance functions and support long-term growth.

About The Role

Crowe seeks a NetSuite Implementation Senior Consultant to support ERP implementations for Manufacturing and Distribution clients. This role works directly with clients and project teams throughout implementation engagements, helping translate business requirements into effective NetSuite solutions. You will contribute across the full implementation lifecycle, including discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.

The ideal candidate combines ERP consulting experience with strong NetSuite functional knowledge and an understanding of supply chain processes. Experience supporting manufacturing operations, inventory management, supply chain, order management, and related business processes is highly valued.

A career in our Microsoft Dynamics team will provide the opportunity to help our clients transform their technology landscape across Front, Back and Mid-Office functions leveraging Microsoft Dynamics.
