To really stand out and make us fit for the future in a constantly changing world, each and every one of us at PwC needs to be a purpose-led and values-driven leader at every level. To help us achieve this we have the PwC Professional; our global leadership development framework. It gives us a single set of expectations across our lines, geographies and career paths, and provides transparency on the skills we need as individuals to be successful and progress in our careers, now and in the future.

As a Senior Associate, You'll Work As Part Of a Team Of Problem Solvers, Helping To Solve Complex Business Issues From Strategy To Execution. PwC Professional Skills And Responsibilities For This Management Level Include But Are Not Limited To:

Use feedback and reflection to develop self awareness, personal strengths and address development areas.

Delegate to others to provide stretch opportunities, coaching them to deliver results.

Demonstrate critical thinking and the ability to bring order to unstructured problems.

Use a broad range of tools and techniques to extract insights from current industry or sector trends.

Review your work and that of others for quality, accuracy and relevance.

Know how and when to use tools available for a given situation and can explain the reasons for this choice.

Seek and embrace opportunities which give exposure to different situations, environments and perspectives.

Use straightforward communication, in a structured way, when influencing and connecting with others.

Able to read situations and modify behavior to build quality relationships.

Uphold the firm's code of ethics and business conduct.

The Opportunity

As part of the Business Application Consulting team you leverage Dynamics 365 Applications to deliver solutions tailored to client needs. As a Senior Associate you analyze complex problems, mentor others, and uphold professional standards while building meaningful client connections. You engage in client-facing roles, manage project tasks, and contribute to the lifecycle stages of Dynamics 365 solutions, enhancing your technical strengths and personal growth.

Responsibilities

  • Utilize Dynamics 365 Applications to craft impactful solutions
  • Interpret client needs and provide guidance on D365 business cases
  • Oversee project tasks to achieve timely and budget-friendly completion
  • Foster meaningful connections with clients while navigating uncertainties
  • Mentor team members to uphold elevated standards
  • Analyze intricate issues and develop strategic solutions
  • Maintain a profound understanding of client requirements
  • Achieve delivery of quality solutions

What You Must Have

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • 4 to 7 years of experience
  • Microsoft Dynamics 365 certification
  • Demonstrating thorough knowledge and/or a proven record of success leveraging Dynamics 365 Applications (F&O, CE, Project Operations, or others), as well as other Microsoft solution offerings
  • Possessing experience with configuration and customization of Microsoft Dynamics 365 products

What Sets You Apart

  • One or more certifications within Dynamics 365 applications preferred
  • Leading efforts to understand and implement D365 solutions
  • Interacting with clients to understand key requirements
  • Advising on complex D365 business cases
  • Conducting business process analysis and creating process flows
  • Developing project plans and managing tasks on time
  • Demonstrating abilities as a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Functional Consultant
  • Leveraging project management skills to lead engagements
  • Providing guidance and feedback to less-experienced staff

The salary range for this position is: $77,000 - $202,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. All hired individuals are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. PwC offers a wide range of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401k, holiday pay, vacation, personal and family sick leave, and more. To view our benefits at a glance, please visit the following link: https://pwc.to/benefits-at-a-glance

As PwC is an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment at PwC without regard to race; color; religion; national origin; sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity); age; disability; genetic information (including family medical history); veteran, marital, or citizenship status; or, any other status protected by law.

Learn more about how we work: https://pwc.to/how-we-work

This role will conduct discovery, requirements gathering, process documentation, configuration, and implementation management of ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning), CRM (Customer Relationship Management), HCM (Human Capital Management) and other related business applications functioning as a key resource for our clients spanning, finance, product distribution, manufacturing, job costing, field service, sales, marketing, service, and reporting.

    • Envisions and develops representations of recommended future state options for evaluation by clients
    • Understands related security structures and best practices
    • Designs and develops scorecards for evaluation of candidate business applications
    • Creates dashboard presentations of quantitative and qualitative scoring of candidate options
    • Supports Technical Leads, Developers and Managers by providing functional clarifications and setting expectations with team and client

    • Performs functional (business process) solution design in business applications (ERP, HCM, CRM, & related) contexts, to provide maximized business value and deliver strong business agility while meeting applicable requirements and constraints
  • Consulting:
    • Gains a deep understanding of client needs, analyzes best practices, and plays an integral part in defining and proposing business value solutions that meet or exceed client expectations
  • Program & Project Management:
    • Supports, and manages aspects of business applications implementations
    • Documents and maintains project milestones, phases, elements, and budget
    • Monitors project progress by tracking risks, actions, issues, decisions, and other activities
    • Develops references for users by writing and maintaining user documentation; providing help desk support; training users
  • Implementation and Support:
    • Provides functional support of EBA solutions and related technologies
    • Manages and resolves issues, defects, and change requests
    • Manages and performs systems configuration tasks (but not coding/development) for process workstreams as directed
    • Provides ongoing support during project implementations and post-go-live support
    • Responsible for configuration of solution based on requirements
  • Fosters a positive demeanor, learning attitude and client service mentality with the team
  • Travel – up to 25%, as needed
  • Other duties, as required

descriptionHtml:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Our goal is to give clients a unique business perspective on how SAP technology can enhance their operations. By leveraging EY’s expertise in SAP, Supply Chain, FICO, BPC, Data & Analytics, Customer Solutions, Technology & Architecture, and SuccessFactors, we assist clients in enhancing performance and increasing productivity.

The Opportunity

Our SAP Procurement practice helps organizations modernize and optimize their source-to-pay operations through SAP S/4HANA. We work with clients to transform procurement processes, improve supplier collaboration, increase operational efficiency, and strengthen controls across purchasing, inventory management, and invoice processing.

As a Senior Technology Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You will interact with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, ensuring that newly implemented technology solutions meet their needs. Your collaboration with technical teams will be essential in designing and delivering effective system architecture solutions.

descriptionHtml:
Today's finance leaders face increasing pressure to modernize operations, improve reporting accuracy, and scale efficiently as their businesses grow. As a NetSuite Senior Consultant at Deloitte, you will help clients design and implement NetSuite solutions that align with their business goals and deliver measurable results. This role fits professionals across core financial accounting, procure-to-pay, or order-to-cash implementation backgrounds. Join a team that is transforming how finance and accounting organizations operate by streamlining processes, improving reporting, and building lasting client relationships along the way.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant, you will implement and deploy NetSuite solutions:

  • Work within an engagement team, identifying business requirements, managing functional design, prototyping, and designing processes
  • Provide NetSuite consulting expertise, using industry experience, business analysis, and best practices to address clients' most complex requirements
  • Implement and deploy NetSuite solutions that accommodate unique industry, business, and regulatory requirements
  • Conduct business process mapping and requirements-gathering sessions with clients, on-site and remote
  • Prepare Business Requirements and Technical Scoping Documents for client approval
  • Build, develop, and test functional designs and scripted, customized solutions for business components and prototypes
  • Drive test planning, execution, and optimization support
  • Troubleshoot configuration issues and provide ongoing post-implementation support to optimize user adoption

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to build and maintain strong client and team relationships
  • Comfort managing multiple priorities across concurrent workstreams
  • Willingness to mentor and support the development of junior team members

The team

Our NetSuite practice helps upper mid-market and high-growth organizations modernize their financial and operational systems on a unified cloud platform. We work alongside clients to streamline processes, improve reporting, and support their next stage of growth. We're just as invested in our own team's growth, with hands-on learning and mentorship built into every engagement.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3+ years of relevant consulting or industry experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Record to Report: General Ledger, Consolidations, Multibook accounting, CTA Analysis, FX variances, and/or Financial Reporting
    • Procure to Pay: Accounts Payable
    • Order to Cash: Accounts Receivable
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Information Systems, or another related field
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
Preferred:

  • Certified NetSuite Professional (NetSuite Administrator / Suite Foundation / ERP Consultant / Multi-Book Consultant / ARM/Revenue Management)
  • Full lifecycle NetSuite implementation experience, including Design, Build, Test, Deploy, and Support phases
  • Experience with NetSuite integrations, customizations, and ERP data migration/cutover
  • Previous "Big 4" or large consulting firm experience
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage teams and stakeholders across global locations
  • Advanced degree in a relevant field
  • Eagerness to mentor junior staff

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,700 to $218,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job Description:

What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

About The Team

Crowe’s NetSuite consulting practice helps organizations transform their finance and operational systems through the implementation and optimization of Oracle NetSuite ERP, a leading cloud-based enterprise resource planning platform. Our team works with clients across a range of industries to design, implement, and support scalable ERP solutions that improve financial visibility, streamline operations, and enable data-driven decision-making.

Our professionals combine deep accounting and operational expertise with technical NetSuite capabilities—including financial modules, workflows, reporting, integrations, and automation—to deliver end-to-end implementations and process improvements. As part of our growing consulting practice, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions that help organizations modernize their finance functions and support long-term growth.

About The Role

Crowe seeks a NetSuite Implementation Senior Consultant to support ERP implementations for Manufacturing and Distribution clients. This role works directly with clients and project teams throughout implementation engagements, helping translate business requirements into effective NetSuite solutions. You will contribute across the full implementation lifecycle, including discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.

The ideal candidate combines ERP consulting experience with strong NetSuite functional knowledge and an understanding of supply chain processes. Experience supporting manufacturing operations, inventory management, supply chain, order management, and related business processes is highly valued.

This role requires strong client-facing and problem-solving skills, along with the ability to manage key project responsibilities and deliver high-quality work with limited oversight. You will collaborate with client stakeholders across finance, operations, supply chain, warehouse, and production teams to understand business needs, configure solutions, and support successful implementations. Together with Crowe’s project teams, you will help design scalable NetSuite solutions that improve operational efficiency, streamline processes, and enhance inventory visibility.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead NetSuite solution design across all core and advanced modules (Financials, Advanced Inventory, WMS, Advanced Manufacturing), ensuring business needs are met through scalable configuration and best-fit system architecture.
  • Own functional configuration of NetSuite, including workflows, saved searches, dashboards, custom forms, roles, and permissions – without performing hands-on coding, but with a strong understanding of SuiteScript, Suitelets, and SuiteCloud architecture to guide technical teams effectively.
  • Collaborate with integration leads to design and validate data flows and interface architecture between NetSuite and external systems, including field mapping, API methods (SuiteTalk/RESTlet), and middleware approaches (e.g., Celigo, Boomi).
  • Evaluate and recommend solution approaches (standard vs. custom vs. SuiteApp) during design workshops and RTM reviews, balancing implementation speed, cost, and long-term maintainability.
  • Support the development of Functional Design Documents (FDDs) and ensure alignment between functional requirements, system design, and technical specifications throughout the build lifecycle.
  • Act as a solutioning lead during Design Phase, partnering with functional consultants to drive business process mapping, gap-fit assessments, and solution documentation aligned to PE-backed client scaling needs.
  • Provide configuration oversight and quality assurance, reviewing proposed scripts, workflows, custom records, and data models for adherence to Crowe and NetSuite standards.
  • Serve as a cross-functional escalation point for architecture or solution design decisions, ensuring technical feasibility and stakeholder alignment across workstreams.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, Supply Chain, Engineering, or related field
  • NetSuite Certifications – Suite Foundations, Administrator and ERP Consultant required.

Experience:

  • 4+ years of NetSuite experience with a focus on solution design, module architecture, or technical oversight roles.
  • Prior experience in multi-entity, multi-currency, or fast-scaling environments.
  • Strong expertise across core modules (GL, AR/AP, Procurement, Inventory, Fulfillment, Manufacturing).

Proficiencies:

  • Deep knowledge of NetSuite Advanced Modules: Advanced Inventory Management, Warehouse Management System (WMS), Advanced Manufacturing.
  • Understanding of NetSuite’s platform architecture including SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, SuiteTalk, and Suite Analytics.
  • Ability to read, review, and advise on SuiteScript 2.x design patterns and SuiteCloud development best practices.
  • Familiarity with 3rd-party integration frameworks, connector platforms (e.g., Celigo, Boomi), and data mapping processes.
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., prompt engineering, low-code development tools) is a plus.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Systems thinking with an ability to architect holistic ERP + integration solutions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to articulate technical decisions to functional and non-technical audiences
  • Ability to lead and influence both Crowe implementation teams and client stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated and detail-oriented with strong organizational and documentation skills.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

The application deadline for this role is 10/02/2027.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Crowe, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $79,100.00 - $156,600.00 per year.

Your exceptional people experience starts here. At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We care about our people and offer employees a comprehensive total rewards package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!

How You Can Grow:

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

descriptionHtml:
As a Senior SAP Application Consultant, Procurement/Warehouse you will be expected to leverage your business process, industry expertise, and SAP solution knowledge to lead clients on their SAP MM WM implementation journey, ensuring alignment of SAP solution and industry driven best business practices. SAP knowledge is required to support the primary objective of applying SAP technology to meet existing and/or optimized client business processes.

Applicants can be located in any U.S. city and must be willing to travel up to 100% based on client and project needs.

Duties And Responsibilities

 Client Engagement/Consulting

  • Build strong relationships with clients to understand their business processes, objectives and challenges
  • Schedule, prepare and lead workshops to demonstrate SAP best practices and identify business requirements
  • Act as trusted advisor in both SAP and business best practices in your area of responsibility
  • Analyze existing business processes and identify areas for improvement and optimization in order to design future-state business processes aligned with SAP best practices
  • Identify and present solution options to support client decision making process
  • Collaborate cross functionally with consultants and stakeholders on business requirements needing seamless integration
  • Ensure that SAP configuration aligns with defined business processes
  • Effectively manage tasks assigned to offshore counterparts and junior consultants to ensure on time deliverables
  • Ensure appropriate testing of configuration and development is complete and documented prior to handover to client
  • Lead activities in all phases of the SAP Activate Methodology
  • Collaborate with project managers to ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget
  • Monitor progress in your area and support risk identification / mitigation plans

Internal/Company-Facing

  • Provide advisory services in both SAP and business best practices in your area of responsibility
  • Act as a mentor to both Junior and Associate level consultants within the organization
  • Take an active role in your own career development in the form of continuous education as well as annual goals and objectives
  • Support presales activities as needed, and the project team during Discovery phase to establish the project scope of work

Position Requirements/Qualifications

 This position requires a combination of manufacturing expertise. Qualified applicants will possess expertise in MM EWM, with additional expertise in other modules.

  • 5+ years SAP MM EWM project implementation and other SAP modules
  • 2+ years leadership experience on SAP MM EWM implementation projects or production support
  • 2+ years integration experience with other process areas
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field or equivalent experience
  • Proven experience as a Business Process Consultant or similar role with a focus on SAP projects
  • Strong knowledge of SAP solutions and modules (e.g., SAP ERP, SAP S/4HANA)
  • Proficiency in industry or business process modeling and documentation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

Business Analysis & Solution Design

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to business users regarding SAP capabilities and process enhancements.

SAP Configuration & Functional Support

  • Configure and support SAP MM processes including:Procurement Purchasing Inventory Management Goods Receipts Stock Transfers Invoice Verification
  • Configure and support SAP WM processes including:Inbound Receiving Put-Away Replenishment Picking Packing Staging Shipping Physical Inventory Management
  • Configure and support SAP SD processes including:Sales Order Processing Logistics Execution Delivery Processing Billing and Invoicing
  • Support RF/mobile-enabled warehouse operations where applicable.

Integration & Technical Collaboration

  • Support integration between SAP and external systems using:IDocs EDI RFCs Middleware platforms (SAP PI/PO or equivalent)
  • Develop functional specifications and work closely with technical teams to support:Interfaces Reports Enhancements Forms Workflow solutions

Testing, Training & Deployment

  • Lead and support:System Integration Testing (SIT) User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Defect resolution activities
  • Create and maintain:Process documentation Configuration documentation Training materials Business process flow diagrams
  • Deliver end-user training and knowledge transfer sessions.
  • Support cutover, go-live, and hypercare activities.

Ongoing Support

  • Troubleshoot and resolve application issues to ensure system stability and business continuity.
  • Collaborate effectively with internal teams, vendors, and stakeholders in a global environment.
  • Travel domestically and internationally as business needs require.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5+ years of SAP functional experience with a strong focus on SAP SD, MM, and WM within SAP ECC 6.0 or higher.
  • Hands-on experience designing and configuring solutions supporting:Order-to-Cash (OTC) Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Inventory Management Warehouse Management
  • Strong understanding of inventory processes including:Goods Receipt Goods Issue Stock Transfers Inventory Adjustments Stock Reconciliation
  • Functional expertise in Warehouse Management processes and integration with SD and Inventory Management.
  • Experience integrating SAP with Production Planning and third-party MES systems.
  • Good understanding of MRP strategies and availability checking.
  • Experience collaborating with technical teams on solution design, testing, and deployment.
  • Proven ability to work directly with business users to gather requirements and deliver enterprise-wide solutions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA 2022 implementations or migrations.
  • SAP GTS experience.
  • Manufacturing, aerospace, defense, or distribution industry experience.
  • Experience supporting global SAP environments.

Work Authorization Requirement

This position may support projects subject to government, regulatory, export control, aerospace, defense, or customer requirements. Therefore, candidates must be a U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident (Green Card Holder) when required by applicable project or customer obligations.

Information Related To The Position

  • The compensation range is $100,000 to $120,000 in base salary plus an annual target bonus.
  • The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Daher considers a number of factors when determining salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, skills, and current market conditions.
  • At Daher, your total rewards package is more than just your base salary as we offer a full benefit package including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Life insurance, Short- and Long-Term Disability, Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays and more.

Your next opportunity starts here — here are the next steps:

  • Review of your application
  • An initial conversation with a recruiter
  • One or more interviews depending on the position, with the relevant team members and manager(s)
  • After the interviews, constructive feedback regardless of the outcome

All applicants are considered for all positions without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, national origin, ancestry, physical/mental disability, medical condition, military/veteran status, genetic information, marital status, ethnicity, alienage, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. By completing an application with Daher, you are seeking to join a team of hardworking professionals dedicated to consistently delivering outstanding service to our customers and contributing to the financial success of the organization, its clients, and its employees. Equal access to programs, services, and employment is available to all qualified persons. Those applicants requiring accommodation to complete the application and/or interview process should contact an HR representative.

Job Description

We are looking for a Senior SAP Functional Expert – Finance & Controlling (FICO) with deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance to lead our financial transformation initiatives.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with S/4HANA innovations (Universal Journal, Advanced Financial Closing, Central Finance, Group Reporting), strong knowledge of finance and controlling processes, and a passion for modernizing financial systems to enable real-time insights and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design, configuration, and optimization of SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI and CO modules) across global entities.
  • Translate complex finance and controlling business requirements into scalable S/4HANA solutions aligned with SAP Best Practices.
  • Drive the implementation of key S/4HANA innovations: Universal Journal (ACDOCA), New Asset Accounting, Margin Analysis (CO-PA), Advanced Financial Closing, Group Reporting / Consolidation, Central Finance (CFin)
  • Define and deliver functional specifications for custom developments, interfaces (APIs, BAPIs), and Fiori applications.
  • Manage integration between Finance and other S/4HANA modules: MM, SD, PP, PS
  • Support finance transformation initiatives: shared services, IFRS compliance, entity harmonization, faster close, real-time reporting.
  • Lead and participate in key phases: blueprinting, configuration, testing, training, mi-gration, cutover, and hyper care.
  • Collaborate with finance leadership, auditors, and IT architects to ensure system com-pliance, performance, and scalability.
  • Mentor and coach junior consultants and business users in S/4HANA Finance process-es.
  • Contribute during presales process and business growth.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of SAP FICO experience, including at least 5+ years on SAP S/4HANA Finance.
  • Deep functional expertise in SAP FI (GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, Banking) and CO (Cost Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis).
  • Proven experience delivering S/4HANA Finance projects (migration, greenfield, or brownfield).
  • Excellent understanding of financial reporting standards (IFRS/GAAP), closing process-es, and tax/legal compliance.
  • Solid integration knowledge with logistics, manufacturing, and HR modules.
  • Expertise in writing Functional Specifications (FS), configuration documents, and test scenarios.
  • Strong communication and business engagement skills at senior stakeholder level.

Additional Information

Why Join Sopra Steria?

Sopra Steria is proud to be certified as a “Great Place to Work” 2026, a recognition that reflects our commitment to creating an inspiring, supportive, and people‑first environment where every employee can thrive.

What you can look forward to:

  • Competitive compensation
  • A comprehensive, fully covered benefits package designed with your well‑being in mind:
    • life insurance,
    • long-term disability,
    • health, dental, and vision coverage,

  • Generous paid time off, including sick leave, personal days, and 3 weeks of vacation to recharge and take care of what matters most.
  • A monthly transportation allowance, making your commute smoother and more affordable.
  • Excellent learning, development, and career advancement opportunities, backed by active support to help you strengthen your skills. You’ll grow within a company culture that is caring, collaborative, and genuinely inclusive.
  • A hybrid work environment that offers the best of both flexibility and connection.
  • All the equipment you need to stay productive and perform at your best from day one.

We sincerely thank all applicants for their interest in this opportunity. We truly appreciate the time and effort you put into applying. Please note that only candidates selected for the next steps in the recruitment process will be contacted.

Job Description

The Team

Join a collaborative SAP delivery team supporting a large automotive client in an established S/4HANA environment. This team partners closely with product owners, business stakeholders, technical developers, IT teams, and AMS support teams to deliver enhancements, testing, deployment, and ongoing innovation across SAP MM/PTP processes. The ideal candidate will bring strong SAP MM solution knowledge, clear communication, and the ability to work across business and technical teams to support project-based delivery in a complex enterprise environment.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced SAP MM/PTP Consultant to support solution analysis, functional specification development, testing, deployment, and enhancement delivery within an existing SAP S/4HANA environment. This is not a traditional AMS ticket-taking role or a heavy configuration-only role. The consultant will analyze business requirements, assess solution feasibility, prepare or update functional specifications, coordinate with technical teams, support development, execute testing, obtain approvals, and help transition solutions to production and AMS support. The ideal candidate will have deep experience supporting SAP Materials Management (MM) and Accounts Payable (AP) business processes within an SAP S/4HANA environment. This role focuses on analyzing business requirements, designing solutions, creating functional specifications, coordinating enhancements, supporting testing, and collaborating with business stakeholders, developers, and cross-functional teams to deliver Procure-to-Pay (P2P) solutions.

Please Note: This is a hybrid role in the Plano, TX area. Candidates must currently reside in the Dallas/Fort Worth metroplex. Only U.S. Citizens and Green Card holders are eligible for consideration, as sponsorship (including H-1B transfers or future sponsorship) is not available for this position.

What You’ll Bring

  • 8+ years of SAP functional experience with strong expertise in SAP Materials Management (MM).
  • Hands-on experience supporting Accounts Payable (AP) processes within SAP, including integration points between MM and Finance.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA implementations and enhancement projects.
  • Proven experience creating functional specifications and working closely with development teams.
  • Experience supporting Functional Unit Testing (FUT), Integration Testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and production deployments.
  • Strong knowledge of MM integration with SAP FI/AP, SD, and EWM.
  • Experience working in Agile environments using Jira and ServiceNow is preferred.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Automotive industry experience is preferred.

Key Responsibilities

  • Understand, analyze, and validate business requirements
  • Evaluate solution feasibility and recommend appropriate SAP MM/PTP solutions
  • Prepare and update functional specifications, including test scenarios
  • Coordinate with technical teams during development and technical specification completion
  • Prepare test data and perform functional unit testing
  • Support integration testing, UAT, approvals, and documentation
  • Assist with deployment planning and production release activities
  • Provide knowledge transfer to AMS/support teams
  • Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, IT, and developers

Preferred Skills

  • Jira experience
  • ServiceNow/SNOW experience
  • Automotive or manufacturing industry experience
  • 1–2 full lifecycle SAP project/go-live experiences

About Us

We're a global, team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion to co-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data-driven leaders that can make a positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can bring a better tomorrow closer to today, this is the place for you.

Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives

Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.

We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.

How we look after you

We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.

We're proud to say we're an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic. Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.

  • Strong communicator verbally and in writing, with keen listening skills.
  • Experience with working with third party providers.
  • Ability to prioritize competing demands and tasks.
  • Well organized, self-disciplined, and motivated.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Can build trust, be assertive when required and shows initiative and enthusiasm.

There’s so much more to enjoy about being at Computacenter than just having a rewarding career. Job Description

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA professional to support key phases of our SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Edition (PCE). This role spans the Explore, Realize, and Deploy phases, requiring a strong combination of business process understanding, integration expertise, data migration governance, and testing execution.

The consultant will provide functional expertise, governance, and validation rather than performing primary SAP configuration and implementation activities.

Key ResponsibilitiesQualifications

  • Explore Phase (Design & Requirements)
  • Workshop Facilitation: Participate in business workshops and support the business in collecting inputs for workshop preparation.
  • Requirements Management: Bridge the gap between business and the system integrator by helping the integrator understand complex business requirements.
  • Organizational Structure & Golden Rules: Support the business in defining organizational data structures (e.g., plants, sales organizations, cost centers) and establishing golden rules.
  • Solution Enablement: Assist the business in fully understanding the SAP S/4HANA solution, end-to-end processes, and S/4 PCE WRICEF (Workflows, Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms) targets.
  • Design Challenge & Validation: Actively challenge the system integrator during the design phase to ensure optimal solution architecture and validate final target business processes.
  • Demo Preparation: Prepare test data for system and solution demonstrations.
  • Integration & Interface Scope: Participate in integration workshops, validate integration designs, and support the definition of SAP interface requirements, including business logic, field mapping, transformation rules, routing principles, and target interface mappings. Validate the overall data migration scope, strategy, methods, and tools.
  • Realize Phase (Configuration, Testing & Migration)
  • SAP Interface Management: Define, review, and validate interface business logic, source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, error-handling requirements, and routing rules for application and SAP S/4 interfaces on mediation layers. Participate in integration design reviews and support end-to-end interface testing across applications and S/4 PCE prior to UAT.
  • Testing & Test Data: Prepare applications and systems for test data alignment. Support the business in writing test cases, execute and validate integration tests, and validate the scope of automatic tests (including test cases, APIs, and end-to-end scenarios).
  • Data Migration Execution:
    • Design, develop, and test extractors and mapping tools to fit target migration templates.
    • Define and validate mapping rules, data cleansing procedures, and data quality checks.
    • Execute data extraction from source systems (iterative cycles) and validate migration results for unit and integration testing.
    • Support the business in validating data migration outputs.
  • Deploy & Tool Kit Phase (Change Management & Testing)
  • Change Management & Training: Assist change management specialized training on SAP S/4 PCE (led by external partners) and support Key Users (KU) during end-user training sessions.
  • Toolkit & Planning: Contribute to the definition and execution of comprehensive testing plans.
  • Proven hands-on experience implementing SAP S/4HANA (preferably Public Cloud Edition).
  • Strong functional knowledge of core SAP modules (FI/CO) and organizational data definition, and basic understanding of the MM, SD, PP modules.
  • Demonstrated experience in SAP interface management, including business logic definition, source-to-target mapping, transformation rules, middleware/mediation mapping, error handling, and end-to-end interface testing.
  • Solid background in SAP Data Migration methodologies, extraction tools, data quality, and cleansing governance.
  • Experience in test management, including writing test cases, automated testing validation, and execution across integrated environments.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills to effectively bridge business teams and external system integrators.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on SAP configuration experience, with at least 2–3 full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementations or conversions.
  • Core Knowledge: Deep expertise in SAP FI/CO architecture, cross-module integration, financial close cockpit, and statutory/management reporting requirements.
  • Certifications: SAP Certified Application Associate – SAP S/4HANA for Financial Accounting Associates (or related S/4HANA Finance certification) preferred.
  • Technical Literacy: Familiarity with SAP Fiori apps, CDS views, and integration with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC).
  • Soft Skills: Strong analytical mindset, excellent cross-functional communication skills, and the ability to bridge business finance needs with technical configurations.

Additional Information

This job description is intended to cover the core accountabilities of the position and is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

LVMH Inc. uses the published salary range as a guideline to provide our employees with market competitive pay while allowing for flexibility to recognize and reward various levels of expertise, performance, and tenure.

While the published salary range is a good faith reflection of the targeted salary level for the position, LVMH Inc. reserves the right to pay outside of the published range of $140,000 - $170,000.

We are seeking an experienced SAP PP Functional Consultant with 8–10 years of hands-on SAP implementation and support experience. Position: Senior Business Analyst, SAP S4/Hana Supply Chain Management

Location: Charlotte, NC, US, 28277


Job Summary/Overview

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – SAP S4/Hana Supply Chain Management to join our IS team. The SAP Business Analyst will be responsible for reviewing, analyzing, planning, developing, testing, documenting, and/or implementing existing and future business systems. This position will consult with business personnel to identify and document business needs and objectives, current operational procedures, problems, input and output requirements, data scope, usage, formatting, and security requirements.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Evaluates user requests for new or modified systems or applications to determine feasibility, cost and time required, compatibility with the current system, computer capabilities, and impact on business.
  • Consults with users to identify current operating procedures and clarify objectives.
  • Reads manuals, periodicals, and technical reports to learn ways to develop programs that meet user requirements.
  • Formulates plan outlining steps required to develop the program and submits plan to the user for approval.
  • Prepares flowcharts and diagrams to illustrate the sequence of steps the program must follow and to describe logical operations involved.
  • Develops necessary systems specifications in the form of table layouts, indices, logic definition, database growth rates, flow charts, and other descriptive documentation sufficiently to allow programming to occur.
  • Writes documentation to describe program development, logic, coding, and corrections.
  • Provides guidance and training to end users to support adoption and effective use of systems.
  • Collaborates cross-functionally with IT, operations, and external partners to ensure successful delivery of solutions.
  • Troubleshoots system issues and provides ongoing support to meet business needs.


Knowledge, Skills, Competencies, and Abilities

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate with all levels of the company as internal and external customers.
  • Ability to work in a team environment and contribute to a positive working environment.
  • Works independently, with little direction successfully.
  • Strong understanding of implementing, configuring, and supporting Materials Management and Production Planning functionality within SAP
  • Understanding of integration points between MM & PP and other areas of SAP system (QM, SD, EWM, CO). VC, PS, or CS a plus.

Senior SAP MM/SD Consultant | Chicago


An established organisation is looking for an experienced SAP Materials Management and Sales & Distribution professional to take functional ownership of its procurement and order-to-cash processes on S/4HANA. The system landscape has been tailored extensively over the years, so this role will suit someone who is at ease outside standard configuration and can make sound, pragmatic decisions about which custom elements to keep, rework or phase out. You'll combine day-to-day support with new development, acting as the central point of expertise for the business.


The role:


  • Serve as the go-to functional expert for SAP procurement and sales processes, from sourcing and purchasing through to stock, invoicing and billing.
  • Handle a mix of live support issues, change requests and new configuration work across the full development lifecycle.
  • Ensure procurement and sales processes connect cleanly with finance, including payables, receivables and logistics.
  • Write functional and technical specifications, including requirements for custom development, and oversee the build and upkeep of reports, interfaces and enhancements.
  • Provide direction to external support partners and review their output against agreed design standards.
  • Work with business users, cross-functional colleagues and suppliers to assess how processes run today and deliver practical improvements.


What you'll need:


  • A degree in a technical or business discipline, or comparable practical experience.
  • At least five years working with SAP MM and SD in a senior functional capacity, ideally on S/4HANA.
  • Broad configuration knowledge spanning master data, purchasing, inventory, order management, pricing, delivery and billing.
  • A solid grasp of how logistics modules feed into finance, particularly around billing, payables and revenue.
  • Experience connecting SAP with external applications, including monitoring and troubleshooting EDI and IDoc-based interfaces.
  • Confidence engaging stakeholders at every level and guiding change without relying on formal authority.


How to apply:


Interested? Get in touch with the MAM Gruppe team for a confidential conversation about this role.

Position

LVMH Beauty's activities benefit from exceptional dynamism that relies on both the longevity and development of key lines, and on the boldness of new creations.

All are driven by the same values: a quest for excellence, creativity, innovation, and perfect mastery of their image.

The brands cultivate what makes them unique and are guaranteed to make them stand out in a highly competitive global market. The success of the LVMH Beauty Division depends on finding the right balance between major historic Houses, such as Parfums Christian Dior, Parfums Givenchy, Acqua di Parma, Guerlain, and newer brands with strong potential like Kenzo Parfums, Fresh, and Make Up For Ever.

LVMH Beauty invites you today to join its North America teams.

LVMH Beauty is part of the LVMH Group.

Job responsibilities

  • Explore Phase (Design & Requirements)
  • Workshop Facilitation: Participate in business workshops and support the business in collecting inputs for workshop preparation.
  • Requirements Management: Bridge the gap between business and the system integrator by helping the integrator understand complex business requirements.
  • Organizational Structure & Golden Rules: Support the business in defining organizational data structures (e.g., plants, sales organizations, cost centers) and establishing golden rules.
  • Solution Enablement: Assist the business in fully understanding the SAP S/4HANA solution, end-to-end processes, and S/4 PCE WRICEF (Workflows, Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms) targets.
  • Design Challenge & Validation: Actively challenge the system integrator during the design phase to ensure optimal solution architecture and validate final target business processes.
  • Demo Preparation: Prepare test data for system and solution demonstrations.
  • Integration & Interface Scope: Participate in integration workshops, validate integration designs, and support the definition of SAP interface requirements, including business logic, field mapping, transformation rules, routing principles, and target interface mappings. Validate the overall data migration scope, strategy, methods, and tools.
  • Realize Phase (Configuration, Testing & Migration)
  • SAP Interface Management: Define, review, and validate interface business logic, source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, error-handling requirements, and routing rules for application and SAP S/4 interfaces on mediation layers. Participate in integration design reviews and support end-to-end interface testing across applications and S/4 PCE prior to UAT.
  • Testing & Test Data: Prepare applications and systems for test data alignment. Support the business in writing test cases, execute and validate integration tests, and validate the scope of automatic tests (including test cases, APIs, and end-to-end scenarios).
  • Data Migration Execution:
    • Design, develop, and test extractors and mapping tools to fit target migration templates.
    • Define and validate mapping rules, data cleansing procedures, and data quality checks.
    • Execute data extraction from source systems (iterative cycles) and validate migration results for unit and integration testing.
    • Support the business in validating data migration outputs.
  • Deploy & Tool Kit Phase (Change Management & Testing)
  • Change Management & Training: Assist change management specialized training on SAP S/4 PCE (led by external partners) and support Key Users (KU) during end-user training sessions.
  • Toolkit & Planning: Contribute to the definition and execution of comprehensive testing plans.
Profile

  • Proven hands-on experience implementing SAP S/4HANA (preferably Public Cloud Edition).
  • Strong functional knowledge of core SAP modules (FI/CO) and organizational data definition, and basic understanding of the MM, SD, PP modules.
  • Demonstrated experience in SAP interface management, including business logic definition, source-to-target mapping, transformation rules, middleware/mediation mapping, error handling, and end-to-end interface testing.
  • Solid background in SAP Data Migration methodologies, extraction tools, data quality, and cleansing governance.
  • Experience in test management, including writing test cases, automated testing validation, and execution across integrated environments.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills to effectively bridge business teams and external system integrators.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on SAP configuration experience, with at least 2–3 full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementations or conversions.
  • Core Knowledge: Deep expertise in SAP FI/CO architecture, cross-module integration, financial close cockpit, and statutory/management reporting requirements.
  • Certifications: SAP Certified Application Associate – SAP S/4HANA for Financial Accounting Associates (or related S/4HANA Finance certification) preferred.
  • Technical Literacy: Familiarity with SAP Fiori apps, CDS views, and integration with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC).
  • Soft Skills: Strong analytical mindset, excellent cross-functional communication skills, and the ability to bridge business finance needs with technical configurations.

Additional information

This job description is intended to cover the core accountabilities of the position and is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

LVMH Inc. uses the published salary range as a guideline to provide our employees with market competitive pay while allowing for flexibility to recognize and reward various levels of expertise, performance, and tenure.

While the published salary range is a good faith reflection of the targeted salary level for the position, LVMH Inc. reserves the right to pay outside of the published range of $125,000 - $150,000.

Business Process knowledge

  • Expertise in SAP S/4HANA and SAP ECC; knowledge of multiple SAP modules preferred
  • Knowledge of SAP Vehicle Management Systems, SAP BRIM & SAP GTS preferred
  • Working experience with configuration and customization of SAP EDI solutions for quote to cash processes
  • Knowledge of integration points and techniques between sales with other SAP components, such as finance and logistics, as well as 3rd party applications
  • Previous experience planning and executing large SAP S/4HANA projects
  • Ability to promote ideas, recommend solutions, and influence others within all levels of the organization including the ability to explain technical processes and concepts to non-technical user groups
  • Ability and discipline to self-manage assignments to meet deadlines, scope, and budget
  • Effective presentation skills
  • Working knowledge of databases, applications, and data integration interfaces
  • Ability to work individually, as a member of a functional team, and part of a global team
  • Effective change management skills
  • Ability to establish, build and maintain relationships with individuals at all levels of the organization
  • Ability to speak a second language is a plus
  • Travel – Up to 25% travel might be required

Additional Information

Hiring Range

At Komatsu, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. This role pays $$160,000-$170,000. The actual offer will consider a wide range of factors, including experience and location.

Company Benefits

Komatsu provides an extensive and robust employee benefits package that is designed to enhance the well-being of our employees and family members. We embrace a positive and empowering employee experience with a culture that prides itself on a diverse and inclusive environment.

  • Health benefits: Medical, dental, vision, HSA, wellness programs, etc.
  • 401k and/or employee savings programs
  • Employee time off (vacation and designated holidays)
  • Employee and family assistance programs
  • Disability benefits
  • Life insurance
  • Employee learning and development programs

Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

At Komatsu, we come from diverse backgrounds, with unique perspectives, experiences and contributions. We believe that our people are part of our shared purpose. Connected by our core values of ambition, perseverance, collaboration and authenticity, we are committed to continually advancing in our support of diversity and inclusion. United, we are on a journey towards a sustainable future that creates value together.

Komatsu develops and supplies technologies, equipment and services for the construction, mining, forklift, industrial and forestry markets. For more than a century, the company has been creating value for its customers through manufacturing and technology innovation, partnering with others to empower a sustainable future where people, business and the planet thrive together. Since the company’s founding in 1921, Komatsu has been committed to supporting individuals and communities through job training, skills development and giving back. As a Komatsu employee, you will be encouraged to grow alongside our global company, contributing to a more sustainable future for all. If you are looking for a company that values your talent and potential, join Komatsu to be a part of something big and help advance modern society. Learn more at www.komatsu.com.

Komatsu is an Equal Opportunity Workplace and an Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

LVMH Beauty invites you today to join its North America teams.

LVMH Beauty is part of the LVMH Group.

Job Responsibilities

  • Explore Phase (Design & Requirements)
  • Workshop Facilitation: Participate in business workshops and support the business in collecting inputs for workshop preparation.
  • Requirements Management: Bridge the gap between business and the system integrator by helping the integrator understand complex business requirements.
  • Organizational Structure & Golden Rules: Support the business in defining organizational data structures (e.g., plants, sales organizations, cost centers) and establishing golden rules.
  • Solution Enablement: Assist the business in fully understanding the SAP S/4HANA solution, end-to-end processes, and S/4 PCE WRICEF (Workflows, Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms) targets.
  • Design Challenge & Validation: Actively challenge the system integrator during the design phase to ensure optimal solution architecture and validate final target business processes.
  • Demo Preparation: Prepare test data for system and solution demonstrations.
  • Integration & Interface Scope: Participate in integration workshops, validate integration designs, and support the definition of SAP interface requirements, including business logic, field mapping, transformation rules, routing principles, and target interface mappings. Validate the overall data migration scope, strategy, methods, and tools.
  • Realize Phase (Configuration, Testing & Migration)
  • SAP Interface Management: Define, review, and validate interface business logic, source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, error-handling requirements, and routing rules for application and SAP S/4 interfaces on mediation layers. Participate in integration design reviews and support end-to-end interface testing across applications and S/4 PCE prior to UAT.
  • Testing & Test Data: Prepare applications and systems for test data alignment. Support the business in writing test cases, execute and validate integration tests, and validate the scope of automatic tests (including test cases, APIs, and end-to-end scenarios).
  • Data Migration Execution:
    • Design, develop, and test extractors and mapping tools to fit target migration templates.
    • Define and validate mapping rules, data cleansing procedures, and data quality checks.
    • Execute data extraction from source systems (iterative cycles) and validate migration results for unit and integration testing.
    • Support the business in validating data migration outputs.
  • Deploy & Tool Kit Phase (Change Management & Testing)
  • Change Management & Training: Assist change management specialized training on SAP S/4 PCE (led by external partners) and support Key Users (KU) during end-user training sessions.
  • Toolkit & Planning: Contribute to the definition and execution of comprehensive testing plans.

Profile

Proven hands-on experience implementing SAP S/4HANA (preferably Public Cloud Edition). Strong functional knowledge of core SAP modules (FI/CO) and organizational data definition, and basic understanding of the MM, SD, PP modules. Demonstrated experience in SAP interface management, including business logic definition, source-to-target mapping, transformation rules, middleware/mediation mapping, error handling, and end-to-end interface testing. Solid background in SAP Data Migration methodologies, extraction tools, data quality, and cleansing governance. Experience in test management, including writing test cases, automated testing validation, and execution across integrated environments. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills to effectively bridge business teams and external system integrators. Required Qualifications & Skills Experience: 5+ years of hands-on SAP configuration experience, with at least 2–3 full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementations or conversions. Core Knowledge: Deep expertise in SAP FI/CO architecture, cross-module integration, financial close cockpit, and statutory/management reporting requirements. Certifications: SAP Certified Application Associate – SAP S/4HANA for Financial Accounting Associates (or related S/4HANA Finance certification) preferred. Technical Literacy: Familiarity with SAP Fiori apps, CDS views, and integration with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC). Soft Skills: Strong analytical mindset, excellent cross-functional communication skills, and the ability to bridge business finance needs with technical configurations.

Additional Information

This job description is intended to cover the core accountabilities of the position and is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

General Motors is undergoing a major transformation, both in how we operate and in how we will influence the future of transportation. Our Software Services team is on the forefront of this work, emboldening our culture by seeking out determined, innovative individuals who will join our team to help move us forward and achieve our mission.

The General Motors Global IT Organization is seeking to identify highly motivated and qualified individuals for potential future opportunities as a Staff Systems Configurator – SAP Functional Analyst (Level 8 individual contributor) to design, configure, and support SAP solutions that enable our end-to-end value chain across:

  • Source-to-Deliver / Source-to-Pay (Supply Chain & Direct Material Sourcing and Procurement for Automotive)
  • Make-to-Ship (Manufacturing & Plant Operations)
  • Order-to-Delivery (Order Management & Distribution)


This requisition is intentionally broad across SAP specialties, including but not limited to SD, FI-CO, MM, PP, WM, EWM, Ariba Direct Material Sourcing and Procurement for Automotive, and S/4HANA. You do not need experience in all of the areas listed; we are seeking strong SAP talent across one or more of these modules and encourage candidates to apply even if their expertise is focused in specific domains.

This role is scoped as a Level 8 expert individual contributor in the Systems Configurator job family, leading complex, multi-team SAP initiatives and setting functional direction in partnership with Senior (Level 7) Systems Configurators.

Location: Warren, MI or Austin, TX

The Role

As an SAP Functional Analyst, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams in Product Lifecycle Management, Global Purchasing & Supply Chain (GPSC), Manufacturing, Logistics, and Order Management to gather requirements and to design, configure, and support SAP solutions that meet business needs across the Source-to-Deliver, Make-to-Ship, and Order-to-Delivery spaces.

You will implement scalable SAP processes, ensure solutions align with industry best practices and GM’s IT Solution Delivery Methodology, optimize business operations, support and extend SAP modules, drive process improvements through automation and standardization, and help design and build new SAP-based landscapes that transform how work is done today. At the staff level, you will also own the functional roadmap for your domains, lead design decisions that span multiple product teams, and act as the primary advisor to leaders on SAP capability and process strategy.

You will:

  • Translate business needs into robust, integrated SAP configurations and functional designs.
  • Optimize business operations in areas such as Order Management, Pricing, Billing, Supply Chain, Logistics, Direct Material Sourcing & Procurement, Purchasing, Production Planning & Execution, Warehousing, and Master Data.
  • Support GM’s journey to S/4HANA and SaaS-first solutions, helping rationalize and modernize the SAP and surrounding application landscape.
  • Define and champion SAP configuration standards, patterns, and guardrails for Senior (Level 7) and mid-level Systems Configurators across your functional domains.
  • Provide final functional sign-off for high-risk or high-impact changes, balancing stability, scalability, and speed of delivery.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead SAP configuration and solution design for core business processes such as Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Production Planning & Execution, and related workflows. This includes ownership of complex, cross-functional initiatives that span multiple SAP products, regions, or business units.
  • Oversee financial postings, cost allocations, and supplier collaboration as they relate to your SAP functional domains.
  • Support sourcing, procurement, supplier management, production planning, logistics, inventory control, warehouse management, and goods movement processes.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, analysts, and technical teams to gather requirements and deliver SAP solutions that are scalable, secure, and aligned with GM standards. Influence prioritization and trade-offs across teams to ensure solutions advance key GM objectives, not just local optimizations.
  • Participate in testing, validation, and deployment of SAP enhancements and new functionalities; ensure strong end-to-end process validation. Drive the overall test strategy for your domains and ensure appropriate use of automation and regression testing.
  • Support integration of SAP with external systems, partnering with integration and infrastructure teams.
  • Help evaluate and rationalize the existing manufacturing, supply chain, and order management application landscape, determining which solutions are integrated with, absorbed into, or retired in favor of SAP S/4HANA and related SAP SaaS solutions.
  • Participate in SAP upgrades, migrations, and digital transformation initiatives, including S/4HANA and cloud/SaaS adoption. Serve as a key decision-maker on fit-to-standard vs. extension, aligned with GM’s clean core strategy.
  • Apply standard SAP functionality to meet business needs, minimizing custom development while still addressing critical gaps via RICEFW objects.
  • Contribute to application management and production support, including issue triage, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement in your functional areas. Act as the top functional escalation point for complex incidents and systemic issues.
  • Create and maintain process documentation, configuration guides, and training materials to support adoption and reuse.
  • Mentor junior team members and promote best practices in SAP solution delivery, testing, and operations. Systematically coach Senior Systems Configurators and other team members, building depth and succession in critical SAP domains.
  • Adhere to organizational IT standards, security protocols, and industry best practices, including relevant regulatory and internal control requirements. Proactively identify control gaps and drive remediation in partnership with Risk, Compliance, and Audit teams.


Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Computing, Information Systems, Supply Chain) or equivalent experience.
  • Extensive hands-on SAP experience, including configuration of one or more relevant modules, for example:
  • SD Order Management, Pricing, Billing, Order-to-Cash.
  • FI-CO integration with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, or Order Management.
  • MM, WM, EWM procurement, inventory, warehouse, and logistics execution.
  • PP / Manufacturing production planning and execution, plan-to-produce.
  • DMe/DMC SAP Digital Manufacturing or other digital manufacturing solutions, and integration with plant-floor and logistics systems.
  • Ariba Direct Material Sourcing and Procurement for Automotive.
  • S/4HANA functional configuration and extensibility.
  • Proven track record leading end-to-end SAP solution delivery for complex programs (e.g., multi-release roadmaps, large deployments, S/4 migrations, or significant new capability introductions).
  • Strong understanding of SAP principles and extensibility approaches, including how to design upgrade-safe, cloud-compliant solutions.
  • Solid business process knowledge in areas such as Order Management, Pricing, Billing, Supply Chain, Logistics, Direct Material Sourcing & Procurement, Purchasing, Production Planning, Warehousing, and Master Data.
  • Experience supporting integration with other SAP modules and external systems, including familiarity with common interface technologies (e.g., IDocs, APIs, middleware).
  • Familiarity with software testing, automation, and quality assurance practices; ability to define and execute test plans and support automated/regression testing.
  • Ability to debug and analyze SAP systems, preferably with some ABAP knowledge to support issue analysis and collaboration with development teams.
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured approach to diagnosing issues and proposing options.
  • Strong commitment to continuous improvement, teamwork, and integrity, including willingness to learn new SAP and cloud capabilities.
  • Ability to set direction for a functional area, influence architecture and product roadmaps, and make sound trade-off decisions.


What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • SAP certification in one or more relevant modules (e.g., SD, MM, PP, WM/EWM, FI-CO, Ariba, S/4HANA).
  • Experience with SAP Automotive Suite or similar industry-specific solutions supporting OEMs, suppliers, or complex manufacturing.
  • Familiarity with the SAP Integrated Tool Chain – including Signavio (process modeling), SAP Cloud ALM (CALM), and Tricentis (Tosca) – as well as SAP Fiori and SAP BTP, especially for cloud-based SAP extensions and integrations.
  • Exposure to SAP AI / analytics capabilities and apply analytics/AI in manufacturing, supply chain, or order management use cases.
  • Experience with EDI transaction sets (ANSI X12, EDIFACT) and related communication protocols, and/or other integration platforms (e.g., SAP PI/PO, SAP Integration Suite, Sterling, Connect Direct).
  • Background working with manufacturers, suppliers, or service providers, ideally in automotive or complex discrete manufacturing environments.
  • Prior consulting experience or working with global stakeholder groups, including experience in regulated environments (e.g., SOX, internal controls, legal/tax requirements).
  • Demonstrated ability to represent your functional area in senior-level forums (e.g., steering committees, enterprise design councils) and to influence outcomes across organizations without direct authority.


Hybrid

This role is categorized as hybrid. The successful candidate is expected to report to Warren, MI or Austin, TX, three times per week, at minimum, or as dictated by business needs.

GM does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need GM immigration sponsorship now or in the future. This includes direct company sponsorship, entry of GM as the immigration employer of record on a government form, and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (e.g., H1-B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc). This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the selected candidate is expected to report to a specific location at least 3 times a week {or other frequency dictated by their manager}. This job may be eligible for relocation benefits.

About GM

Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all.

Why Join Us

We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team.

Benefits Overview

From day one, we're looking out for your well-being–at work and at home–so you can focus on realizing your ambitions. Learn how GM supports a rewarding career that rewards you personally by visiting Total Rewards resources.

Non-Discrimination and Equal Employment Opportunities (U.S.)

General Motors is committed to being a workplace that is not only free of unlawful discrimination, but one that genuinely fosters inclusion and belonging. We strongly believe that providing an inclusive workplace creates an environment in which our employees can thrive and develop better products for our customers.

All employment decisions are made on a non-discriminatory basis without regard to sex, race, color, national origin, citizenship status, religion, age, disability, pregnancy or maternity status, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran or protected veteran, or any other similarly protected status in accordance with federal, state and local laws.

We encourage interested candidates to review the key responsibilities and qualifications for each role and apply for any positions that match their skills and capabilities. Applicants in the recruitment process may be required, where applicable, to successfully complete a role-related assessment(s) and/or a pre-employment screening prior to beginning employment. To learn more, visit How we Hire.

Accommodations

General Motors offers opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, email us or call us at 1-800-865-7580. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.
