The Opportunity

Our SAP Procurement practice helps organizations modernize and optimize their source-to-pay operations through SAP S/4HANA. We work with clients to transform procurement processes, improve supplier collaboration, increase operational efficiency, and strengthen controls across purchasing, inventory management, and invoice processing.

As a Senior Technology Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You will interact with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, ensuring that newly implemented technology solutions meet their needs. Your collaboration with technical teams will be essential in designing and delivering effective system architecture solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for delivering top-notch business analysis and system configuration. Your day-to-day will involve:

  • Support SAP Procurement and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstreams within SAP S/4HANA implementation and transformation engagements.
  • Design and configure SAP Materials Management (MM) solutions across purchasing, inventory management, goods movements, and invoice verification processes.
  • Advise clients on procurement leading practices and SAP standard capabilities while balancing business requirements with scalable solutions.
  • Translating complex business requirements into detailed technical specifications
  • Develop functional specifications, process documentation, test scripts, training materials, and other project deliverables.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Sales to help deliver integrated business solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

On a typical engagement, you will work directly with procurement, supply chain, and finance leaders to understand business challenges and translate requirements into scalable SAP solutions. Success in this role requires a combination of functional procurement expertise, SAP configuration experience, and the ability to guide clients through large-scale transformation initiatives.

We are seeking professionals with demonstrated experience in one or more procurement specializations and an understanding of related end-to-end Procure-to-Pay processes.

Key skills include:

  • Deep understanding of Procure-to-Pay business processes and their integration points across the enterprise.
  • Experience designing SAP-enabled procurement solutions that balance business requirements with standard SAP functionality.
  • Ability to lead requirements gathering sessions, process design workshops, fit-gap assessments, and solution validation activities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex business and system challenges.
  • Proven ability to manage workstream deliverables, project risks, stakeholder expectations, and timelines.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

  • A bachelor's degree with at least 2-4 years of SAP Procurement, Supply Chain, or consulting experience.
  • Experience supporting at least one full lifecycle SAP implementation, preferably an SAP S/4HANA transformation.
  • Hands-on experience in one or more SAP Procurement specializations, including:
    • SAP S/4HANA Procurement (Direct Materials)
    • SAP Invoice Management and Accounts Payable Integration
    • SAP Inventory Management
    • SAP Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, or Contracts
    • SAP Ariba Buying and Invoicing
    • SAP Ariba Integration, including Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG)
  • Experience configuring SAP MM procurement processes, including material master, business partner (vendor), RFQs, contracts, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, approval workflows, output management, goods receipts, stock transport orders, ALE, and IDocs.
  • Experience in one or more SAP Ariba solutions, including Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Strategic Sourcing, Contracts, Buying and Invoicing, Supply Chain Collaboration, Commerce Automation, or Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG).
  • Knowledge of integration points with Accounts Payable, Production Planning, Sales & Distribution, and other related SAP modules.
  • Experience leading the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstream, including facilitating solution design workshops and developing proof of concepts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills.
  • Knowledge of leading practices, benchmarking, peer company environments and prior advisory experience relevant to industry specific finance and technology functions.
  • A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

  • Previous consulting experience within a professional services environment.
  • SAP S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement certification or other relevant SAP certifications.

We seek individuals who are proactive, innovative, and eager to contribute to team success. Top performers are those who demonstrate strong analytical skills, the ability to communicate effectively, and a passion for technology and its impact on business.

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

The Opportunity

As part of the Business Application Consulting team you leverage Dynamics 365 Applications to deliver solutions tailored to client needs. Responsibilities

  • Utilize Dynamics 365 Applications to craft impactful solutions

  • Analyze intricate issues and develop strategic solutions
  • Maintain a profound understanding of client requirements
  • Achieve delivery of quality solutions

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • 4 to 7 years of experience
  • Microsoft Dynamics 365 certification
  • Demonstrating thorough knowledge and/or a proven record of success leveraging Dynamics 365 Applications (F&O, CE, Project Operations, or others), as well as other Microsoft solution offerings

What Sets You Apart

  • One or more certifications within Dynamics 365 applications preferred
  • Leading efforts to understand and implement D365 solutions
  • Interacting with clients to understand key requirements
  • Advising on complex D365 business cases
  • Conducting business process analysis and creating process flows
  • Developing project plans and managing tasks on time
  • Demonstrating abilities as a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Functional Consultant
  • Leveraging project management skills to lead engagements
  • Providing guidance and feedback to less-experienced staff

Today's finance leaders face increasing pressure to modernize operations, improve reporting accuracy, and scale efficiently as their businesses grow. As a NetSuite Senior Consultant at Deloitte, you will help clients design and implement NetSuite solutions that align with their business goals and deliver measurable results. This role fits professionals across core financial accounting, procure-to-pay, or order-to-cash implementation backgrounds. Join a team that is transforming how finance and accounting organizations operate by streamlining processes, improving reporting, and building lasting client relationships along the way.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant, you will implement and deploy NetSuite solutions:

  • Work within an engagement team, identifying business requirements, managing functional design, prototyping, and designing processes
  • Provide NetSuite consulting expertise, using industry experience, business analysis, and best practices to address clients' most complex requirements
  • Implement and deploy NetSuite solutions that accommodate unique industry, business, and regulatory requirements
  • Conduct business process mapping and requirements-gathering sessions with clients, on-site and remote
  • Prepare Business Requirements and Technical Scoping Documents for client approval
  • Build, develop, and test functional designs and scripted, customized solutions for business components and prototypes
  • Drive test planning, execution, and optimization support
  • Troubleshoot configuration issues and provide ongoing post-implementation support to optimize user adoption

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to build and maintain strong client and team relationships
  • Comfort managing multiple priorities across concurrent workstreams
  • Willingness to mentor and support the development of junior team members

The team

Our NetSuite practice helps upper mid-market and high-growth organizations modernize their financial and operational systems on a unified cloud platform. We work alongside clients to streamline processes, improve reporting, and support their next stage of growth. We're just as invested in our own team's growth, with hands-on learning and mentorship built into every engagement.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3+ years of relevant consulting or industry experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Record to Report: General Ledger, Consolidations, Multibook accounting, CTA Analysis, FX variances, and/or Financial Reporting
    • Procure to Pay: Accounts Payable
    • Order to Cash: Accounts Receivable
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Information Systems, or another related field
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
Preferred:

  • Certified NetSuite Professional (NetSuite Administrator / Suite Foundation / ERP Consultant / Multi-Book Consultant / ARM/Revenue Management)
  • Full lifecycle NetSuite implementation experience, including Design, Build, Test, Deploy, and Support phases
  • Experience with NetSuite integrations, customizations, and ERP data migration/cutover
  • Previous "Big 4" or large consulting firm experience
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage teams and stakeholders across global locations
  • Advanced degree in a relevant field
  • Eagerness to mentor junior staff

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,700 to $218,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job Summary

 JOB DESCRIPTION

BDO Digital, LLC., a wholly owned subsidiary of BDO USA, P.C., is a rapidly growing digital advisory organization dedicated to helping middle-market organizations capture the full power of technology, adapt to disruption, increase operational efficiencies, improve risk management effectiveness, and uncover new sources of revenue. Our collaborative, cross-disciplinary team is comprised of digital strategists, systems integrators, data scientists, software developers, change management professionals, and industry-specific advisors who work together to solve clients’ immediate digital needs and unearth new opportunities to drive competitive advantage. Our goal is to help our clients become faster, smarter, and more resilient to change.

To support our double-digit growth goals, BDO Digital seeks a manager who will be part of an Enterprise Business Applications (EBA) team supporting projects in the areas of EBA strategy and implementation, in addition to Business Transformation and Operational Excellence efforts. This role will conduct discovery, requirements gathering, process documentation, configuration, and implementation management of ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning), CRM (Customer Relationship Management), HCM (Human Capital Management) and other related business applications functioning as a key resource for our clients spanning, finance, product distribution, manufacturing, job costing, field service, sales, marketing, service, and reporting.

Job Duties

  • Strategy, Requirements & Selection:
    • Participates in defining needs for existing and new EBA solutions
    • Documents existing enterprise business applications, related business processes, and personas impacted
    • Identifies existing inefficiencies, potential improvement opportunities, and critical differentiating business requirements
    • Envisions and develops representations of recommended future state options for evaluation by clients
    • Understands related security structures and best practices
    • Designs and develops scorecards for evaluation of candidate business applications
    • Creates dashboard presentations of quantitative and qualitative scoring of candidate options
    • Supports Technical Leads, Developers and Managers by providing functional clarifications and setting expectations with team and client
  • Solution Functional Design:
    • Performs functional (business process) solution design in business applications (ERP, HCM, CRM, & related) contexts, to provide maximized business value and deliver strong business agility while meeting applicable requirements and constraints
  • Consulting:
    • Gains a deep understanding of client needs, analyzes best practices, and plays an integral part in defining and proposing business value solutions that meet or exceed client expectations
  • Program & Project Management:
    • Supports, and manages aspects of business applications implementations
    • Documents and maintains project milestones, phases, elements, and budget
    • Monitors project progress by tracking risks, actions, issues, decisions, and other activities
    • Develops references for users by writing and maintaining user documentation; providing help desk support; training users
  • Implementation and Support:
    • Provides functional support of EBA solutions and related technologies
    • Manages and resolves issues, defects, and change requests
    • Manages and performs systems configuration tasks (but not coding/development) for process workstreams as directed
    • Provides ongoing support during project implementations and post-go-live support
    • Responsible for configuration of solution based on requirements
  • Fosters a positive demeanor, learning attitude and client service mentality with the team
  • Travel – up to 25%, as needed
  • Other duties, as required

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Owns and drives completion of key workstreams as directed by project leaders
  • Manages project workstreams as directed
  • Mentors and develops entry level consultants and senior consultants


Education

Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Bachelor’s Degree and six (6) or more years of industry experience with ERP systems, required; OR
  • High School Diploma/GED and seven (7) or more years of industry experience with ERP systems, required


Experience

  • Six (6) or more years of business process analysis and/or business application education or experience, required
  • Four (4) or more years of education or experience with ERP or CRM Product, required
  • Some client facing best practice consulting experience, preferred


License/Certifications

  • One or more current business applications technology certifications, preferred


Software

  • Microsoft Visio, PowerPoint, Word, and SharePoint, required
  • Experience with one or more ERP/CRM/HCM Solutions technology, required:
    • Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365), CRM, Business Central, F&SCM), Ceridian Dayforce Solutions (Talent & Benefits Intelligence, Workforce Management (WFM), HR, Advanced HR Analytics, or Payroll), Salesforce, Oracle NetSuite, Acumatica, SAP, Infor, Sage, Syteline, JDE, IFS, or any other ERP/CRM Software
  • Smartsheet, preferred
  • Enterprise software strategy, selection, and implementation experience, preferred

Other Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong analytical, problem solving, facilitation, documentation, and communication skills
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, both verbal and written
  • Excellent interpersonal and customer relationship skills
  • Business process analysis, design, and process flow skills
  • Excels at operating in a fast-paced technical environment

Salesforce, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Business Central, Microsoft Dynamics Business Central, Microsoft Dynamics Finance & Operations, Dynamics F&O, Microsoft Finance and Supply Chain Management, Microsoft F&SCM, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dynamics 365 CRM, Microsoft Customer Experience Platform, Business Analyst, BA, Enterprise Tester, Requirements Gathering, User Experience, User Enablement, Data Visualization, Software, Definition, Custom Applications, Data Analytics, Cloud Strategy, SharePoint, Office 365, O365, SFDC, D365, Acumatica, NetSuite. At BDO, how we show up matters. We build strong relationships by supporting one another, our clients, and our communities with care, curiosity, and a commitment to helping one another grow and succeed. BDO Digital, LLC., a wholly owned subsidiary of BDO USA, P.C., is a rapidly growing digital advisory organization dedicated to helping middle-market organizations capture the full power of technology, adapt to disruption, increase operational efficiencies, improve risk management effectiveness, and uncover new sources of revenue.     • Documents existing enterprise business applications, related business processes, and personas impacted

    • Envisions and develops representations of recommended future state options for evaluation by clients
    • Understands related security structures and best practices
    • Designs and develops scorecards for evaluation of candidate business applications
    • Creates dashboard presentations of quantitative and qualitative scoring of candidate options

  • Consulting:

  • Program & Project Management:
    • Supports, and manages aspects of business applications implementations
    • Documents and maintains project milestones, phases, elements, and budget
    • Monitors project progress by tracking risks, actions, issues, decisions, and other activities
    • Develops references for users by writing and maintaining user documentation; providing help desk support; training users
  • Implementation and Support:
    • Provides functional support of EBA solutions and related technologies
    • Manages and resolves issues, defects, and change requests
    • Manages and performs systems configuration tasks (but not coding/development) for process workstreams as directed
    • Provides ongoing support during project implementations and post-go-live support
    • Responsible for configuration of solution based on requirements
  • Fosters a positive demeanor, learning attitude and client service mentality with the team
  • Travel – up to 25%, as needed
  • Other duties, as required

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Owns and drives completion of key workstreams as directed by project leaders
  • Manages project workstreams as directed
  • Mentors and develops entry level consultants and senior consultants


Education

Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Bachelor’s Degree and six (6) or more years of industry experience with ERP systems, required; OR
  • High School Diploma/GED and seven (7) or more years of industry experience with ERP systems, required


Experience

  • Six (6) or more years of business process analysis and/or business application education or experience, required
  • Four (4) or more years of education or experience with ERP or CRM Product, required
  • Some client facing best practice consulting experience, preferred


License/Certifications

  • One or more current business applications technology certifications, preferred


Software

  • Microsoft Visio, PowerPoint, Word, and SharePoint, required
  • Experience with one or more ERP/CRM/HCM Solutions technology, required:
    • Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365), CRM, Business Central, F&SCM), Ceridian Dayforce Solutions (Talent & Benefits Intelligence, Workforce Management (WFM), HR, Advanced HR Analytics, or Payroll), Salesforce, Oracle NetSuite, Acumatica, SAP, Infor, Sage, Syteline, JDE, IFS, or any other ERP/CRM Software
  • Smartsheet, preferred
  • Enterprise software strategy, selection, and implementation experience, preferred

Other Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong analytical, problem solving, facilitation, documentation, and communication skills
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, both verbal and written
  • Excellent interpersonal and customer relationship skills
  • Business process analysis, design, and process flow skills
  • Excels at operating in a fast-paced technical environment

The Emerging ERP Solutions practice is all about bringing you the best in cloud-based ERP applications like Workday Financials and Infor. We're here to help transform finance and supply-chain processes, making them more efficient and cost-effective. Our teams use Deloitte's vast expertise to deliver lasting results for our clients. By working closely with CFOs, CIOs, and Business Unit leaders, we provide valuable business transformation and continuous support across various industries.

If you're seeking an exciting career with plenty of opportunities, consider joining us at Deloitte. We work on projects involving Workday Financials, Supply Chain Management, Infor Solutions, Microsoft Dynamics, and Sustainability Technology and Strategy. With such a variety of areas to explore, you'll have the chance to make a real impact while growing in your career. Come be part of a team that values innovation and strives for excellence. Apply now and let's achieve great things together!

Deloitte's Emerging ERP Solutions-Workday teams are market leaders working with clients across industries to deliver transformational solutions optimized for their unique business needs.

Recruiting for this role ends on 4/1/2026

Work you'll do

As a Workday Financials Sr Consultant, you will lead project workstreams, identify and document business requirements, provide functional design, prototyping (including scenario design, flow mapping), testing, user training, defining support procedures. Additional duties may include: coordination of schedules, creation of documentation and collateral, creation and execution of test / use cases, configuration of Workday software, assisting with prioritization and sequencing of the workstream's efforts and assisting project leadership as required.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of consulting or industry experience in Workday Financials/ERP finance domain
  • 2+ years of experience leading Financials workstreams as well as project teams
  • Workday Financials Professional certification or capability to obtain upon joining
  • A minimum of 1 full life cycle Workday Financial implementation
  • Demonstrated knowledge in some combination of the following: Record to Report, Procure-to-Pay (PTP), Order-to-Cash (OTC)
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Bachelor's Degree or 8 years equivalent professional experience
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred

  • An advanced degree in the area of specialization
  • Functional knowledge around financial systems and processes.
  • Experience defining systems strategy, developing systems requirements, designing and prototyping, testing, training, defining support procedures, and implementing practical business solutions under multiple deadlines Ability to work independently, manage small engagements or parts of large engagements
  • Experience as a lead and mentor to junior staff
  • Presentation skills (MS Visio, MS PowerPoint)

Wages + Salary

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. descriptionHtml:
A. Duda & Sons, Inc. has an opening for a salaried paid Lead Functional Consultant D365 F&SCM Sales and Production at the corporate office in Oviedo, FL. In this position, you will serve as the senior functional contributor for the Sales and Production capabilities of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Supply Chain Management (D365 F&SCM). 

In this role, you will partner with Sales and Production stakeholders, implementation consultants, internal developers, and BI and data teams to translate complex operational requirements into scalable, maintainable D365 solutions. You will lead functional design, configuration, fit-to-standard and fit-gap analysis, testing, implementation readiness, and post-go-live optimization.

The ideal candidate combines deep D365 Sales and Production expertise with strong business-process knowledge and a configure-before-customize mindset. You will help ensure that Duda’s D365 environment supports business objectives, minimizes unnecessary customization, and delivers sustainable long-term value. The position also assists the EDI Manager with testing, maintenance, and support for sales-related EDI integrations.

Primary Responsibilities and Duties:Lead Sales and Production Solution Design
  • Analyze current-state and future-state processes across sales order management, customer setup, pricing and discounts, order promising, fulfillment, production control, bills of materials, formulas, routes, resources, capacity planning, scheduling, and subcontracting.
  • Translate complex Sales and Production requirements into functional D365 F&SCM solution designs.
  • Lead fit-to-standard and fit-gap assessments, evaluating whether business needs can be addressed through standard functionality, configuration, workflow, or process change.
  • Evaluate cross-module impacts involving Inventory Management, Warehouse Management, Procurement and Sourcing, Master Planning, Product Information Management, Quality Management, Cost Management, and Finance.
  • Develop and maintain functional requirements, process flows, configuration specifications, solution-design documentation, and decision records. 
Configure and Optimize D365 F&SCM
  • Lead and perform functional configuration for sales order parameters, pricing and discount structures, delivery and reservation settings, production groups, production-control parameters, bills of materials, formulas, routes, resources, calendars, and scheduling.
  • Demonstrate standard D365 functionality and recommend practical configuration alternatives.
  • Evaluate business-process transformation and standard product capabilities before recommending custom development.
  • Review proposed customizations and challenge unnecessary development when standard functionality, configuration, or process redesign can meet the business need.
  • Assess Microsoft D365 F&SCM releases and recommend standard capabilities that could replace manual processes or existing customizations. 
Partner Across Business and Technology Teams
  • Serve as the senior Sales and Production functional counterpart to implementation consultants throughout discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization.
  • Lead workshops, fit-gap sessions, solution demonstrations, and design reviews.
  • Review implementation-partner designs and configuration recommendations for alignment with business requirements and D365 standards.
  • Provide internal developers with clear functional requirements, business justification, dependencies, expected behavior, and acceptance criteria when development is necessary.
  • Validate that delivered solutions support the approved functional design without unnecessarily expanding customization.
  • Assist the EDI Manager with maintenance, testing, and support for sales-related EDI integrations before and after go-live. 
Drive Testing, Deployment, and Readiness
  • Lead functional testing and business validation for implementations, enhancements, releases, and process changes.
  • Develop or oversee test scenarios, test cases, expected results, and acceptance criteria.
  • Lead user-acceptance-testing readiness, solution demonstrations, training support, cutover readiness, and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Confirm that delivered functionality meets approved requirements and solution designs before deployment to production. 
Solve Complex Problems and Support Continuous Improvement
  • Investigate complex issues involving sales orders, pricing, availability, reservations, fulfillment, production orders, bills of materials, formulas, routes, resources, scheduling, inventory transactions, costing, quality, integrations, and data.
  • Diagnose root causes involving business-process gaps, configuration deficiencies, standard application behavior, data quality, integration failures, and custom development.
  • Guide teams toward sustainable resolutions through solution design, configuration, process optimization, and adoption of standard D365 functionality.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate Sales and Production processes.
  • Recommend solutions that improve controls, usability, reliability, throughput, planning effectiveness, scalability, upgradeability, and total cost of ownership. 
Provide Functional Leadership and Governance
  • Serve as a trusted D365 F&SCM advisor to Sales and Operations leadership, process owners, planners, production managers, customer-service teams, warehouse and inventory stakeholders, subject-matter experts, and technology partners.
  • Present solution alternatives, tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, and business impacts to support informed decision-making.
  • Provide functional governance for Sales and Production configuration and solution changes.
  • Mentor Business Analysts and other team members on D365 F&SCM functionality and business-process design.
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree is required or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience
  • Minimum 6-7 years of relevant ERP, Finance systems, business process, or D365 experience, including significant D365 Sales and Production implementation, configuration, or functional solution design experience
  • Minimum of 2 end-to-end implementations of D365F&SCM - Demonstrated experience leading substantial portions of the D365 F&SCM Sales and Production implementation lifecycle, including discovery, fit-to-standard, fit-gap analysis, functional design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live optimization.
About Us: A. Duda & Sons, Inc. is a privately owned company, ranked #4 on Orlando Business Journal's Top 100 Privately Held Companies list in Central Florida. Starting out as a humble celery farm in 1926, DUDA’s business operations today include Duda Farm Fresh Foods, one of the world’s leading producers and suppliers of celery and other quality fresh and fresh-cut vegetables and citrus; The Viera Company, a highly regarded community developer with fully-integrated real estate operations including Viera Builders, a residential home builder; as well as Duda Ranches, manager of DUDA’s agricultural operations including sod, sugarcane, citrus and cattle.

Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401K, flexible spending accounts, tuition reimbursement, paid time off, and more. Visit our website at www.duda.com for more information.

Application Details:
  • Duda is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.
Ready to make a difference? Apply today and become a part of our dynamic team at A. Duda & Sons, Inc.!

Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.

Senior Associates play an integral client-facing project or work-stream leadership role. While activities vary based on project size/scope and individual skill-sets and strengths, the Sr. Associate can expect to spend their time with a heavy focus on material client interaction through all projects, project management, intensive data-analysis and the identification for the “so-what’s” therein, and to creating compelling client-ready presentations. Additionally, the Sr. Associate will focus on developing Analysts and Coachees.

Responsibilities

  • Lead functional design and configuration for Oracle Cloud SCM implementations with a focus on Procure-to-Pay (P2P) for Higher Education clients.
  • Responsible for Oracle Cloud implementation projects including discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, stabilization, and post-go-live support.
  • Partner with integration, reporting, and data teams to ensure seamless end-to-end design.
  • Facilitate client workshops, document business requirements, identify process improvement opportunities, and translate requirements into Oracle Cloud solutions.
  • Support testing activities including system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), issue resolution, and deployment readiness.
  • Gather and document business requirements, current-state processes, and future-state solution designs.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a field related to this position or equivalent work experience.
  • 3-5 years of experience analyzing requirements, writing functional specifications, conducting testing and interfacing with business users.
  • Must have Oracle Cloud Procure-to-Pay (P2P) implementation experience, including configuration, testing, and client-facing delivery activities.
  • Prior experience leading or supporting implementations for clients in Higher Education strongly preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills to translate information from meetings into documentation that can be shared with meeting participants and project teams.
  • Ability to own project workstreams through self-discipline for planning and organizing tasks with little to no supervision.
  • A desire and willingness to learn new tools, techniques, concepts, and methodologies.
  • Strong attention to detail, with a quality-focused mindset.
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% as needed to work with client or other internal project teams.
